简体中文: 绕已保存的边或面旋转，直到你选择另一个轴。

English (原文): No shown body to change: show one, or choose New Body
简体中文: 没有可更改的显示实体：请显示一个实体，或选择新建实体

English (原文): Pick bodies or features: a sketch is neither. Repeat its curves with the sketch's own Pattern or Mirror, or extrude it first.
简体中文: 请选择实体或特征：草图两者都不是。请用草图自身的阵列或镜像重复其曲线，或先将其拉伸。

English (原文): A point that fills X, Y and Z: click here, then click a vertex, edge or face of the model, a point of a sketch, or the origin.
简体中文: 填入 X、Y、Z 的点：先单击此处，再单击模型的顶点、边或面、草图中的点，或原点。

English (原文): A straight edge of the picked face to measure the distance below from: click here, then click the edge.
简体中文: 所选面上的一条直边，下方的距离从它量起：先单击此处，再单击该边。

English (原文): Select an input to change it. Click selected objects to remove them; Ctrl/Cmd-click also toggles them. Review the preview, then press OK.
简体中文: 选择输入项进行修改。点击已选对象可取消选择；按住 Ctrl/Cmd 点击也可切换选择。检查预览后，再按“确定”。
第 {step} 步，共 {total} 步：选择{input}

English (原文): {name} was changed by another program or computer since you opened or last saved it. Overwrite replaces those changes with yours; Save a Copy keeps both.
简体中文: 自您打开或上次保存 {name} 以来，它已被其他程序或计算机更改。覆盖会用您的更改替换这些更改；保存副本则两者都保留。

English (原文): Finish answering the save prompt before opening another design.
简体中文: 请先回答保存提示，再打开其他设计。

English (原文): Saved by a newer SolidCraft (format {format}, this version reads up to {reads}). If something's missing, update.
简体中文: 由较新版本的 SolidCraft 保存(格式 {format},此版本最高可读取 {reads})。如有缺失,请更新。

English (原文): Saved by a newer SolidCraft (format {format} with `{change}`, which this version doesn't know). If something's missing, update.
简体中文: 由较新版本的 SolidCraft 保存(格式 {format},包含此版本未知的 `{change}`)。如有缺失,请更新。
未读取:{what}。保存时会保留它。

English (原文): {name} is open in SolidCraft {app} on {who}, opened {when}. If you both save, one of you loses work. Open it read-only to look at it without saving over it.
简体中文: {name} 已在 {who} 上的 SolidCraft {app} 中打开（{when}打开）。如果双方都保存，其中一方的工作会丢失。以只读方式打开即可查看而不会覆盖它。

English (原文): Opened read-only: Save asks for a new file
简体中文: 已以只读方式打开：保存时会要求新文件名

English (原文): This design was opened read-only: save it as a new file
简体中文: 此设计以只读方式打开：请另存为新文件
保存 {n} 个设计的更改？

English (原文): {name} has unsaved changes. If you don't save, they are lost.
简体中文: {name} 有未保存的更改。如果不保存，将丢失这些更改。

English (原文): Saved as {name} (templates with images are saved as .scdwg)
简体中文: 已另存为 {name}(含图像的模板保存为 .scdwg)

English (原文): {joint} is a rigid joint: it holds its parts still, so it has nothing to drive. To let them move, change its type in Edit Joint: Revolute to rotate, Slider to slide, Cylindrical for both.
简体中文: {joint} 是刚性接头：它把零件固定在原位，因此没有可驱动的运动。要让零件运动，请在“编辑接头”中更改其类型：旋转用 Revolute，滑动用 Slider，两者兼有用 Cylindrical。

English (原文): Stopped at {value}: the loop through {joint} can't close any further
简体中文: 停在 {value}：经过 {joint} 的环路无法再闭合

English (原文): Moves nothing: {part} is not connected to anything grounded
简体中文: 没有任何移动：{part} 未连接到任何固定的零部件

English (原文): Waiting for the export to stop…

简体中文: 正在取消 DXF 导出

English (原文): Curve tolerance must be between 0.0001 and 1 mm.
简体中文: 曲线公差必须介于 0.0001 和 1 mm 之间。

English (原文): Visible bodies and shown sketches only. Recognised circles and arcs are written as CIRCLE and ARC; other curves use straight segments. Smaller tolerance gives finer curves and uses more time and memory.
简体中文: 仅导出可见实体和显示的草图。曲线使用直线段近似。公差越小，曲线越精细，但需要更多时间和内存。

English (原文): Where the drawing's 0,0 is: the point the camera looks at, or the model's origin as seen from the camera (for machining from a part corner).
简体中文: 图形的 0,0 位于何处：相机所注视的点，或从相机看去的模型原点（用于从零件角部加工）。

message id: each rail's curves must be in one sketch
English (原文): each rail's curves must be in one sketch
简体中文: 每条导轨的曲线必须位于同一个草图中

English (原文): Pick at least one open end face of a frame member
简体中文: 请至少选择一个框架构件的开放端面

English (原文): End {ends} of this cap is no longer on the model. Pick the end faces again
简体中文: 此端盖的端 {ends} 已不在模型上。请重新选择端面

English (原文): Several exploded views are named `{name}`. Use a numeric exploded view ID: {ids}.
简体中文: 多个爆炸图名为 `{name}`。请使用数字爆炸图 ID：{ids}。

message id: feature computation ended without a result
English (原文): feature computation ended without a result
简体中文: 特征计算结束时没有返回结果

English (原文): Designs, CAD files, meshes and drawings
简体中文: 设计、CAD 文件、网格和图纸

English (原文): The file chooser that opened is not the desktop's own: the desktop portal service is not available.
简体中文: 打开的文件选择器并非桌面自带：桌面的文件选择服务不可用。

English (原文): The file chooser that opened is not the desktop's own: there is no D-Bus session bus.
简体中文: 打开的文件选择器并非桌面自带：没有 D-Bus 会话总线。

English (原文): The file chooser that opened is not the desktop's own: under XWayland the portal refuses the parent window.
简体中文: 打开的文件选择器并非桌面自带：在 XWayland 下，门户会拒绝父窗口。

English (原文): Saved preview. Geometry is being checked before editing.
简体中文: 这是已保存的预览。正在检查几何体，完成后即可编辑。

English (原文): Waiting for the previous operation to stop...
简体中文: 正在等待上一次操作停止...

English (原文): Full graphics at the next start
简体中文: 下次启动时使用完整图形
已以安全图形模式启动

English (原文): Gives the selected bodies, faces or components a color or a material look, without changing their weight. Use it to tell parts apart or to preview a finish.
简体中文: 为所选的实体、面或组件设置颜色或材质外观，不改变其重量。用于区分零件或预览表面效果。

English (原文): Lists the parts of the design or a component with their counts, by part number, and can save the list as CSV or JSON. Use it as the parts list for ordering and assembly.
简体中文: 按零件号列出设计或组件的零件及其数量，并可将清单保存为 CSV 或 JSON。用作采购和装配的物料清单。

English (原文): Places a part against another by a geometric rule between a reference on each: mate, flush, distance, concentric, tangent and others. Each rule removes some of the part's freedom and keeps the rest. Use it to position parts while you design, before you know how they move.
简体中文: 通过两个零件各自参照之间的几何规则（配合、齐平、距离、同心、相切等）放置零件。每条规则去除零件的部分自由度并保留其余部分。用于在设计时、尚不清楚零件如何运动之前定位零件。
版本 {version} · 提交 {commit} · 构建日期 {date}

English (原文): Places an image on a planar face of the model, like a sticker. Use it to show a label, logo or printed pattern on a part.
简体中文: 像贴纸一样将图像放到模型的平面上。用于在零件上显示标签、标志或印刷图案。

English (原文): Changes a canvas: its position, size, angle, opacity, mirroring, visibility or name. Use it to line up a reference image with the sketch you trace over it.
简体中文: 修改画布：位置、大小、角度、不透明度、镜像、可见性或名称。用于将参考图像与在其上描绘的草图对齐。

English (原文): Places a PNG or JPEG image on a plane or face as a see-through reference. Use it to trace a photo or drawing in a sketch, with the image scaled to a known size.
简体中文: 将 PNG 或 JPEG 图像作为半透明参考放在平面或面上。用于按已知尺寸缩放图像后，在草图中描绘照片或图纸。

English (原文): Cuts a linked component loose from its design file, keeping its bodies as they are. Use it when the part should no longer follow changes to the original file.
简体中文: 断开链接组件与其设计文件的关联，保留其实体不变。用于零件不再需要跟随原文件修改时。

English (原文): Keeps the positions of parts you moved by hand, so they become where those parts are. Use it after dragging parts into place that no joint holds.
简体中文: 将手动移动过的零件的位置确定为其新位置。用于拖动未被接头约束的零件到位之后。

English (原文): Adds a new, empty component to the design, inside the active component unless you choose another parent. Use it to give a new part of an assembly its own place for bodies and sketches.
简体中文: 向设计添加一个新的空组件，除非另选父级，否则放在当前激活的组件中。用于为装配中的新零件提供存放实体和草图的位置。

English (原文): Saves the part you are editing in place, returns to its assembly and updates the assembly from it. Use it when your changes to the linked part are done.
简体中文: 保存正在原位编辑的零件，返回其装配体，并用该零件更新装配体。对链接零件的更改完成后使用。

English (原文): Turns each selected body into a component of its own, named after the body. Use it when a design built as loose bodies should become an assembly whose parts can be joined and moved.
简体中文: 将每个选中的实体变成一个独立的组件，并以实体名称命名。用于把由零散实体构成的设计变成可用接头连接和移动零件的装配。

English (原文): Inserts another saved design as a component linked to its file, with its solid bodies placed as they are there. Use it to reuse a part in an assembly and pick up later changes with Update Links.
简体中文: 将另一个已保存的设计作为链接到其文件的组件插入，其实体保持在原设计中的位置。用于在装配中复用零件，并通过“更新链接”获取之后的修改。

English (原文): Shows the volume, mass, center of mass and moments of inertia of a component, using its bodies' materials. Use it to check weight and balance of an assembly.
简体中文: 根据各实体的材料，显示组件的体积、质量、质心和转动惯量。用于检查装配体的重量和平衡。

English (原文): Puts parts you moved by hand back where they were, dropping moves that were not captured. Use it to undo trial moves in an assembly.
简体中文: 将手动移动过的零件放回原位，放弃尚未捕获的移动。用于撤销装配中的试移动。

English (原文): Reads the linked design files again and replaces bodies where they changed. Use it after editing a part that this assembly uses.
简体中文: 重新读取链接的设计文件，并替换已更改的实体。用于编辑了此装配所使用的零件之后。

English (原文): Adds parameters, features, materials or appearances as columns of the configuration table. Use it to build variants of one design, such as sizes of a part.
简体中文: 将参数、特征、材料或外观添加为配置表的列。用于创建同一设计的变体，例如零件的不同尺寸。

English (原文): Checks that a row of the configuration table rebuilds, without changing the design or its history. Use it before switching to a variant you are not sure of.
简体中文: 检查配置表的某一行能否重新生成，不改变设计及其历史。用于切换到没有把握的变体之前。

English (原文): Shows the rules of the configuration table, its rows and which row is active. Use it to see how the variants of a design are set up.
简体中文: 显示配置表的规则、各行以及当前生效的行。用于了解设计的变体是如何设置的。

English (原文): Shows the configuration table: one row per variant, one column per parameter or feature, and whether the design still matches the active row. Use it to review the variants of a design.
简体中文: 显示配置表：每个变体一行，每个参数或特征一列，并指出设计是否仍与当前生效的行一致。用于检查设计的各个变体。

English (原文): Restart each assistant to load the SolidCraft server. Each file was backed up as .bak before it changed.
简体中文: 请重启各个助手以加载 SolidCraft 服务器。每个被修改的文件都已备份为 .bak。

English (原文): Creates a construction axis with the method your picks call for: along an edge or line, through a hole or round face, where two planes meet, through two points, or square to a face through a point. Use it when you know the references and not the method.
简体中文: 按所选对象对应的方法创建构造轴：沿边或直线、穿过孔或圆形面、两平面的交线、穿过两点，或过一点垂直于面。在已知参照但不想选择方法时使用。

English (原文): Creates a construction axis along a straight edge or sketch line. Use it as the axis for a revolve, a circular pattern or a joint.
简体中文: 沿直边或草图线创建构造轴。用作旋转、圆周阵列或接头的轴。

English (原文): Creates a construction axis through a point, square to a face. Use it as an axis that stands straight out of a surface.
简体中文: 创建一条过某点、垂直于面的构造轴。用作从表面笔直伸出的轴。

English (原文): Creates a construction axis through the center of a cylinder, cone or torus face, or a circular edge. Use it to turn or pattern features around a round part.
简体中文: 通过圆柱、圆锥或圆环面的中心，或圆形边的中心创建构造轴。用于绕圆形零件旋转或阵列特征。

English (原文): Creates a construction axis where two planes or flat faces meet. Use it when the axis you need is the line between two faces.
简体中文: 在两个平面或平整面相交处创建构造轴。用于所需的轴正是两个面之间的交线时。

English (原文): Creates a construction axis through two points, vertices or sketch points. Use it for an axis that runs between two known positions.
简体中文: 通过两个点、顶点或草图点创建构造轴。用于连接两个已知位置的轴。

English (原文): Creates a construction plane with the method your picks call for: offset from a plane, through a point, between two planes, through lines or points, tangent to a curved face, or square to a path. Use it when you know the references and not the method.
简体中文: 按所选对象对应的方法创建构造平面：偏移自平面、过一点、两平面之间、过直线或点、与曲面相切，或垂直于路径。在已知参照但不想选择方法时使用。

English (原文): Creates a construction plane square to an edge or curve, at a position along it. Use it to sketch a profile for a sweep or a section of a path.
简体中文: 在边或曲线上的指定位置创建垂直于它的构造平面。用于为扫掠绘制轮廓，或绘制路径的截面。

English (原文): Creates a construction plane turned by an angle from a plane or face, about an axis or edge. Turn on Use axis direction only to project the axis onto the base and pivot about a point on that plane (the base origin when none is picked). Use it for sloped sketches, such as an angled bracket.
简体中文: 创建一个由平面或面绕轴或边旋转一定角度而成的构造平面。用于倾斜的草图，例如斜支架。

English (原文): Creates a construction plane containing an axis and a point off that axis. Pick an origin or construction axis, a straight edge or sketch line, then a vertex, sketch point or construction point. A point on the axis cannot define a unique plane.
简体中文: 创建包含一条轴和一个轴外点的构造平面。先选择原点轴、构造轴、直边或草图直线，再选择顶点、草图点或构造点。轴上的点无法确定唯一的平面。

English (原文): Creates a construction plane halfway between two planes or flat faces, or bisecting them where they meet at an angle. Use it as a symmetry plane for mirroring.
简体中文: 在两个平面或平整面的正中间创建构造平面；若二者成角相交，则取其角平分面。用作镜像的对称面。

English (原文): Creates a construction plane parallel to a plane or flat face, at a distance or through a point. Use it to sketch at a set height above a face.
简体中文: 创建与平面或平整面平行的构造平面，按距离或过某点确定。用于在面上方指定高度处绘制草图。

English (原文): Creates a construction plane that holds a line or edge and stands square to a plane or face. Use it to sketch upright on a model along an edge.
简体中文: 创建一个包含某直线或边、并垂直于某平面或面的构造平面。用于沿边在模型上垂直地绘制草图。

English (原文): Creates a construction plane through a picked point, square to a picked straight edge, sketch line or axis. Pick the line, then a vertex, sketch point or construction point; the point can lie on the line or off it. Use it to sketch at the end of an edge, or where a plane must sit square to a line at a picked point.
简体中文: 创建过拾取点、垂直于所拾取的直边、草图直线或轴的构造平面。先选直线,再选顶点、草图点或构造点;点可以在直线上,也可以在直线外。用于在边的端点处草图,或需要平面在拾取点处与一条线垂直时使用。

English (原文): Creates a construction plane that touches a cylinder, cone, sphere or torus at a point. Use it to sketch on the side of a round part.
简体中文: 创建在某点与圆柱、圆锥、球或圆环相切的构造平面。用于在圆形零件的侧面绘制草图。

English (原文): Creates a construction plane through three points. Use it for a plane set by positions on the model, such as three corners.
简体中文: 通过三个点创建构造平面。用于由模型上的位置（如三个角）确定的平面。

English (原文): Creates a construction plane through two straight edges or lines that lie in one plane. Use it for a plane across a part, such as through two opposite edges.
简体中文: 通过位于同一平面内的两条直边或直线创建构造平面。用于穿过零件的平面，例如通过两条相对的边。

English (原文): Creates a construction point with the method your picks call for: at a vertex, at the center of a circle or sphere, along an edge, where two lines or three planes meet, or where a line crosses a plane. Use it when you know the references and not the method.
简体中文: 按所选对象对应的方法创建构造点：在顶点、圆或球的中心、沿边、两直线或三个平面的交点，或直线与平面的交点。在已知参照但不想选择方法时使用。

English (原文): Creates a construction point at a position along an edge or curve. Use it as a reference partway along a path.
简体中文: 在边或曲线上的指定位置创建构造点。用作路径中途的参考。

English (原文): Creates a construction point at the center of a circular edge, sketch circle or arc, sphere or torus. Use it as a reference for holes, axes and joints.
简体中文: 在圆形边、草图圆或圆弧、球或圆环的中心创建构造点。用作孔、轴和接头的参考。

English (原文): Creates a construction point where an edge or line passes through a plane or flat face. Use it to mark where a path crosses a plane.
简体中文: 在边或直线穿过平面或平整面处创建构造点。用于标出路径与平面相交的位置。

English (原文): Creates a construction point where three planes or flat faces meet. Use it as a corner reference, even where the model has no vertex.
简体中文: 在三个平面或平整面相交处创建构造点。即使模型上没有顶点，也可用作角点参考。

English (原文): Creates a construction point where two edges or lines meet, or come closest. Use it as a reference at a virtual corner.
简体中文: 在两条边或直线相交处（或相距最近处）创建构造点。用作虚拟角点处的参考。

English (原文): Creates a construction point on a vertex or sketch point. Use it as a reference that stays when the sketch or body around it is hidden.
简体中文: 在顶点或草图点上创建构造点。用作参考，即使周围的草图或实体被隐藏也会保留。

English (原文): Lists the pairs of parts in contact sets that pass through each other in their current position. Use it to find collisions before you drive joints or run a motion study.
简体中文: 列出接触集中在当前位置相互穿透的零件对。用于在驱动接头或运行运动研究之前查找碰撞。

English (原文): Groups two or more parts into a contact set, whose bodies are kept from passing through each other while joints move. Use it for parts that should stop when they touch, such as a lever against its stop.
简体中文: 将两个或更多零件组成一个接触集，在接头运动时其实体不会相互穿透。用于接触时应停止的零件，例如抵住限位块的杠杆。

English (原文): Turns contact off, so driven joints and motion studies no longer stop where parts touch. Use it to move parts freely again, or to keep a large assembly responsive.
简体中文: 关闭接触，驱动接头和运动研究在零件接触处不再停止。用于重新自由移动零件，或让大型装配保持流畅。

English (原文): Changes a contact set: the parts it holds, its name, or whether it is suppressed; it can also delete the set. Use it to adjust which parts are kept from passing through each other.
简体中文: 修改接触集：其包含的零件、名称或是否抑制；也可以删除该接触集。用于调整哪些零件不得相互穿透。

English (原文): Puts every part of the assembly into one contact set, so no two parts can pass through each other while joints move. Use it for a quick check of a whole mechanism.
简体中文: 将装配中的所有零件放入同一个接触集，使接头运动时任何两个零件都不会相互穿透。用于快速检查整个机构。

English (原文): Turns contact on for the contact sets you defined, so driven joints and motion studies stop where their parts would pass through each other. Use it to bring your sets back after turning contact off.
简体中文: 为已定义的接触集开启接触，驱动接头和运动研究会在其零件即将相互穿透处停止。用于在关闭接触后恢复这些接触集。

English (原文): Lists the contact sets of the design, the parts in each one and whether contact is on. Use it to check how contact is set up before you drive the assembly.
简体中文: 列出设计中的接触集、每个接触集包含的零件以及接触是否开启。用于在驱动装配之前检查接触设置。

English (原文): Shows an overview of the design: its components, bodies, sketches, features and parameters. Use it to get your bearings in a design you did not build yourself.
简体中文: 显示设计的概览：组件、实体、草图、特征和参数。用于了解不是自己创建的设计。

English (原文): Changes the units the design shows lengths in, such as mm or inches. The geometry keeps its size; only the display and plain numbers follow.
简体中文: 更改设计显示长度所用的单位，如 mm 或英寸。几何大小不变，只有显示和纯数字随之改变。

English (原文): Writes the drawing to a file: a PDF of one sheet or of every sheet, one page each at its true paper size, or one sheet as SVG or PNG. Use it to send or print a drawing, or to put it in another program.
简体中文: 将图纸写入文件：单张或全部图纸的 PDF（每张图纸一页，按实际纸张尺寸），或将一张图纸导出为 SVG 或 PNG。用于发送、打印图纸或在其他程序中使用。

English (原文): Makes the whole drawing one PDF, a page per sheet at its true paper size, and opens it in your PDF viewer to print. Use it to print a drawing at scale.
简体中文: 将整个图纸生成一个 PDF（每张图纸一页，按实际纸张尺寸），并在 PDF 查看器中打开以便打印。用于按比例打印图纸。

English (原文): Start a sketch on this sheet or the selected drawing view. Its geometry stays with that owner.
简体中文: 在此图纸或选定的图纸视图上开始草图。几何图形仍归该对象所有。

English (原文): Changes a saved table on a sheet: what it lists, where it sits, its columns and its words. Use it to adjust a parts list or revision table after adding it.
简体中文: 更改图纸页上已保存的表格的内容、位置、列和文字。添加零件表或修订表后，可用它进行调整。

English (原文): Draws a region of a view again, larger, beside it: the view shows the region's outline and letter, the detail what lies inside. Use it for small features a view's scale leaves too small to read or dimension.
简体中文: 将视图的一个区域放大后画在旁边：原视图显示区域的轮廓和字母，局部视图显示区域内的内容。用于视图比例下太小而无法看清或标注的特征。

English (原文): Remembers the design, the active sketch and the undo history as they are now. Use it before trying something risky that you may want to go back from.
简体中文: 记住设计、当前草图和撤销历史的现状。用于尝试有风险的操作之前，以便日后可以回退。

English (原文): Goes back to a checkpoint, undo history included. Use it to drop everything done since the checkpoint in one step.
简体中文: 回到某个检查点，撤销历史一并还原。用于一步丢弃检查点之后的所有操作。

English (原文): Creates an exploded view that pushes the parts away from the assembly's center, or by the moves you set. Use it to show how an assembly goes together, for instructions or presentations.
简体中文: 创建爆炸图，将零件从装配中心向外推开，或按设定的位移移动。用于在说明书或演示中展示装配的组装方式。

English (原文): Removes the selected faces and lets the neighboring faces close the gap, or leaves the gap open as a surface. Use it to take off a rounded edge, a hole or a boss that is in the way.
简体中文: 删除所选的面，并由相邻的面封闭留下的缺口，也可以让缺口保持开放、成为曲面。用于去掉碍事的圆角、孔或凸台。

English (原文): Builds a printed circuit board from its fabrication files: the Gerber board outline and the Excellon drill files become a sketch and a board body of the thickness you set, with every hole and slot cut through. Use it to design an enclosure or a bracket around a real board.
简体中文: 根据制造文件构建印制电路板：Gerber 板框和 Excellon 钻孔文件生成一个草图和一个指定厚度的电路板实体，所有孔和槽都被贯穿切出。用于围绕实际电路板设计外壳或支架。

English (原文): Adds a 3MF, STL, OBJ, PLY or glTF file to the design as mesh bodies in a new component. Use it to place a downloaded or scanned model beside your design as a reference.
简体中文: 将 3MF、STL、OBJ、PLY 或 glTF 文件作为新组件中的网格实体添加到设计中。用于把下载或扫描得到的模型作为参考放在设计旁边。

English (原文): Adds a STEP, IGES, FreeCAD or Rhino file to the design as solid bodies in a new component; an assembly's parts become nested components. Use it to bring in models from suppliers or other CAD programs.
简体中文: 将 STEP、IGES、FreeCAD 或 Rhino 文件作为新组件中的实体添加到设计中；装配中的零件会成为嵌套组件。用于导入供应商或其他 CAD 程序的模型。

English (原文): Saves bodies as an STL, 3MF or OBJ mesh, with the smoothness of curved faces you choose. Use it to prepare parts for 3D printing or for programs that read meshes.
简体中文: 将实体保存为 STL、3MF 或 OBJ 网格，曲面的平滑程度可选。用于为 3D 打印或读取网格的程序准备零件。

English (原文): Saves the selected bodies as a 3MF file and opens it in the slicer you choose. Use it to go from the model to printing in one step.
简体中文: 将选中的实体保存为 3MF 文件，并在所选的切片软件中打开。用于一步从模型进入打印。

English (原文): The interface uses egui's built-in fonts (Ubuntu Light and Hack, under the Ubuntu Font Licence and the MIT/Bitstream Vera license; Noto Emoji and the emoji icon font, under the OFL and MIT). Sketch text uses Liberation Sans (SIL OFL 1.1). The Crafting Apps' optional font pack, craft-fonts (BIZ UDPGothic, Shippori Mincho, BIZ UDMincho, Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans Arabic; SIL OFL 1.1), is not bundled in SolidCraft builds.
简体中文: 界面使用 egui 的内置字体（Ubuntu Light 和 Hack，采用 Ubuntu Font Licence 和 MIT/Bitstream Vera 许可证；Noto Emoji 和表情图标字体，采用 OFL 和 MIT 许可证）。草图文本使用 Liberation Sans（SIL OFL 1.1）。The Crafting Apps 的可选字体包 craft-fonts（BIZ UDPGothic、Shippori Mincho、BIZ UDMincho、Noto Sans CJK SC、Noto Sans Arabic；SIL OFL 1.1）未随 SolidCraft 构建版本捆绑提供。

English (原文): Closes the open ends of frame members with plates shaped like the profile's outline. Use it to seal tubes, angles and beams, on top of the end or set into it.
简体中文: 用符合型材外形的板封闭框架构件的开放端。用于封住管材、角钢和梁的端部，可盖在端面上或嵌入端部。

English (原文): Places a profile, such as a tube or an aluminum extrusion, along the lines of a frame sketch, one member per line. Use it to build frames, racks and welded structures.
简体中文: 沿框架草图的线放置型材（如管材或铝型材），每条线一根构件。用于构建框架、货架和焊接结构。

English (原文): Turns one frame member about its own line, by an angle or so a side lies parallel to a line you pick. Use it to square a tube up to a neighbor or face a flange the right way.
简体中文: 将一根框架构件绕其自身直线旋转，可按角度，也可使某个侧面与所选直线平行。用于让管材与相邻构件对齐，或将翼缘转到正确方向。

English (原文): Colors the faces a tool can reach from one direction, and those it cannot. Use it to check a part for machining or molding from that side.
简体中文: 给刀具从某一方向能够到达和无法到达的面着色。用于检查零件从该方向加工或成型是否可行。

English (原文): Shows the center of mass of bodies, each on its own and all together, at uniform density. Use it to check balance and where a part will tip.
简体中文: 在均匀密度下显示各实体单独以及整体的质心。用于检查平衡和零件的倾倒位置。

English (原文): Gives each component its own temporary color, without changing appearances. Use it to tell the parts of an assembly apart at a glance.
简体中文: 给每个组件一种临时颜色，不改变外观。用于一眼分辨装配体的各个零件。

English (原文): Compares two bodies and shows where one has material the other does not, with volume and deviation. Use it to check a changed or imported part against the original.
简体中文: 比较两个实体，显示其中一个有而另一个没有材料的位置，并给出体积和偏差。用于对照原件检查修改过或导入的零件。

English (原文): Checks how smoothly faces meet along their edges: gaps, kinks or curvature jumps, and shades the seams. Use it to find where surfaces do not join cleanly.
简体中文: 检查各面沿边相接的平滑程度：间隙、折角或曲率跳变，并给接缝着色。用于找出曲面衔接不干净的地方。

English (原文): Draws combs along curves, edges or faces whose teeth show how strongly they bend. Use it to spot flat spots, kinks and uneven curvature.
简体中文: 沿曲线、边或面绘制梳状线，梳齿显示弯曲的强弱。用于发现平坦处、折角和曲率不均。

English (原文): Colors faces by how strongly they curve, red where the radius is small. Use it to find tight spots and to judge how smooth a surface is.
简体中文: 按弯曲程度给面着色，半径小的地方为红色。用于找出急弯处并判断曲面是否光滑。

English (原文): Colors faces by their draft angle to a pull direction, marking those with too little. Use it to check a part before molding or casting.
简体中文: 按各面相对拔模方向的拔模角着色，标出角度不足的面。用于注塑或铸造前检查零件。

English (原文): Shows the model with a reflective, mirror-like finish. Use it to judge the flow of surfaces by the way reflections run across them.
简体中文: 以反光的镜面效果显示模型。用于根据反射的走向判断曲面的流畅程度。

English (原文): Finds bodies that overlap and shows each overlap with its volume. Use it to check an assembly for parts that collide.
简体中文: 找出相互重叠的实体，并显示每处重叠及其体积。用于检查装配体中是否有零件发生碰撞。

English (原文): Draws the isoparametric curves of faces, the grid the surface is built on. Use it to see how a surface flows and where it bunches up.
简体中文: 绘制面的等参线，即曲面所依据的网格。用于查看曲面的走向以及线条密集之处。

English (原文): Measures lengths, distances, angles, areas and radii between what you pick, or the volume and mass of bodies. Use it to check sizes and clearances.
简体中文: 测量所选对象之间的长度、距离、角度、面积和半径，或实体的体积和质量。用于检查尺寸和间隙。

English (原文): Finds the smallest radius of curvature of curves, edges or faces, and where it is. Use it to check that a tool or nozzle can follow the shape.
简体中文: 找出曲线、边或面的最小曲率半径及其位置。用于检查刀具或喷嘴能否沿形状走刀。

English (原文): Cuts the view open along a plane and hatches the cut faces, without changing the model. Use it to look inside parts and assemblies.
简体中文: 沿平面剖开视图并为截面填充剖面线，不改变模型。用于查看零件和装配体的内部。

English (原文): Shows black and white stripes reflected on the model's faces. Use it to judge smoothness: stripes that break or kink at an edge show a poor transition.
简体中文: 在模型的面上显示反射的黑白条纹。用于判断光顺程度：条纹在边处断开或折弯，说明过渡不好。

English (原文): Joins two parts where they already are, without moving either one, and sets how they may still move. Use it for parts you have already placed in their final position.
简体中文: 在两个零件当前所在位置将其连接，不移动任何一个，并设定它们仍可如何运动。用于已放置在最终位置的零件。

English (原文): Links a turning cam to a follower, so the follower slides or swings as the cam's outline passes under it. Use it for cams, eccentrics and valve drives.
简体中文: 将旋转的凸轮与从动件关联，使从动件随凸轮轮廓滑动或摆动。用于凸轮、偏心机构和气门传动。

English (原文): Joins two parts at the joint origins you pick and moves the second part into place; the joint type sets how they may still move. Use it to build an assembly whose parts move like the real mechanism.
简体中文: 在所选的接头原点处连接两个零件，并把第二个零件移到位；接头类型决定它们仍可如何运动。用于构建零件像真实机构一样运动的装配。

English (原文): Sets a joint's angle or distance and moves the parts with it, within its limits; linked joints and closed loops follow. Use it to check that a mechanism moves as intended.
简体中文: 在限制范围内设定接头的角度或距离，并带动零件移动；关联的接头和闭环随之运动。用于检查机构是否按预期运动。

English (原文): Links two turning joints with a gear ratio, so driving one turns the other. Use it for spur and ring gears, with the ratio from pitch radii or tooth counts.
简体中文: 以齿轮传动比关联两个旋转接头，驱动其中一个时另一个随之转动。用于直齿轮和内齿轮，传动比由节圆半径或齿数确定。

English (原文): Sets how far a joint may turn or slide, as a minimum and a maximum, or clears those limits. Use it to keep a hinge, slider or lever within its real range of travel.
简体中文: 以最小值和最大值设定接头可转动或滑动的范围，或清除这些限制。用于使铰链、滑块或杠杆保持在其实际行程内。

English (原文): Couples two joints with a ratio and an offset, so driving one moves the other. Use it for a fixed relation between joints that Gear, Rack and Pinion or Screw do not cover.
简体中文: 以比例和偏移关联两个接头，驱动其中一个时另一个随之运动。用于“齿轮”“齿轮齿条”或“螺旋”无法表达的接头运动关系。

English (原文): Places a named joint origin on a part: at the center of a face or round end, the middle of an edge, a corner or a point. Use it to prepare where joints attach; one picked on a face follows it when the part changes size.
简体中文: 在零件上放置一个命名的接头原点：位于面或圆形端部的中心、边的中点、角点或某一点。用于预先确定接头的连接位置；在面上选取的原点会在零件尺寸改变时跟随该面。

English (原文): Links a turning pinion to a sliding rack, so the rack moves by the length of pitch circle the pinion rolls through. Use it for rack drives, steering and linear stages.
简体中文: 将旋转的小齿轮与滑动的齿条关联，齿条移动的距离等于小齿轮节圆滚过的弧长。用于齿轮齿条传动、转向机构和直线平台。

English (原文): Moves a point on a part toward a target by changing the joints on its chain, within their limits. Use it to pose a mechanism by where its end should be, such as the tip of a robot arm.
简体中文: 通过在限制范围内改变链上的接头，将零件上的某一点移向目标。用于按末端应到达的位置摆放机构，例如机械臂的末端。

English (原文): Locks the selected parts together as they are, so they move as one. Use it for parts that belong together and have no motion between them.
简体中文: 将选中的零件按当前位置锁定在一起，使其作为一个整体运动。用于彼此之间没有相对运动的成组零件。

English (原文): Links turning and sliding by a pitch, so each turn advances by that distance. Use it for lead screws, bolts and threaded spindles.
简体中文: 以螺距关联转动与滑动，每转一圈前进相应距离。用于丝杠、螺栓和螺纹轴。

English (原文): Apply a saved layout to the current workspace. Retained editors keep their drafts.
简体中文: 将保存的布局应用到当前工作区。保留的编辑器会继续保留其草稿。

English (原文): Read the committed layout and discover registered workspaces.
简体中文: 读取已提交的布局并查看已注册的工作区。

English (原文): Restore the current workspace's registered default layout. User presets remain available.
简体中文: 恢复当前工作区注册的默认布局。用户预设仍会保留。

English (原文): Save the complete layout under a name. Replacing a user preset requires explicit overwrite permission.
简体中文: 为完整布局命名并保存。替换用户预设需要明确允许覆盖。

English (原文): Select a registered layout workspace and remember the outgoing layout.
简体中文: 选择已注册的布局工作区，并记住离开前的布局。

English (原文): Applies a material or appearance from a local library file to bodies, faces or components. Use it to reuse materials you saved from another design.
简体中文: 将本地库文件中的材料或外观应用到实体、面或组件。用于重复使用在其他设计中保存的材料。

English (原文): Saves the design's materials and appearances to a library file. Use it to share them or reuse them in other designs.
简体中文: 将设计的材料和外观保存到库文件。用于共享，或在其他设计中重复使用。

English (原文): Checks a library file and lists its materials and appearances, without changing the design. Use it to see what a library holds before applying it.
简体中文: 检查库文件并列出其中的材料和外观，不改变设计。用于在应用之前查看库里有什么。

English (原文): Sets what the selected bodies are made of, such as steel, aluminum or ABS. Use it so that the mass and weight match the real part.
简体中文: 设置所选实体的材料，例如钢、铝或 ABS。用于让质量和重量与实际零件一致。

English (原文): Checks a material data card for consistent numbers and missing values. Use it before relying on the data for mass or stiffness.
简体中文: 检查材料数据卡的数值是否一致、有无缺失。用于在依赖这些数据计算质量或刚度之前。

English (原文): Rebuilds a mesh body, such as an STL, as an editable solid with flat and cylindrical faces. Use it to modify imported mechanical parts like a modeled body.
简体中文: 将网格实体（如 STL）重建为带平面和圆柱面的可编辑实体。用于像修改建模实体那样修改导入的机械零件。

English (原文): Sets joint values at steps along a timeline and plays them back as an animation. Use it to watch a mechanism move through a sequence and check clearances along the way.
简体中文: 在时间轴的各个步骤设定接头值，并以动画方式回放。用于观察机构完成一系列动作，并检查过程中的间隙。

English (原文): Traces the path a point on a part follows while a motion study plays or a joint is driven, and keeps it as a 3D sketch curve when you confirm. Use it to see where a mechanism reaches, or to build on its path.
简体中文: 求出运动研究播放或驱动接头时零件上某一点经过的轨迹，确认后保留为三维草图曲线。用于查看机构的可达范围，或在该轨迹基础上建模。

English (原文): Fixes a part in place, or frees it again, so that joints move the other parts around it. Use it for the frame or base that the rest of the assembly is built on.
简体中文: 将零件固定在原位，或重新解除固定，接头会围绕它移动其他零件。用于装配中其余零件所依托的框架或底座。

English (原文): Moves an assembly part only along freedoms allowed by its joints. Select a part face, then drag an available arrow or arc.
简体中文: 仅沿关节允许的自由度移动装配零部件。选中零部件的面后，拖动可用的箭头或圆弧。

English (原文): Select an open panel tab without requesting keyboard focus.
简体中文: 选择已打开的面板选项卡，而不请求键盘焦点。

English (原文): Close a panel through its content lifecycle guard. Its placement is remembered.
简体中文: 通过内容生命周期检查后关闭面板。其位置会被记住。

English (原文): Collapse or expand a panel section while retaining its requested dimensions.
简体中文: 折叠或展开面板分区，同时保留所需尺寸。

English (原文): Dismiss the temporary view of a collapsed panel.
简体中文: 关闭折叠面板的临时视图。

English (原文): Move a panel into an explicitly positioned floating section.
简体中文: 将面板移至位置明确指定的浮动分区。

English (原文): Focus a panel, reopening its retained state and expanding its section when needed.
简体中文: 聚焦面板，必要时重新打开其保留状态并展开分区。

English (原文): Read registered panel kinds, committed instances, active tabs, availability and host capabilities.
简体中文: 读取已注册的面板种类、已提交的实例、活动选项卡、可用状态和宿主能力。

English (原文): Move a panel into a new section or join an existing tab group.
简体中文: 将面板移至新分区，或加入现有的选项卡组。

English (原文): Return a native panel section to its remembered dock without canceling its content.
简体中文: 将独立窗口中的面板分区返回记住的停靠位置，而不取消其内容。

English (原文): Open a panel kind with an explicit instance identity and placement for a new instance.
简体中文: 使用明确的实例标识打开指定种类的面板。新实例需要指定位置。

English (原文): Temporarily show a collapsed panel without changing its saved size or collapse state.
简体中文: 临时显示折叠的面板，而不更改保存的尺寸或折叠状态。

English (原文): Move a panel to a native host when supported. Browser hosts use a floating section.
简体中文: 支持时将面板移至独立窗口。浏览器宿主会使用浮动分区。

English (原文): Restore an adjacent dock pair's default size ratio within its shared bounds.
简体中文: 在共同约束内恢复相邻停靠分区对的默认尺寸比例。

English (原文): Set a panel section's outer width and height within every tab's bounds.
简体中文: 在所有选项卡的约束内设置面板分区的外部宽度和高度。

English (原文): Resize adjacent dock sections together while conserving their shared extent.
简体中文: 同时调整相邻停靠分区的尺寸，并保持其共同总长度。

English (原文): Opens the table of named values and expressions that drive the dimensions of the design. Use it to change a size in one place and let every feature that uses it follow.
简体中文: 打开驱动设计尺寸的命名数值和表达式表。用于在一处修改尺寸，让所有引用它的特征随之更新。

English (原文): Saves the design's parameters as CSV or JSON. Use it to edit them in a spreadsheet or move them to another design.
简体中文: 将设计的参数保存为 CSV 或 JSON。用于在电子表格中编辑，或转移到其他设计。

English (原文): Shows which parameters and features use which others, and any loops or errors among them. Use it to see what a change to a parameter will affect.
简体中文: 显示哪些参数和特征使用了哪些其他参数和特征，以及其中的循环或错误。用于了解改动某个参数会影响什么。

English (原文): Reads parameters from CSV or JSON into the design, all or none of them. Use it to bring in values from a spreadsheet or another design.
简体中文: 将 CSV 或 JSON 中的参数读入设计，要么全部读入，要么一个也不读。用于从电子表格或其他设计带入数值。

English (原文): Moves a user parameter before or after another in the list. Use it to keep related parameters together.
简体中文: 将某个用户参数移到列表中另一个参数之前或之后。用于把相关参数放在一起。

English (原文): Adds a standard screw, bolt, nut, washer, pin or bearing in the size you pick. Placed on a hole, it seats in the hole with a joint, so you need not model fasteners yourself.
简体中文: 按所选尺寸添加标准螺钉、螺栓、螺母、垫圈、销或轴承。放在孔上时会通过接头安装在孔中，无需自己建模紧固件。

English (原文): Inserts a standard part in the family, size and length you pick. Placed on the rim or wall of a hole, it seats on the hole with a rigid joint.
简体中文: 按所选类别、尺寸和长度插入标准零件。放在孔的边缘或孔壁上时，会通过刚性接头安装在孔上。

English (原文): Opens the standard parts: screws, bolts, nuts, washers, set screws, dowel pins and bearings in standard sizes. Use it to add a standard part instead of modeling it yourself.
简体中文: 打开标准零件：标准尺寸的螺钉、螺栓、螺母、垫圈、紧定螺钉、定位销和轴承。用于直接添加标准件，而无需自己建模。

English (原文): Changes the size or length of an inserted standard part and rebuilds it; its joints keep it seated. Use it when a screw turns out too long or a hole needs another size.
简体中文: 修改已插入标准零件的尺寸或长度并重建；其接头保持安装位置不变。用于螺钉过长或孔需要其他尺寸时。

English (原文): Assigns a plastic rule to bodies, so their plastic features take its draft and clearance as defaults. Use it to set up a molded part once for all its features.
简体中文: 将塑料规则指定给实体，使其塑料特征默认采用该规则的拔模和间隙。用于一次设置好注塑件的所有特征。

English (原文): Adds a screw boss on a face: a post with an optional hole, draft, root fillet and supporting ribs. Use it for screw points in molded or printed housings.
简体中文: 在面上添加螺钉凸台：带可选孔、拔模、根部圆角和加强筋的立柱。用于注塑或打印外壳中的螺钉位。

English (原文): Adds a lip or a matching groove along the rim of a shelled body (Shell a face open first, then pick the rim around that opening). Use it so that two housing halves locate on each other and close tightly.
简体中文: 沿抽壳实体的边缘添加凸缘或与之配合的凹槽。用于让外壳的两半相互定位并紧密闭合。

English (原文): Creates and edits plastic rules: material, wall thickness, radii, clearance and draft. Use them to keep the features of a molded part consistent.
简体中文: 创建和编辑塑料规则：材料、壁厚、半径、间隙和拔模。用于保持注塑件各特征一致。

English (原文): Adds a rest on a face: a round or rectangular pad, solid or hollow, with draft. Use it as a support or standoff in a molded housing.
简体中文: 在面上添加垫块：圆形或矩形的凸垫，可实心或空心，带拔模。用作注塑外壳中的支撑或定位柱。

English (原文): Adds a snap-fit hook on a face, with its length, thickness and catch. Use it to clip parts together without screws.
简体中文: 在面上添加卡扣钩，可设置其长度、厚度和卡爪。用于不用螺钉将零件卡在一起。

English (原文): Insert a PLY, XYZ or PTS scan as a point cloud alongside the model. Use it as a reference when building a model from measured data.
简体中文: 将 PLY、XYZ 或 PTS 扫描作为点云插入到模型旁。根据测量数据建模时，可将其用作参考。

English (原文): Turns surfaces into the rule's sheet metal: the faces of a solid or a surface body, with bends at the edges you pick. Use it to make a sheet metal part from a modeled shape.
简体中文: 按规则将曲面转换为钣金：实体或曲面实体的面，在所选的边处折弯。用于由建模的形状制作钣金零件。

English (原文): Saves the bend table of a sheet metal body as CSV or JSON: angles, radii and bend positions in the flat. Use it for the press brake or the workshop.
简体中文: 将钣金实体的折弯表保存为 CSV 或 JSON：角度、半径以及展开图中的折弯位置。用于折弯机或车间。

English (原文): Saves the flat pattern as a DXF, with outlines, bend lines and optional bend notes. Use it for laser, plasma or waterjet cutting.
简体中文: 将展开图保存为 DXF，包含轮廓、折弯线和可选的折弯注释。用于激光、等离子或水刀切割。

English (原文): Adds a flange: a base plate from a sketch, a wall along an open sketch contour, or a bent wall on sheet edges. Use it to build up sheet metal parts.
简体中文: 添加法兰：由草图生成的基板、沿开放草图轮廓的壁，或在钣金边上折弯的壁。用于构建钣金零件。

English (原文): Creates the flat pattern of a sheet metal body, with its size, cut-outs and bend lines. Use it to check the blank before you cut it.
简体中文: 创建钣金实体的展开图，含尺寸、切口和折弯线。用于在切割前检查坯料。

English (原文): Bends a sheet along a sketch line by an angle and radius. Use it to fold a flat sheet after cutting features into it.
简体中文: 沿草图线按指定角度和半径折弯钣金。用于在平板上切好特征之后将其折叠。

English (原文): Folds a sheet edge back on itself. Use it for safe, stiff edges without sharp burrs.
简体中文: 将钣金边缘折回贴合自身。用于获得安全、坚固且没有锐利毛刺的边缘。

English (原文): Creates and edits sheet metal rules: thickness, bend radius, K-factor, reliefs and gaps. Use them to match the material and tools of your workshop.
简体中文: 创建和编辑钣金规则：厚度、折弯半径、K 因子、释放槽和间隙。用于匹配车间的材料和工具。

English (原文): Adds a chain of flanges along a sheet edge, following an open chain of sketch lines. Use it for profiles such as a U or Z shape in one step.
简体中文: 沿钣金边按开放的草图线链添加一串法兰。用于一步生成 U 形或 Z 形等型材。

English (原文): Adds a field of holes over the whole flat sheet, in a staggered or square pattern. Use it for vents, grilles and lighter panels.
简体中文: 在整块展开的钣金上添加孔阵，排列为交错或方格。用于通风口、格栅和减重面板。

English (原文): Gives sheet metal behavior to a body that is sheet metal already, such as an import or a shelled part of one thickness: its bends and rolls are found from its faces. Use it to unfold and edit a part made elsewhere.
简体中文: 让本身已是钣金的实体（如导入件或厚度均匀的抽壳件）具有钣金行为：从其面中找出折弯和卷圆。用于展开和编辑在别处制作的零件。

English (原文): Folds an unfolded sheet metal body back up. Use it after adding features to the flat sheet.
简体中文: 将展开的钣金实体重新折回。用于在展开的钣金上添加特征之后。

English (原文): Unfolds all bends of a sheet metal body. Use it to add holes or cuts that have to cross a bend, then refold.
简体中文: 展开钣金实体的所有折弯。用于添加需要跨越折弯的孔或切口，之后再重新折弯。

English (原文): Draws a circular arc around a center point, from a start point to an end point. Use it when the arc's center is known, such as a radius around a hole or a pivot.
简体中文: 在圆心周围绘制一段圆弧，从起点到终点。适用于圆心已知的情况，例如孔周围或转轴周围的半径。

English (原文): Draws an arc that starts at the end of a line or arc and continues tangent to it. Use it to carry on a chain with a smooth bend instead of a corner.
简体中文: 从直线或圆弧的端点出发，绘制与其相切的圆弧。用于以平滑的弯曲而不是尖角延续链条。

English (原文): Draws an arc from a start point to an end point through a third point. Use it when the arc has to pass through given points rather than around a known center.
简体中文: 绘制从起点经过第三个点到终点的圆弧。适用于圆弧必须经过给定的点、而不是围绕已知圆心的情况。

English (原文): Draws an exact circular arc in space through three points, with 3D Sketch on. Use it for bends in paths and guide rails that leave the sketch plane.
简体中文: 开启3D 草图后，通过三点在空间中绘制精确的圆弧。用于离开草图平面的路径和导轨中的弯曲。

English (原文): Adds the constraints the sketch nearly has already, such as horizontal, parallel or coincident, then dimensions it until it is fully defined. Use it to lock a roughly drawn sketch in one step.
简体中文: 添加草图已近乎满足的约束，例如水平、平行或重合，然后标注尺寸直到完全定义。用于一步锁定画得比较随意的草图。

English (原文): Works like AutoConstrain, but measures the positions from a datum point you pick instead of the origin. Use it when the part is laid out from one reference point, such as a corner or a hole.
简体中文: 与自动约束类似，但位置是从你选取的基准点而不是原点开始测量。适用于以某个参考点（如角点或孔）布置零件的情况。

English (原文): Joins the ends of two curves with a smooth spline that is tangent to both, or also curvature continuous if you choose. Use it to bridge a gap between curves without a kink.
简体中文: 用与两条曲线都相切的平滑样条曲线连接两者的端点，也可选择曲率连续。用于无折痕地桥接曲线之间的间隙。

English (原文): Splits off the piece you click and keeps all the pieces. Crossings with other curves and points constrained to the curve mark where the piece ends.
简体中文: 在其他曲线与其相交处，或在你放置的点处，把曲线拆分成若干段。适用于曲线的某一段需要单独约束或单独删除的情况。

English (原文): Leaves the sketch and discards everything changed since it was created or opened for editing. Undo brings the changes back.
简体中文: 离开草图，并放弃自创建或开始编辑以来的所有更改。撤销可恢复这些更改。

English (原文): Switches lines between normal lines and centerlines, axes that profiles leave out. Use a centerline as the axis for a revolve, a mirror or a symmetry constraint.
简体中文: 在普通直线与中心线之间切换，中心线是轮廓中不包含的轴线。把中心线用作旋转、镜像或对称约束的轴。

English (原文): Bevels the corner between two lines, set by a distance along the first line and an angle. Use it when a drawing gives the chamfer as a length and an angle, such as 2 mm × 30°.
简体中文: 按沿第一条直线的距离和一个角度，对两条直线之间的拐角倒角。适用于图纸以长度加角度给出倒角的情况，例如 2 mm × 30°。

English (原文): Bevels the corner between two lines the same distance back along both. Use it for the usual 45° chamfer on an outline.
简体中文: 沿两条直线向后退相同距离，对它们之间的拐角倒角。用于轮廓上常见的 45° 倒角。

English (原文): Bevels the corner between two lines, set by a separate distance along each line. Use it for chamfers that are not 45°, given as two lengths.
简体中文: 按沿每条直线各自的距离，对两条直线之间的拐角倒角。用于以两个长度给出的非 45° 倒角。

English (原文): Draws a circle from its center and its diameter. Use it for holes, bosses and other round features whose center is known.
简体中文: 根据圆心和直径绘制圆。用于圆心已知的孔、凸台和其他圆形特征。

English (原文): Draws a circle through three points. Use it when the circle has to pass through given points, for example of existing geometry.
简体中文: 绘制经过三个点的圆。适用于圆必须经过给定点的情况，例如已有几何体上的点。

English (原文): Draws a circle that touches three lines, circles or arcs. Use it to fit a circle into the space between three curves, such as the inscribed circle of a triangle.
简体中文: 绘制与三条直线、圆或圆弧都相切的圆。用于在三条曲线之间放入一个圆，例如三角形的内切圆。

English (原文): Draws a circle from the two ends of its diameter. Use it when the circle's edge points are known rather than its center.
简体中文: 根据直径的两个端点绘制圆。适用于已知圆周上的点而非圆心的情况。

English (原文): Draws a circle of a given size that touches two lines, circles or arcs. Use it for a rounding of fixed radius between two curves.
简体中文: 绘制指定大小、与两条直线、圆或圆弧相切的圆。用于在两条曲线之间做固定半径的圆角过渡。

English (原文): Draws a conic curve between two end points, shaped by an apex point and a rho value. Use it for smooth transitions whose fullness you want to tune, from flat to nearly a sharp corner.
简体中文: 在两个端点之间绘制圆锥曲线，形状由顶点和 rho 值决定。用于需要调节饱满度的平滑过渡，从平缓到接近尖角都可以。

English (原文): Applies the constraint that one or two picked curves nearly have already, such as horizontal, parallel, tangent or equal. Use it to tidy a hand-drawn sketch one relation at a time.
简体中文: 应用所选的一两条曲线已近乎满足的约束，例如水平、平行、相切或相等。用于逐个关系地整理手绘草图。

English (原文): Makes a point lie on another point, a curve or a sketch axis. Use it to close gaps in a profile or to put a point on a line.
简体中文: 使一个点位于另一个点、曲线或草图轴上。用于闭合轮廓中的间隙，或把点放到直线上。

English (原文): Makes two lines lie on one straight line. Use it to line up interrupted edges, such as both sides of a notch.
简体中文: 使两条直线位于同一条直线上。用于对齐被打断的边，例如缺口的两侧。

English (原文): Gives two circles or arcs the same center, or centers a circle or arc on a sketch point, including the origin. Pick either pair in either order.
简体中文: 使两个圆或圆弧具有相同的圆心，也可将圆或圆弧的圆心约束到草图点（包括原点）。两者的选择顺序不限。

English (原文): Makes two curves that meet at an end point continue with the same curvature (G2). Use it where a tangent join is not smooth enough, for example on visible surfaces.
简体中文: 使在端点相接的两条曲线以相同的曲率延续 (G2)。用于相切连接不够平滑的地方，例如可见曲面。

English (原文): Makes lines the same length, or circles and arcs the same radius. Use it so that one dimension drives several matching features.
简体中文: 使直线长度相等，或使圆和圆弧半径相等。用于让一个尺寸同时驱动多个相同的特征。

English (原文): Fixes points or curves where they are, or frees them again. Use it for geometry that must not move when you drag or solve the sketch.
简体中文: 把点或曲线固定在当前位置，或再次解除固定。用于拖动或解算草图时不得移动的几何体。

English (原文): Makes a line, or the line between two points, horizontal or vertical, whichever is closer. Use it to square an outline up to the sketch axes.
简体中文: 使一条直线或两点之间的连线水平或竖直，取更接近的方向。用于让轮廓与草图坐标轴对齐。

English (原文): Puts a point on the middle of a line, or halfway along an arc, or makes the midpoints of two lines meet. Use it to center geometry on an edge.
简体中文: 把点放在直线的中间，或使两条直线的中点重合。用于使几何体相对于某条边居中。

English (原文): Makes two lines parallel. Use it for sides that must stay parallel when other dimensions change.
简体中文: 使两条直线平行。用于其他尺寸变化时必须保持平行的边。

English (原文): Makes two lines meet at a right angle. Use it for square corners between lines that are not on the sketch axes.
简体中文: 使两条直线以直角相交。用于不在草图坐标轴上的直线之间的直角拐角。

English (原文): Makes a closed chain of lines a regular polygon: equal sides, with every corner on one circle. Use it to make a hand-drawn polygon regular and keep it so.
简体中文: 把封闭的直线链变成正多边形：各边相等，所有顶点位于同一个圆上。用于让手绘的多边形变成正多边形并保持如此。

English (原文): Makes two points or curves mirror each other across a line or about a point. Use it to keep a profile symmetric when you change one side.
简体中文: 使两个点或曲线关于一条直线或一个点互为镜像。用于修改一侧时保持轮廓对称。

English (原文): Makes two curves touch tangentially, such as a line and an arc. Use it for smooth joins without a kink.
简体中文: 使两条曲线相切，例如直线与圆弧。用于无折痕的平滑连接。

English (原文): Switches curves between normal geometry and construction geometry, which profiles leave out. Use construction curves as helpers for layout, references and dimensions.
简体中文: 在普通几何与构造几何之间切换，构造几何不参与轮廓。把构造曲线用作布局、参照和尺寸标注的辅助。

English (原文): Create an infinite construction line through two points. Use it to lay out a sketch without splitting profiles.
简体中文: 创建经过两点的无限构造直线，用于辅助绘制草图而不分割轮廓。

English (原文): Create an infinite construction line at an angle from sketch X. Pick the point and type the angle, or pick its direction.
简体中文: 创建与草图X轴成指定角度的无限构造直线。选择一点后输入角度或选择方向。

English (原文): Pick two intersecting straight sketch lines, then choose either angle bisector. The result follows its source lines.
简体中文: 选择两条相交的草图直线，再选择所需的角平分线。结果随原直线的编辑而变化。

English (原文): Create an infinite horizontal construction line through a point, or type its distance from the sketch X axis. A typed distance becomes a driving dimension. Its horizontal constraint follows later edits.
简体中文: 创建经过指定点的无限水平构造直线。后续编辑时保持水平约束。

English (原文): Pick a straight sketch line, then place a parallel infinite construction line or type its offset. A typed offset becomes a driving distance. Right-click to choose another reference.
简体中文: 选择草图直线，然后放置与其平行的无限构造直线。右键单击可更换参照。

English (原文): Pick a straight sketch line, then place a perpendicular infinite construction line. Right-click to choose another reference.
简体中文: 选择草图直线，然后放置与其垂直的无限构造直线。右键单击可更换参照。

English (原文): Create a tangent at a point on a circle or circular arc, or an endpoint of an open spline or conic. Pick the curve, then its contact point.
简体中文: 在圆或圆弧上的点处，或开放样条曲线、圆锥曲线的端点处创建切线。先选曲线，再选接点。

English (原文): Pick a circle or circular arc, then an external point and a tangent solution. The previews show only contacts on the drawn arc.
简体中文: 依次选择圆或圆弧、外部点和所需切线。预览仅显示接点位于已绘圆弧上的解。

English (原文): Pick two circles or circular arcs, then choose a common tangent in the preview. Contacts must lie on the drawn curves.
简体中文: 选择两个圆或圆弧，再从预览中选择公切线。接点必须位于已绘曲线上。

English (原文): Create an infinite vertical construction line through a point, or type its distance from the sketch Y axis. A typed distance becomes a driving dimension. Its vertical constraint follows later edits.
简体中文: 创建经过指定点的无限竖直构造直线。后续编辑时保持竖直约束。

English (原文): Copies the selected sketch curves and points, together with the constraints and dimensions among them. Paste them into this sketch or another one.
简体中文: 复制所选的草图曲线和点，以及它们之间的约束和尺寸。可粘贴到本草图或另一个草图中。

English (原文): Starts a new 2D sketch on a plane or on a flat face of the model. Every extrude, revolve and sweep begins with a sketch.
简体中文: 在平面或模型的平面上开始新的二维草图。每个拉伸、旋转和扫掠都从草图开始。

English (原文): Copies the selected sketch geometry and deletes it from the sketch, in one undo step. Paste it elsewhere in this sketch or into another one.
简体中文: 复制所选的草图几何并将其从草图中删除，只需一步撤销。可粘贴到本草图的其他位置或另一个草图中。

English (原文): Adds a driving dimension: a length, distance, angle, radius or diameter, depending on what you pick. Type a value or a parameter name, and the sketch follows it.
简体中文: 添加驱动尺寸：根据所选对象为长度、距离、角度、半径或直径。输入数值或参数名，草图随之变化。

English (原文): Opens an existing sketch for editing. The features built on it update when you finish the sketch.
简体中文: 打开已有的草图进行编辑。完成草图后，基于它创建的特征会随之更新。

English (原文): Draws an ellipse from its center, the end of its major axis and a point on its minor side. Use it for oval openings, cams and other elongated round shapes.
简体中文: 根据圆心、长轴端点和短轴一侧的一个点绘制椭圆。用于椭圆形开口、凸轮和其他细长的圆形形状。

English (原文): Draws a curve from formulas: x(t) and y(t), or y = f(x), over a range. The formulas can use parameters and the curve follows them: use it for a sine wave, a spiral or a gear tooth's involute.
简体中文: 在一个范围内按公式绘制曲线：x(t) 和 y(t)，或 y = f(x)。公式可以使用参数，曲线随参数变化。适用于正弦波、螺旋线或齿轮的渐开线。

English (原文): Lengthens a line or arc up to the nearest curve in its way, or grows two curves until they meet. Use it to close gaps in a profile after trimming or editing.
简体中文: 把直线或圆弧延长到途中最近的曲线，或把两条曲线延伸到相交。用于在修剪或编辑后闭合轮廓中的间隙。

English (原文): Rounds the corner where two curves meet (lines, arcs, conics or control point splines) with an arc of a given radius. Several corners rounded together share one radius.
简体中文: 用指定半径的圆弧把两条直线或圆弧相交的拐角倒圆。同时倒圆的多个拐角共用同一个半径。

English (原文): Leaves the sketch and returns to the model. Its closed profiles are then ready for Extrude, Revolve and other features.
简体中文: 离开草图并返回模型。其封闭轮廓随即可用于拉伸、旋转和其他特征。

English (原文): Runs AutoConstrain on the sketch, then finishes it. Use it to leave a sketch fully defined in one step.
简体中文: 对草图运行自动约束，然后完成草图。用于一步得到完全定义的草图。

English (原文): Cuts a mesh or solid body with the sketch plane and fits lines and arcs to the section. Use it to rebuild a scanned or imported part as an editable sketch.
简体中文: 用草图平面剖切网格或实体，并用直线和圆弧拟合截面。用于把扫描或导入的零件重建为可编辑的草图。

English (原文): Brings model edges, vertices and curves of other sketches into this sketch as linked references, flattening those off its plane onto it. Use it to build on geometry that does not lie in the sketch plane.
简体中文: 把模型的边、顶点和其他草图的曲线作为关联参照引入本草图，并把不在其平面上的几何压平到平面上。用于基于不在草图平面内的几何继续作图。

English (原文): Switches lines between normal lines and infinite construction lines that run across the whole view. Use them as layout references that never end too short.
简体中文: 在普通直线与贯穿整个视图的无限构造直线之间切换。用作永远不会过短的布局参照。

English (原文): Reads an airfoil coordinate file (.dat, Selig or Lednicer) into a sketch as one curve through every point, at the chord you set. Use it to draw wing sections that a loft turns into a wing.
简体中文: 将翼型坐标文件（.dat，Selig 或 Lednicer 格式）按设定的弦长读入草图，成为一条经过每个点的曲线。用于绘制翼剖面，再用放样生成机翼。

English (原文): Reads the curves of a DXF drawing into a sketch, scaled, turned and placed where you set. Use it to build on a 2D drawing from another program, such as a laser-cut outline.
简体中文: 将 DXF 图纸中的曲线读入草图，并按设定进行缩放、旋转和放置。用于在其他程序制作的二维图纸（例如激光切割轮廓）基础上建模。

English (原文): Reads the paths of an SVG drawing into a sketch, scaled, turned and placed where you set. Use it to turn a logo or vector outline into curves you can extrude.
简体中文: 将 SVG 图形中的路径读入草图，并按设定进行缩放、旋转和放置。用于把标志或矢量轮廓变成可拉伸的曲线。

English (原文): Opens a report on the open sketch: how many degrees of freedom are left and whether it is fully constrained. Use it to find out what still moves before you finish the sketch.
简体中文: 打开当前草图的报告：显示剩余的自由度以及是否已完全约束。在完成草图之前，用它找出仍然可以移动的部分。

English (原文): Adds the curves or points where bodies, faces, edges or other sketches cross the sketch plane. They stay linked and follow the model when it changes.
简体中文: 添加实体、面、边或其他草图与草图平面相交处的曲线或点。它们保持关联，并随模型变化。

English (原文): Creates 3D curves where two bodies, faces or curves of other sketches meet, linked to them. Use them as paths or guide rails that follow the model.
简体中文: 在两个实体、面或其他草图的曲线相交处创建与它们关联的三维曲线。用作跟随模型的路径或导轨。

English (原文): Creates a 3D curve along a face's U or V direction through a point you pick, linked to the face. Use it as a path or split line that follows the surface.
简体中文: 通过你选取的点，沿面的 U 或 V 方向创建与该面关联的三维曲线。用作跟随曲面的路径或分割线。

English (原文): Draws connected lines point by point, as an open chain or a closed outline. It is the basic tool for most profiles.
简体中文: 逐点绘制相连的直线，可以是开放链或封闭轮廓。这是绘制大多数轮廓的基本工具。

English (原文): Draws a line from its midpoint out to one end, with the other end mirrored. Use it for lines centered on a point, such as a symmetric edge.
简体中文: 从中点向一端绘制直线，另一端随之对称生成。用于以某点为中心的直线，例如对称的边。

English (原文): Draws connected straight lines between points in space, with 3D Sketch on. Use it for paths and frames that leave the sketch plane.
简体中文: 开启3D 草图后，在空间中的点之间绘制相连的直线。用于离开草图平面的路径和框架。

English (原文): Mirrors sketch curves and points across a line or axis and adds symmetry constraints. Use it to draw half of a symmetric profile and complete it.
简体中文: 把草图曲线和点关于直线或轴镜像，并添加对称约束。用于只画对称轮廓的一半，再将其补全。

English (原文): Moves or rotates sketch curves and points, or a copy of them. Use it to reposition geometry while keeping its shape and constraints.
简体中文: 移动或旋转草图曲线和点，或它们的副本。用于在保持形状和约束的同时调整几何的位置。

English (原文): Creates a copy of a chain of curves at a set distance, on one side or both. Use it for walls, outlines and clearances; the distance stays an editable dimension.
简体中文: 按设定的距离在一侧或两侧创建曲线链的副本。用于壁、轮廓和间隙；距离仍是可编辑的尺寸。

English (原文): Pastes sketch geometry you copied or cut into the active sketch. Place it at a point or shift it by an offset.
简体中文: 把复制或剪切的草图几何粘贴到当前草图。可放置在某一点，或按偏移量移动。

English (原文): Copies sketch geometry around a center point, over a full circle or a set angle. Use it for bolt circles, spokes and teeth.
简体中文: 绕中心点复制草图几何，可绕整圆或按设定角度。用于螺栓圆、辐条和齿。

English (原文): Copies sketch geometry in rows and columns at set spacings. Use it for grids of holes, slots or vents.
简体中文: 按设定间距以行和列复制草图几何。用于孔、槽或通风口的阵列。

English (原文): Places a sketch point. Use it as a reference for dimensions, constraints, hole centers or later features.
简体中文: 放置一个草图点。用作尺寸、约束、孔心或后续特征的参照。

English (原文): Places points that divide the picked curves into equal lengths. The points stay on each curve and keep their spacing when it changes.
简体中文: 放置将所选曲线分成等长段的点。这些点留在各曲线上，曲线改变时保持间距。

English (原文): Places a point in space, with 3D Sketch on. Use it as a reference for 3D curves and paths.
简体中文: 开启3D 草图后，在空间中放置一个点。用作三维曲线和路径的参照。

English (原文): Draws a regular polygon around a circle, sized from its center to the middle of a side. Use it when the width across flats is known, as for a hex nut.
简体中文: 在圆外绘制正多边形，大小由中心到边中点的距离决定。适用于已知对边距的情况，例如六角螺母。

English (原文): Draws a regular polygon from the two ends of one side. Use it when the length and position of a side are known.
简体中文: 根据一条边的两个端点绘制正多边形。适用于已知边的长度和位置的情况。

English (原文): Draws a regular polygon inside a circle, sized from its center to a corner. Use it when the size across corners is known.
简体中文: 在圆内绘制正多边形，大小由中心到顶点的距离决定。适用于已知对角距的情况。

English (原文): Brings model edges, faces, vertices and curves of other sketches into this sketch, projected onto its plane. They stay linked and follow the model when it changes.
简体中文: 把模型的边、面、顶点和其他草图的曲线投影到本草图的平面上并引入。它们保持关联，并随模型变化。

English (原文): Projects curves of other sketches along this sketch's normal onto a face, as linked 3D curves. Use it to put a logo, split line or path onto a curved surface.
简体中文: 把其他草图的曲线沿本草图的法线方向投影到面上，生成关联的三维曲线。用于把标志、分割线或路径放到曲面上。

English (原文): Draws a rectangle from its center and one corner. Use it for outlines centered on a point, such as the origin.
简体中文: 根据中心和一个角点绘制矩形。用于以某点（如原点）为中心的轮廓。

English (原文): Draws a rectangle from the middle of one edge, one end of that edge and its width. Use it for a slot, tab or bracket centered on a point or on the middle of a line.
简体中文: 根据一条边的中点、该边的一个端点和宽度绘制矩形。用于以某点或某条线的中点为中心的槽、凸片或支架。

English (原文): Draws a rectangle with all four corners rounded to one radius. Use it for plates, lids and openings with rounded corners.
简体中文: 绘制四个角都倒成同一半径圆角的矩形。用于带圆角的板、盖和开口。

English (原文): Draws a rectangle from one edge and a point on the opposite side. Use it for rectangles at an angle to the sketch axes.
简体中文: 根据一条边和对侧的一个点绘制矩形。用于与草图坐标轴成角度的矩形。

English (原文): Draws a rectangle from two opposite corners. Use it for the outlines of plates, blocks and pockets.
简体中文: 根据两个对角点绘制矩形。用于板、块体和凹槽的轮廓。

English (原文): Scales sketch curves and points by a factor about a base point. Use it to resize part of a sketch without drawing it again.
简体中文: 以基点为中心按比例缩放草图曲线和点。用于无需重画就调整草图某一部分的大小。

English (原文): Draws a curved slot of a given width along an arc set by its center, start and end. Use it for adjustment slots around a pivot.
简体中文: 沿由圆心、起点和终点确定的圆弧，绘制指定宽度的弧形槽。用于绕转轴的调节槽。

English (原文): Draws a curved slot of a given width along an arc through three points. Use it when the slot's path has to pass through given points.
简体中文: 沿经过三点的圆弧，绘制指定宽度的弧形槽。适用于槽的路径必须经过给定点的情况。

English (原文): Draws a straight slot of a given width from its center to the center of one end arc. Use it for slots centered on a point.
简体中文: 从中心到一端圆弧的圆心，绘制指定宽度的直槽。用于以某点为中心的槽。

English (原文): Draws a straight slot of a given width between the centers of its two end arcs. Use it for slots dimensioned center to center, such as adjustment slots for screws.
简体中文: 在两端圆弧的圆心之间，绘制指定宽度的直槽。用于按中心距标注的槽，例如螺钉调节槽。

English (原文): Draws a straight slot of a given width from one outer end to the other. Use it when the slot's overall length is what matters.
简体中文: 从一个外端到另一个外端，绘制指定宽度的直槽。适用于槽的总长最重要的情况。

English (原文): Draws a control point spline with the knots and weights it is given, so the curve is exactly that B-spline and not one the points imply. Use it to reproduce a spline with a fixed knot vector, such as one from another system; a weighted spline must be of degree 2.
简体中文: 按给定的节点和权重绘制控制点样条，曲线正是该 B 样条，而不是由点推出的曲线。用于重现节点向量固定的样条，例如来自其他系统的样条；带权重的样条必须为 2 次。

English (原文): Draws a cubic spline shaped by control points that it does not pass through. Use it for smooth, flowing curves that you shape by moving the points.
简体中文: 绘制由控制点决定形状的三次样条曲线，曲线不经过这些点。用于通过移动控制点来塑形的平滑流畅曲线。

English (原文): Draws a degree 5 spline shaped by control points. Use it where curves have to join with smoother curvature, for example on visible styled surfaces.
简体中文: 绘制由控制点决定形状的 5 次样条曲线。用于曲线需要以更平滑的曲率连接的地方，例如可见的造型曲面。

English (原文): Draws a smooth spline that passes through every point you place, open or closed. Use it to trace a shape through known points.
简体中文: 绘制经过你放置的每个点的平滑样条曲线，可开放或封闭。用于通过已知点描出形状。

English (原文): Draws one smooth spline through as few of a contour's many points as keep every point within a tolerance, and reports the deviation it reached. Use it for a contour from a computation: a traced outline, a scanned section or a generated shape.
简体中文: 从轮廓的大量点中选出尽可能少的点，绘制一条使每个点都在公差之内的光滑样条，并报告实际达到的偏差。用于来自计算的轮廓：描摹的外形、扫描的截面或生成的形状。

English (原文): Draws a smooth curve in space through points, with 3D Sketch on. Use it for sweep paths and cable runs that leave the sketch plane.
简体中文: 开启3D 草图后，在空间中通过各点绘制平滑曲线。用于离开草图平面的扫掠路径和线缆走线。

English (原文): Creates in the sketch plane the outline a body sweeps when it turns about an axis. Use it to get the silhouette of a turned part for a revolve or a drawing.
简体中文: 在草图平面中创建实体绕轴旋转时扫出的轮廓。用于获得车削零件的剪影，以便旋转或出图。

English (原文): Writes text in the sketch in a chosen font, height and angle; its words can follow parameters. Extrude or emboss it for labels and lettering.
简体中文: 用选定的字体、高度和角度在草图中写文字；文字内容可以跟随参数。拉伸或压印后可做标签和字样。

English (原文): Scales, turns and moves sketch geometry about a center point in one step. Use it to reposition and resize a selection at once.
简体中文: 以中心点为基准，一步完成草图几何的缩放、旋转和移动。用于同时调整所选对象的位置和大小。

English (原文): Removes the piece you click. Crossings with other curves and points constrained to the curve mark where the piece ends.
简体中文: 删除你点击位置周围、最近两个交点之间的那段曲线。用于把重叠的线整理成封闭轮廓。

English (原文): Moves the selected bodies so that a point, face or plane on them meets a point, face or plane elsewhere. Use it to place a part against another one without measuring the offset.
简体中文: 移动所选实体，使其上的点、面或平面与别处的点、面或平面对齐。用于把一个零件贴靠到另一个零件上，而无需测量距离。

English (原文): Makes solids from the regions enclosed by overlapping tool bodies, filling only the regions you pick. Use it to build a shape from the space that several bodies bound together.
简体中文: 由相互重叠的工具实体所围成的区域生成实体，只填充所选区域。用于利用多个实体共同围成的空间构建形状。

English (原文): Creates a box that encloses the selected bodies, with an optional margin. Use it to see a part's overall size, or as the stock it is machined from.
简体中文: 创建包围选中实体的长方体，可设置余量。用于查看零件的总体尺寸，或作为加工所用的毛坯。

English (原文): Creates a box from a length, width and height, from a corner point or centered on a point. Use it for a quick block, a placeholder or a body to cut features into.
简体中文: 根据长、宽、高创建长方体，可从角点或以某点为中心放置。用于快速创建块体、占位体或用于切出特征的实体。

English (原文): Cuts the selected edges with a flat bevel of the distance you set. Use it to break sharp edges or to ease the entry of a pin or screw.
简体中文: 用指定的距离在所选边上切出一个平直的斜面。用于去除锐边，或使销钉、螺钉更容易插入。

English (原文): Creates a helical body, such as a spring, from a diameter, turns, height or pitch and a round or square section. Use it for springs, coils and helical ridges.
简体中文: 根据直径、圈数、高度或螺距以及圆形或方形截面创建螺旋形实体，例如弹簧。用于弹簧、线圈和螺旋凸筋。

English (原文): Joins bodies, cuts them out of a target body, or keeps only the volume they share, and can keep the tool bodies. Use it to merge parts, to cut one shape with another or to find where two bodies overlap.
简体中文: 将多个实体合并、从目标实体中切除，或只保留它们共有的体积，还可以保留工具实体。用于合并零件、用一个形体切割另一个形体，或找出两个实体重叠的位置。

English (原文): Creates a cone from a base circle and a height, or a truncated cone when the top has a radius too. Use it for tapers, funnels, countersinks and points.
简体中文: 根据底圆和高度创建圆锥体；若顶面也有半径，则为圆台。用于锥度、漏斗、沉头孔和尖端。

English (原文): Creates a cylinder from a radius or diameter and a height, standing on a point along an axis. Use it for shafts, pins, bosses and round blanks.
简体中文: 根据半径或直径和高度创建圆柱体，立于某点并沿某轴延伸。用于轴、销、凸台和圆形毛坯。

English (原文): Tilts the selected faces by the angle you set, measured from a neutral plane. Use it on molded or cast parts so that they slide out of the mold.
简体中文: 将所选的面按指定角度倾斜，角度从中性面量起。用于注塑件或铸件，使零件能够脱模。

English (原文): Raises sketch profiles, such as text or a logo, out of a face, or sinks them into it. Use it for lettering, labels and markings on flat or round faces.
简体中文: 将文字或标志等草图轮廓从面上凸起或凹入。用于平面或圆柱面上的文字、标签和标记。

English (原文): Pushes a sketch profile into 3D along a distance, adding or removing material. Use it to turn a flat outline into a block, a boss or a pocket.
简体中文: 将草图轮廓按指定距离拉伸为三维形体，可以增加或去除材料。用于把平面轮廓变成方块、凸台或凹槽。

English (原文): Rounds the selected edges with a smooth circular blend of the radius you set. Use it to soften sharp edges for strength, comfort or looks.
简体中文: 用指定半径的平滑圆弧将所选的边倒圆。用于出于强度、手感或外观的考虑而柔化锐边。

English (原文): Drills a round hole of the diameter you set at a chosen point on a face. Use it for screw clearances, pins and other simple round openings.
简体中文: 在面上的指定位置钻出指定直径的圆孔。用于螺钉过孔、销孔等简单的圆形开口。

English (原文): Blends a smooth solid between two or more sketch profiles, or from a profile to a point. Use it for transitions, funnels, handles and any shape that changes section along its length.
简体中文: 在两个或更多草图轮廓之间，或从轮廓到一个点，生成平滑过渡的实体。用于过渡段、漏斗、手柄等截面沿长度变化的形体。

English (原文): Makes a mirrored copy of the selected bodies or features across a plane, and can merge it with the original. Use it for symmetric parts, so that you model one half and get both.
简体中文: 将所选实体或特征相对于一个平面生成镜像副本，还可以与原件合并。用于对称零件，只需建一半即可得到两侧。

English (原文): Moves or rotates the selected bodies, or a copy of them, by the distance and angle you set. Use it to reposition a body or to make a second one in another place.
简体中文: 按指定的距离和角度移动或旋转所选实体，或其副本。用于调整实体位置，或在别处再生成一个。

English (原文): Pushes the selected faces in or out by the distance you set, and the faces around them follow. Use it to make a wall thicker, a pocket deeper or a boss taller without editing the sketch.
简体中文: 将所选的面按指定距离向内或向外推移，周围的面随之调整。用于在不编辑草图的情况下加厚壁、加深凹槽或加高凸台。

English (原文): Repeats the selected objects around an axis, for the count and total angle you set. Use it for bolt circles, spokes, fins and teeth.
简体中文: 将所选对象按指定的数量和总角度绕轴重复排列。用于螺栓圆周分布、辐条、散热片和轮齿。

English (原文): Copies features or bodies along a sketch path, by count and spacing. Use it for holes along a curved edge or parts along a rail.
简体中文: 沿草图路径按数量和间距复制特征或实体。用于沿曲线边的孔，或沿导轨的零件。

English (原文): Repeats the selected objects in one or two directions with the count and spacing you set. Use it for rows and grids of holes, ribs, pins or feet.
简体中文: 将所选对象按指定的数量和间距沿一个或两个方向重复排列。用于成排或成网格的孔、加强筋、销钉或支脚。

English (原文): Creates a round tube along a path of sketch curves, solid or hollow with a wall thickness. Use it for tubes, wires, cables and rails.
简体中文: 沿草图曲线路径创建圆管，可为实心或带壁厚的空心。用于管道、线材、电缆和栏杆。

English (原文): Adds or removes material as you drag a face, or rounds edges as you drag them. Use it for quick changes straight on the model.
简体中文: 拖动面来增加或去除材料，或拖动边将其倒圆。用于直接在模型上快速修改。

English (原文): Takes the selected bodies out of the design from this point in the timeline on; earlier steps keep them. Use it to drop a helper body, such as a cutting tool you no longer need.
简体中文: 从时间线的这一位置起，将所选实体从设计中移除；之前的步骤仍保留它们。用于去掉辅助实体，例如不再需要的切割工具。

English (原文): Moves the selected flat faces onto a plane or onto a parallel face, and the body grows or shrinks to meet it. Use it to bring a face flush with another part or a construction plane.
简体中文: 将所选的平面移到一个平面或平行的面上，实体随之伸长或缩短。用于让一个面与另一个零件或构造平面齐平。

English (原文): Spins a sketch profile around an axis to make a round solid. Use it for shafts, knobs, bowls and any part that is round about a center line.
简体中文: 将草图轮廓绕一条轴旋转，生成圆形的实体。用于轴、旋钮、碗等围绕中心线呈圆形的零件。

English (原文): Adds a thin wall along an open sketch curve, filled out to the next faces of the body. Use it to stiffen walls and corners, for example in molded or printed parts.
简体中文: 沿开放的草图曲线添加一道薄壁，延伸到实体的下一个面。用于加强壁和角，例如注塑件或打印件。

English (原文): Makes the selected bodies larger or smaller by a factor, the same in every direction or one per axis. Use it to resize an imported shape or to allow for shrinkage.
简体中文: 按比例放大或缩小所选实体，可在各方向相同，也可按轴分别设置。用于调整导入形体的大小，或预留收缩量。

English (原文): Hollows out a solid, leaving walls of the thickness you set, and can open the faces you pick. Use it for boxes, covers and other thin-walled parts.
简体中文: 将实体掏空，留下指定厚度的壁，还可以打开所选的面。用于盒子、盖子等薄壁零件。

English (原文): Creates a sphere from a radius or diameter around a center point. Use it for balls, knobs and rounded ends.
简体中文: 根据半径或直径，以指定点为球心创建球体。用于球、旋钮和圆头端部。

English (原文): Cuts a body into separate bodies with a plane, the face of another body or a sketch line. Use it to make parts that are printed, machined or colored on their own.
简体中文: 用平面、另一实体的面或草图直线，将实体切分为多个独立的实体。用于制作分别打印、加工或上色的零件。

English (原文): Divides the selected faces along a plane, the face of another body or sketch curves, without cutting the body. Use it to give part of a face its own draft, color or offset.
简体中文: 沿平面、另一实体的面或草图曲线分割所选的面，而不切开实体。用于给面的一部分单独设置拔模、颜色或偏移。

English (原文): Drags a sketch profile along a path to make a solid. Use it for pipes, rails, handles and any part of constant section that follows a curve.
简体中文: 沿路径拖动草图轮廓生成实体。用于管道、导轨、手柄等截面恒定且沿曲线延伸的零件。

English (原文): Adds an ISO metric thread to a cylindrical face, either as a cosmetic thread or cut into the body. Use it for bolts, threaded holes and printed screw parts.
简体中文: 在圆柱面上添加 ISO 公制螺纹，可作为装饰螺纹或切入实体。用于螺栓、螺纹孔和打印的螺纹零件。

English (原文): Creates a ring from a major radius around its axis and a minor radius for its round section. Use it for O-rings, handles and round beads.
简体中文: 根据绕轴的大半径和圆形截面的小半径创建圆环。用于 O 形圈、把手和环形凸筋。

English (原文): Adds a thin wall along each open sketch curve, each filled out to the next faces of the body. Use it for a grid of supporting walls inside housings and trays.
简体中文: 沿每条开放的草图曲线各添加一道薄壁，均延伸到实体的下一个面。用于外壳和托盘内部的网格支撑壁。

English (原文): Creates a surface that bridges the edges of two bodies, tangent or curvature continuous to both. Use it to join two surfaces smoothly across a gap.
简体中文: 创建桥接两个实体边的曲面，与两侧相切连续或曲率连续。用于在间隙上将两个曲面平滑连接。

English (原文): Creates a surface filling a loop of two to four sketch curves, or a network of curves. Use it for free-form panels defined by their edges.
简体中文: 创建填充由二至四条草图曲线构成的环或曲线网络的曲面。用于由边界定义的自由曲面面板。

English (原文): Lengthens a surface past its edges, by a distance or up to a plane or face. Use it so that surfaces overlap before you trim or stitch them.
简体中文: 将曲面延伸出其边缘，按距离或直至某个平面或面。用于在修剪或缝合之前让曲面相互重叠。

English (原文): Pushes sketch curves or profiles along a distance into a surface, walls only, without caps. Use it for thin walls and for cutting or splitting tools.
简体中文: 将草图曲线或轮廓按一段距离拉伸为曲面，只有壁，没有端盖。用于薄壁，以及切割或分割工具。

English (原文): Smooths the inside of free-form faces while their edges stay put. Use it to even out bumps and wavy reflections in a surface.
简体中文: 在保持边不动的前提下，使自由曲面的内部变得光顺。用于抚平曲面上的凸起和波浪状反射。

English (原文): Creates a surface that passes through two or more sections in order, without caps. Use it for shells and transitions between different shapes.
简体中文: 创建按顺序穿过两个或更多截面的曲面，无端盖。用于外壳以及不同形状之间的过渡。

English (原文): Rebuilds the edge of a surface so it meets another body's edge, with matching tangent or curvature. Use it to close a seam smoothly between two surfaces.
简体中文: 重建曲面的边，使其与另一实体的边衔接，并匹配相切或曲率。用于平滑地闭合两个曲面之间的接缝。

English (原文): Creates a copy of faces at a distance along their normals, as a new surface body. Use it for skins, clearances or the other side of a wall.
简体中文: 将面沿法向按一定距离复制为新的曲面实体。用于蒙皮、间隙，或壁的另一侧。

English (原文): Fills a sketch region or a closed loop of edges with a face, flat or smoothly curved. Use it to close holes in a surface body.
简体中文: 用平面或平滑弯曲的面填充草图区域或边的闭合环。用于封闭曲面实体上的孔。

English (原文): Turns faces of a surface body over, so their outside faces the other way. Use it before thickening or stitching when the faces point inward.
简体中文: 翻转曲面实体的面，使其外侧朝向反方向。用于面朝内时，在加厚或缝合之前。

English (原文): Turns sketch curves or profiles about an axis into a surface, without caps. Use it for round shells such as lampshades, bowls and nozzles.
简体中文: 将草图曲线或轮廓绕轴旋转为曲面，无端盖。用于灯罩、碗、喷嘴等圆形壳体。

English (原文): Creates a strip of straight lines out from a chain of edges, along the face's normal, tangent or at an angle. Use it for draft walls, run-offs and parting surfaces.
简体中文: 从一串边出发，沿面的法向、切向或按某一角度生成由直线构成的带状面。用于拔模壁、过渡面和分型面。

English (原文): Sews surface bodies together along their shared edges, into a solid when they close. Use it to turn a set of surfaces into one body.
简体中文: 沿共用的边将曲面实体缝合在一起，闭合时成为实体。用于将一组曲面变成一个实体。

English (原文): Moves sketch curves or profiles along a path into a surface, without caps. Use it for gutters, trims and other thin shapes that follow a path.
简体中文: 沿路径移动草图曲线或轮廓生成曲面，无端盖。用于排水槽、饰条等沿路径延伸的薄形状。

English (原文): Gives a surface body a thickness, turning it into a solid. Use it to make printable or machinable parts from surfaces.
简体中文: 为曲面实体赋予厚度，使其成为实体。用于由曲面制作可打印或可加工的零件。

English (原文): Cuts a surface with a plane, another surface or sketch curves, and keeps the side you pick. Use it to cut surfaces to shape before stitching.
简体中文: 用平面、另一个曲面或草图曲线切割曲面，并保留所选的一侧。用于在缝合前将曲面切成所需形状。

English (原文): Separates faces of a body into surface bodies of their own; a solid comes apart into surfaces. Use it to rework single faces of a body.
简体中文: 将实体的面分离为各自独立的曲面实体；实体会拆成曲面。用于重新处理实体中的单个面。

English (原文): Removes holes from a face, or restores its outer boundary to the surface's natural bounds. Use it to get back the full surface after a trim.
简体中文: 去掉面上的孔，或将其外边界恢复为曲面的自然边界。用于在修剪之后找回完整的曲面。

English (原文): Rebuilds every feature in the timeline from the start. Use it to refresh the model and to see which features fail.
简体中文: 从头重新计算时间线中的所有特征。用于刷新模型，并查看哪些特征失败。

English (原文): Deletes the selected features from the timeline; deleting a sketch also deletes the features built from it. Use it to remove a step that is no longer wanted.
简体中文: 从时间线中删除所选特征；删除草图时，由它生成的特征也会一起删除。用于去掉不再需要的步骤。

English (原文): Lists the features that would be deleted with a feature, and those that would fail without it. Use it before deleting or changing a feature.
简体中文: 列出会随某个特征一同被删除的特征，以及缺少它就会失败的特征。用于在删除或更改特征之前。

English (原文): Replay the remaining features one at a time, with a half-second pause after each rebuild. Run this command again or press Escape to stop; Go to end jumps immediately.
简体中文: 逐个播放剩余特征，每次重建后暂停半秒。再次运行此命令或按Escape停止；转到末尾会立即跳转。

English (原文): Turns the view to a standard direction such as front, top or iso, or to a saved named view. Use it to look at the model from a fixed angle.
简体中文: 将视图转到前视、俯视、等轴测等标准方向，或转到已保存的命名视图。用于从固定角度观察模型。

English (原文): Deletes a saved named view. The model is not changed.
简体中文: 删除已保存的命名视图。模型不会改变。

English (原文): Zooms and pans so the whole model, or the selection, fills the view. Use it when the model has gone out of sight.
简体中文: 缩放并平移，使整个模型或所选对象充满视图。用于模型跑出视野时。

English (原文): Shows or hides the grid in the viewport. Use it as a size and orientation guide while modeling.
简体中文: 显示或隐藏视口中的网格。用作建模时的尺寸和方向参考。

English (原文): Shows or hides the model's shadow on the ground. Use it to judge height and position more easily.
简体中文: 显示或隐藏模型在地面上的阴影。用于更容易判断高度和位置。

English (原文): Turns the view back to the home direction and fits the model. Use it to get back to a known view quickly.
简体中文: 将视图转回主视图方向并适合模型。用于快速回到已知的视图。

English (原文): Lists the named views saved in the design. Use it to find a view you saved earlier.
简体中文: 列出设计中保存的命名视图。用于找到之前保存的视图。

English (原文): Turns, pans or zooms the view by steps, such as a quarter turn left. Use it to move the camera precisely instead of dragging.
简体中文: 按步骤旋转、平移或缩放视图，例如向左转四分之一圈。用于精确移动相机，而不是靠拖动。

English (原文): Shows or hides the navigation bar at the bottom of the viewport. Hide it for more room, show it to reach the view tools by mouse.
简体中文: 显示或隐藏视口底部的导航栏。隐藏可腾出空间，显示便于用鼠标使用视图工具。

English (原文): Gives a saved named view a new name. The view itself stays the same.
简体中文: 为已保存的命名视图改名。视图本身保持不变。

English (原文): Folds the ribbon to its tab row, so the view gets the room its panels took. Click a tab to show its panels over the view; choose this again to keep the whole ribbon shown.
简体中文: 将功能区折叠为选项卡行，让视图得到面板原先占用的空间。单击选项卡可在视图上方显示其面板；再次选择此命令则始终显示完整的功能区。

English (原文): Saves the current camera position as a named view in the design. Use it to come back to the same angle later, for example for screenshots.
简体中文: 将当前相机位置作为命名视图保存到设计中。用于以后回到同一角度，例如截图。

English (原文): Orbits the view around the model continuously until the next click or key. Use it to present a model from all sides.
简体中文: 让视图持续绕模型环绕，直到下一次点击或按键。用于从各个方向展示模型。

English (原文): Latches a camera tool, orbit, pan or zoom, so that dragging with the left mouse button moves the view until you switch it off. Use it on a trackpad or without a middle mouse button.
简体中文: 锁定一个相机工具（环绕、平移或缩放），之后用鼠标左键拖动即可移动视图，直到关闭。用于触控板或没有鼠标中键时。

English (原文): Switches how the model is drawn: shaded with or without edges, wireframe, or with hidden edges. Use wireframe to see inside, shaded for a clean look.
简体中文: 切换模型的绘制方式：带边或不带边的着色、线框，或带隐藏边。用线框看内部，用着色得到干净的外观。

English (原文): ISO 273 clearance hole for {size}, {fit} fit: {diameter} mm. Type another diameter to use it instead.
简体中文: {size} 的 ISO 273 通孔，{fit}配合：{diameter} mm。输入其他直径即改用该值。

English (原文): Changes apply to the {count} holes in {folder}; each keeps its place.
简体中文: 更改将应用于 {folder} 中的 {count} 个孔；每个孔保持原位置。

English (原文): Delete this personal preset? Existing holes are unchanged.
简体中文: 删除此个人预设？现有孔不会改变。

English (原文): The personal library already contains 64 presets.
Enter a short name without line breaks or control characters.
简体中文: 请输入不含换行符或控制字符的简短名称。

English (原文): Complete the hole parameters using valid expressions of reasonable length.
简体中文: 请使用长度适当的有效表达式填写孔参数。

English (原文): The selected preset is no longer available.
A preset with this name already exists. Use a different name.
简体中文: 同名预设已存在，请使用其他名称。
保存对所选预设的修改

English (原文): Saved in your profile for all projects.
简体中文: 保存在您的配置中，适用于所有项目。

English (原文): This preset uses thread options that this version cannot recall.
简体中文: 此预设使用了当前版本无法调用的螺纹选项。

English (原文): This preset contains options that cannot be overwritten safely.
简体中文: 此预设包含无法安全覆盖的选项。

English (原文): Choose a format for the current design.
简体中文: 为当前设计选择一种格式。
