简体中文: 将 STEP、IGES 或网格导入新设计
英寸 · 在设计工作区中打开
毫米 · 在设计工作区中打开

English (原文): Designs you open or save appear here.
简体中文: 您打开或保存的设计将显示在这里。

English (原文): SolidCraft closed before these designs were saved.
简体中文: SolidCraft 在这些设计保存前已关闭。

English (原文): Create a design, open a recent file, or explore a sample.
简体中文: 创建设计、打开最近的文件或浏览示例。

English (原文): There was 1 other problem with the file.
简体中文: 文件还有 1 个其他问题。

English (原文): There were {count} other problems with the file.
简体中文: 文件还有 {count} 个其他问题。

English (原文): Exporting these parts again from the program that made them may fix this. Copy Warning Message has the details.
简体中文: 从创建这些零件的程序重新导出可能会解决此问题。“复制警告消息”中有详细信息。

English (原文): 1 face couldn't be repaired and is missing.
{count} faces couldn't be repaired and are missing.
1 part needs repair before it can be modeled on.
简体中文: 1 个零件需要修复后才能建模。

English (原文): {count} parts need repair before they can be modeled on.
简体中文: {count} 个零件需要修复后才能建模。

English (原文): 1 face couldn't be drawn and is hidden.
{count} faces couldn't be drawn and are hidden.
Everything in the file was carried over.
简体中文: 文件中的所有内容均已导入。

English (原文): 1 part has gaps between its faces and came in as an open body.
简体中文: 1 个零件的面之间有缝隙，作为开放实体导入。

English (原文): {count} parts have gaps between their faces and came in as open bodies.
简体中文: {count} 个零件的面之间有缝隙，作为开放实体导入。

English (原文): 1 part couldn't be made into a solid and was not imported.
简体中文: 1 个零件无法生成实体，未导入。

English (原文): {count} parts couldn't be made into solids and were not imported.
简体中文: {count} 个零件无法生成实体，未导入。

English (原文): Small flaws were repaired in 1 part.
简体中文: 已修复 1 个零件中的小缺陷。

English (原文): Small flaws were repaired in {count} parts.
简体中文: 已修复 {count} 个零件中的小缺陷。
{parts} 个零件中有 {solids} 个作为实体导入。

English (原文): 1 part couldn't be made into a solid and came in as surfaces.
简体中文: 1 个零件无法生成实体，作为曲面导入。

English (原文): {count} parts couldn't be made into solids and came in as surfaces.
简体中文: {count} 个零件无法生成实体，作为曲面导入。

English (原文): The share of the chord that the position places and the angle turns about: 0 is the leading edge, 0.25 the quarter chord, 1 the trailing edge.
简体中文: 位置所放置、角度所围绕旋转的弦长份额：0 为前缘，0.25 为四分之一弦，1 为后缘。

English (原文): Install SolidCraft as an app: it opens in its own window and works offline
简体中文: 将 SolidCraft 安装为应用：在独立窗口中打开，离线也能使用
选择“文件”›“添加到程序坞”。

English (原文): SolidCraft then opens in its own window from the Dock, and works offline.
简体中文: 之后 SolidCraft 从程序坞在独立窗口中打开，离线也能使用。

English (原文): Tap Share (in the … menu if it isn't on the toolbar).
简体中文: 轻点“共享”（若不在工具栏上，则在 … 菜单中）。

English (原文): SolidCraft then opens from its icon on the Home Screen, without Safari's toolbars, and works offline.
简体中文: 之后 SolidCraft 从主屏幕上的图标打开，不显示 Safari 的工具栏，离线也能使用。

English (原文): Safari installs web apps from its own menus:
简体中文: Safari 通过自身的菜单安装网页应用：

English (原文): Settings or model changed while waiting for the preview. Retake the screenshot to update the technical details for the current view.
简体中文: 等待预览时设置或模型已更改。重新截图即可按当前视图更新技术详情。

English (原文): Screenshot captured locally. Your edited technical details were kept: check that they still match the current view.
简体中文: 已在本地截图。已保留你编辑过的技术详情：请检查它们是否仍与当前视图一致。

English (原文): Technical details updated to match the current view. Screenshot captured locally. Review it before attaching it on GitHub.
简体中文: 技术详情已按当前视图更新。已在本地截图。附加到 GitHub 之前请先检查。

English (原文): Paste the image into the GitHub draft, or save the PNG if image copying is unavailable.
简体中文: 请将图片粘贴到 GitHub 草稿中。如果无法复制图片，请保存 PNG。

English (原文): Review the GitHub draft and attach the screenshot. GitHub's Submit new issue button publishes it.
简体中文: 请检查 GitHub 草稿并附上截图。点击 GitHub 的 Submit new issue 按钮即可发布。

English (原文): Report copied. Paste into the GitHub draft, attach the screenshot, then click Submit new issue on GitHub.
简体中文: 报告已复制。请粘贴到 GitHub 草稿中，附上截图，然后在 GitHub 上点击 Submit new issue。
已从此草稿中移除截图。

English (原文): Report copied. Paste it into the GitHub draft if needed.
简体中文: 报告已复制。如有需要，请将其粘贴到 GitHub 草稿中。

English (原文): Screenshot saved. Attach the PNG in the GitHub draft.
简体中文: 截图已保存。请在 GitHub 草稿中附上 PNG。

English (原文): Several joints are named `{name}`. Use a numeric joint ID: {ids}.
简体中文: 多个接头名为 `{name}`。请使用数字接头 ID：{ids}。

English (原文): joint limit minimum must not exceed maximum
简体中文: 接头的下限不得大于上限

English (原文): The search for the limits stopped with an error
Fill in the limits from where the parts this joint moves first touch another part, turning or sliding each way from where it is now. It runs on a copy: nothing changes until OK.
简体中文: 根据此接头移动的零件首次接触其他零件的位置填写限制，从当前位置向两个方向旋转或滑动。在副本上进行：按“确定”前不会更改任何内容。

English (原文): The joint or the design has changed since these limits were found: find them again
简体中文: 找到这些限制后接头或设计已更改：请重新查找

English (原文): Each picked body moves into a new component of its own and stays where it is.
简体中文: 每个所选实体移入各自的新组件，位置保持不变。

English (原文): {side} {value}: the limit of another value or joint
{side} {value}: a closed loop cannot close past it
{side}: no contact within {range}, left as it was
Already in each other here: {pairs}. They stop the search only if they go deeper.
简体中文: 此处已相互重叠：{pairs}。只有更深入时才会停止查找。

English (原文): Both picks are on {body}. Pick the second one on another part.
简体中文: 两次选择都在 {body} 上。请在另一个零件上选择第二个。

English (原文): These parts are bodies of one component: {bodies}. A joint moves one component against another, so each part needs a component of its own.
简体中文: 这些零件是同一组件的实体：{bodies}。接头使一个组件相对另一个组件运动，因此每个零件都需要自己的组件。

English (原文): These {count} bodies are all in one component (or in the design itself): use {command} first.
简体中文: 这 {count} 个实体都位于同一组件中（或直接位于设计中）：请先使用“{command}”。
请选择两个或更多组件。
取消固定 {occurrence} 后的接头问题：{joint}：{reason}

English (原文): Check the joint type (such as Rigid), grounding, joint limits, and parameter-driven values.
简体中文: 请检查关节类型（例如 Rigid）、固定状态、关节限位和参数驱动值。

English (原文): A joint of this part conflicts with the others: {joint}.
简体中文: 此零部件的一个关节与其他关节冲突：{joint}。

English (原文): Edit, suppress or delete the conflicting joint so the other joints can place the part.
简体中文: 请编辑、抑制或删除冲突的关节，以便其他关节可以放置该零部件。

English (原文): This part has no movable joint axis.
简体中文: 此零部件没有可操作的关节自由度。

English (原文): Move — drag an arrow or ring. Esc cancels the current drag.
简体中文: 移动 — 拖动箭头或圆弧。按 Esc 取消当前拖动。
关闭：使用原来的移动面板。

English (原文): Pull outside the dashed guide for the fine step.
简体中文: 拉到虚线引导线外可使用精细步长。

English (原文): Select a face or one assembly part, then choose Move.
简体中文: 请选择一个面或一个装配零部件，然后执行移动。

English (原文): Use joint motion handles for Move
简体中文: 移动时使用关节运动控制柄
受包含点 ({x}, {y}, {z}) 的面限制

English (原文): Close designs using this file before renaming, moving, or trashing it
简体中文: 重命名、移动或移至回收站前，请关闭使用此文件的设计。

English (原文): This file will go to the system Trash, where you can restore it.
简体中文: 此文件将移至系统回收站，您可以从那里恢复它。

English (原文): No designs or project folders here yet. Save designs into this folder, then Refresh.
简体中文: 这里还没有设计或项目文件夹。请将设计保存到此文件夹后刷新。

English (原文): Folder unavailable: {error}. Return Home or try Refresh.
简体中文: 文件夹不可用：{error}。请返回根文件夹或刷新。

English (原文): Highlight limit reached. Clear an existing highlight first.
简体中文: 已达到高亮数量上限。请先清除现有高亮。

English (原文): Enter a filename without directory separators.
简体中文: 请输入不含目录分隔符的文件名。

English (原文): This folder has more than 10,000 items. Organize it into smaller project folders to see everything.
简体中文: 此文件夹包含超过 10,000 个项目。请将其整理到较小的项目文件夹中以显示全部内容。
没有匹配的设计或文件夹。

English (原文): This filename cannot be opened. Rename it to a valid UTF-8 filename and try again.
简体中文: 无法打开此文件。请将其重命名为有效的 UTF-8 文件名后重试。

English (原文): This folder is outside your document library. Return Home.
简体中文: 此文件夹位于文档库之外。请返回根文件夹。

English (原文): Some items could not be read. Try Refresh.
简体中文: 部分项目无法读取。请刷新。

English (原文): Some items could not be read. Check folder permissions and try Refresh.
简体中文: 部分项目无法读取。请检查文件夹权限并刷新。

English (原文): Cannot read this folder: {error}. Check its permissions or choose another folder.
简体中文: 无法读取此文件夹：{error}。请检查权限或选择其他文件夹。
最近的 CAD 文件夹

English (原文): Document folder unavailable: {error}. Reconnect it or choose another folder.
简体中文: 文档文件夹不可用：{error}。请重新连接或选择其他文件夹。

English (原文): Sample designs only. Use the gear above to choose your CAD folder.
简体中文: 仅显示示例设计。请使用上方的齿轮按钮选择 CAD 文件夹。

English (原文): Could not scan this folder: {error}. Try Refresh.
简体中文: 无法扫描此文件夹：{error}。请刷新。

English (原文): Folder scan stopped. Try Refresh or choose the folder again.
简体中文: 文件夹扫描已停止。请刷新或重新选择文件夹。

English (原文): Show the document browser beside open designs. You can also show or hide it from the app bar.
简体中文: 在已打开的设计旁显示文档浏览器。您也可以通过应用栏显示或隐藏它。

English (原文): Choose the thumbnail and document browser size. Smaller sizes leave more room for the design.
简体中文: 选择缩略图和文档浏览器的大小。较小尺寸可为设计留出更多空间。

English (原文): This filename is not valid UTF-8.
简体中文: 此文件名不是有效的 UTF-8。

English (原文): Could not start the file operation: {error}
The file operation stopped unexpectedly. Refresh the folder to check its contents.
简体中文: 文件操作意外停止。请刷新文件夹以检查其内容。

English (原文): This design uses files from {folders}. Load them?
简体中文: 此设计使用了 {folders} 中的文件。要加载吗？
其他文件夹中的链接文件

English (原文): Hide the Discord button (turn it back on in Preferences, General)
简体中文: 隐藏 Discord 按钮（可在偏好设置的“常规”中重新打开）

English (原文): Join the SolidCraft Discord (opens in your browser)
简体中文: 加入 SolidCraft 的 Discord（在浏览器中打开）

English (原文): Hide the Donate button (turn it back on in Preferences, General)
简体中文: 隐藏捐赠按钮（可在偏好设置的“常规”中重新打开）
在 Ko-fi 上支持 SolidCraft…

English (原文): Support SolidCraft on Ko-fi (opens ko-fi.com in your browser)
简体中文: 在 Ko-fi 上支持 SolidCraft（在浏览器中打开）

English (原文): Choose a look for the selection, or drag a swatch onto a body or face.
简体中文: 为所选对象选择外观，或将色样拖到实体或面上。

English (原文): Select bodies and choose their plastic design rule.
简体中文: 选择实体并指定其塑料设计规则。

English (原文): Edit configuration rows, columns and rules, then activate or preview a row.
简体中文: 编辑配置行、列和规则，然后激活或预览某一行。

English (原文): Select bodies and choose their physical material.
简体中文: 选择实体并指定其物理材质。

English (原文): Edit expressions and units. Changes apply on Enter or when leaving a field.
简体中文: 编辑表达式和单位。按 Enter 或离开字段时应用更改。

English (原文): Choose a rule to edit, or create a new rule. Confirm to save the rule.
简体中文: 选择要编辑的规则，或创建新规则。确认以保存规则。

English (原文): Assigned density must be above 0 and at most 1000 g/cm³.
简体中文: 指定密度必须大于 0 且不超过 1000 g/cm³。
请输入 1–128 个字符的名称。

English (原文): Save or discard the material draft before assigning a material.
简体中文: 指定材料前，请保存或放弃材料草稿。

English (原文): Material saved. Body assignments are unchanged.
简体中文: 材料已保存。实体的材料指定未变。

English (原文): Save stores this material without assigning it to bodies. Blank properties and conditions remain unknown. Card density does not change assigned density or mass.
简体中文: 保存材料不会将其指定给实体。空白属性和条件仍为未知。属性卡密度不会改变指定密度或质量。

English (原文): This material changed while the draft was open. Discard and reopen it before saving.
简体中文: 草稿打开期间材料已改变。请放弃并重新打开后再保存。

English (原文): Engineering properties are unknown. Save may keep only the assigned density and existing appearance.
简体中文: 工程属性未知。可以只保存指定密度和现有外观。

English (原文): Click for all messages of this session
简体中文: 点击查看本次会话的所有消息

English (原文): Checked to step {step} only: the check ran out of its work budget
简体中文: 仅检查到第 {step} 步：检查已用完其工作量上限

English (原文): Several motion studies are named `{name}`. Use a numeric motion study ID: {ids}.
简体中文: 多个运动研究名为 `{name}`。请使用数字运动研究 ID：{ids}。

English (原文): Add a key at this step with the joint's value now
简体中文: 在此步骤添加关键帧，使用关节的当前值
在此处松开以打开窗口

English (原文): A window keeps at least one view
简体中文: 每个窗口至少保留一个视图

English (原文): Could not open a window. The views are in {design}
简体中文: 无法打开窗口。视图位于 {design} 中

English (原文): A design can have up to 8 windows
简体中文: 每个设计最多可打开 8 个窗口

English (原文): Shift+Alt+left drag orbits, Shift+Alt+middle pans, Shift+Alt+right zooms; middle drag also pans and right drag orbits
简体中文: Shift+Alt+左键拖动旋转，Shift+Alt+中键拖动平移，Shift+Alt+右键拖动缩放；中键拖动也可平移，右键拖动旋转

English (原文): Middle drag orbits, Shift+middle pans, Ctrl+middle zooms; right drag leaves the camera alone
简体中文: 中键拖动旋转，Shift+中键拖动平移，Ctrl+中键拖动缩放；右键拖动不会移动相机

English (原文): What dragging each mouse button does, with an optional key held. A side button still goes Back when you click it.
简体中文: 拖动每个鼠标按键时的操作,可同时按住一个键。点击侧键仍然是后退。

English (原文): Middle drag orbits, Shift+middle pans, Ctrl+middle drag vertically zooms (down to zoom in); scroll the wheel to zoom
简体中文: 中键拖动旋转，Shift+中键平移，Ctrl+中键上下拖动缩放（向下放大）；滚动滚轮也可缩放

English (原文): A middle or right drag goes on orbiting, panning or zooming as it began until the button is released, whatever keys are pressed or let go meanwhile. Off: the keys held decide at every moment of the drag.
简体中文: 中键或右键拖动会保持开始时的旋转、平移或缩放，直到松开按键，期间按下或松开任何键都不会改变。关闭后：拖动的每一刻都由当时按住的键决定。

English (原文): A drag keeps the navigation it started with
简体中文: 拖动保持开始时的导航方式

English (原文): Mouse and 3D mouse rotate through both poles and preserve roll. Shift axis snapping is disabled.
简体中文: 鼠标和3D鼠标可保持滚转并越过两个极点旋转。Shift轴吸附将被禁用。

English (原文): Mouse and 3D mouse rotate through both poles and preserve roll. Hold Shift during an orbit drag to snap the view direction and roll.
简体中文: 鼠标和3D鼠标可越过两极旋转，并保留画面旋转角度。在拖动环绕时按住Shift，可吸附视图方向和画面旋转角度。

English (原文): Sideways mouse drags spin the model around the world's vertical axis; up and down drags tilt over the top without a limit.
简体中文: 左右拖动鼠标时模型绕世界竖直轴旋转；上下拖动可不受限制地越过顶部倾斜。

English (原文): Middle drag pans, Shift+middle orbits, right drag orbits
简体中文: 中键拖动平移，Shift+中键拖动旋转，右键拖动旋转

English (原文): Alt+left drag pans, Shift+Alt+left zooms, Ctrl+left drag on empty space orbits
简体中文: Alt+左键拖动平移，Shift+Alt+左键拖动缩放，在空白处 Ctrl+左键拖动旋转

English (原文): Middle drag pans, Shift+middle orbits, Ctrl+middle zooms, right drag orbits
简体中文: 中键拖动平移，Shift+中键拖动旋转，Ctrl+中键拖动缩放，右键拖动旋转

English (原文): While an orbit turns about the origin or the point under the cursor, a small dot marks the point the view turns about. Off: nothing is drawn.
简体中文: 围绕原点或光标下的点旋转时，用一个小圆点标出视图所绕的点。关闭后不绘制任何内容。

English (原文): Alt+left drag orbits, Alt+middle pans, Alt+right zooms; middle drag also pans
简体中文: Alt+左键拖动旋转，Alt+中键拖动平移，Alt+右键拖动缩放；中键拖动也可平移

English (原文): Alt+right drag: right zooms in, left zooms out. Turn off to restore vertical drag zoom.
简体中文: Alt+右键拖动：向右放大，向左缩小。关闭此选项可恢复垂直拖动缩放。

English (原文): Middle drag orbits, Shift+middle pans (NX's middle + right), Ctrl+middle zooms (NX's middle + left); right drag leaves the camera
简体中文: 中键拖动旋转，Shift+中键平移（对应 NX 的中键+右键），Ctrl+中键缩放（对应 NX 的中键+左键）；右键拖动不旋转视图

English (原文): Left drag on empty space orbits, Shift+left drag box-selects, sketch geometry drags edit; right or middle drag pans, Shift+right or Shift+middle drag zooms
简体中文: 在空白处左键拖动旋转，Shift+左键拖动框选，拖动草图几何可编辑；右键或中键拖动平移，Shift+右键或 Shift+中键拖动缩放

English (原文): An orbit drag that reaches the edge of the view moves the cursor to the opposite edge and keeps turning. Off: the drag stops at the edge of the screen. Has no effect on Wayland or in the browser.
简体中文: 旋转拖动到达视图边缘时，光标移到对侧边缘并继续旋转。关闭时，拖动在屏幕边缘停止。在 Wayland 和浏览器中无效。

English (原文): Sketch editing uses orthographic view. Finish the sketch to switch perspective.
简体中文: 编辑草图时使用正交视图。完成草图后才能切换透视。

English (原文): Off: a right drag leaves the camera alone and the right button only opens the context menu. Picking the SolidWorks mouse mapping turns it off.
简体中文: 关闭：右键拖动不会移动相机，右键只打开上下文菜单。选择 SolidWorks 鼠标映射时会关闭此项。

English (原文): Middle drag orbits, Ctrl+middle pans, Shift+middle zooms, right drag orbits
简体中文: 中键拖动旋转，Ctrl+中键拖动平移，Shift+中键拖动缩放，右键拖动旋转

English (原文): Right drag orbits, middle or Shift+right drag pans
简体中文: 右键拖动旋转，中键或 Shift+右键拖动平移

English (原文): Hold Shift and move the pointer to pan; hold Alt/Option and move it to orbit. No mouse button is needed. Vertical scroll zooms.
简体中文: 按住 Shift 并移动指针可平移；按住 Alt/Option 并移动可旋转。无需按鼠标按钮。垂直滚动可缩放。

English (原文): Orbit (hold Alt/Option and move; no mouse button)
简体中文: 旋转（按住 Alt/Option 并移动，无需鼠标按钮）

English (原文): Pan (hold Shift and move; no mouse button)
简体中文: 平移（按住 Shift 并移动，无需鼠标按钮）

English (原文): Touchpad uses vertical scroll to zoom. Your two-finger pan setting is kept for other presets.
简体中文: 触控板使用垂直滚动进行缩放。双指平移设置将保留供其他预设使用。
缩放（垂直滚动或双指捏合）

English (原文): Drag one finger to orbit, two fingers to pan, and pinch to zoom. Turn off to use the mouse mapping for finger drags.
简体中文: 单指拖动可旋转视图，双指拖动可平移，捏合或张开双指可缩放。关闭后，手指拖动将使用鼠标操作映射。

English (原文): When the view is rolled (Look At on a tilted sketch, or the view cube's turn arrows), orbiting stands it upright again as you drag, and the model turns the way the pointer goes. Off: a rolled view keeps its roll while you orbit, so an upside-down view stays upside down.
简体中文: 当视图绕视线方向倾斜时（正视倾斜平面上的草图，或使用视图立方体的旋转箭头），环绕时视图会在拖动中恢复正立，模型随指针方向转动。关闭：倾斜的视图在环绕时保持倾斜，倒置的视图保持倒置。

English (原文): Orbiting stands a rolled view upright
简体中文: 环绕时将倾斜的视图恢复正立

English (原文): {available} · drag onto the bar, or press Add
This slot is already on the bar.
Remove a slot to add another.
简体中文: 请先移除一个槽位以添加其他槽位。

English (原文): Choose the controls on the bar at the bottom of the 3D view, and in what order. Drag a slot to move it, or drag it off the bar to remove it.
简体中文: 选择3D视图底部导航栏中的控件及其顺序。拖动槽位可移动，拖出栏外可移除。

English (原文): No slot selected. Select a slot on the bar to move it, remove it or change how it looks.
简体中文: 未选择槽位。选择栏上的槽位即可移动、移除或更改其外观。

English (原文): A divider between groups of buttons. Drag it onto the bar, or press Add; use as many as you like.
简体中文: 按钮组之间的分隔线。将其拖到栏上，或按“添加”；可以按需使用任意数量。

English (原文): The bar already has four separators.
The bar changed. Select the slot again.
简体中文: 导航栏已更改。请重新选择槽位。

English (原文): Darkens creases and corners to add depth.
简体中文: 加深凹槽和角落的阴影，增加深度感。

English (原文): Holds the view settings: graphics preset, grid, ground shadow, ambient occlusion and projection.
简体中文: 设置图形预设、网格、地面阴影、环境光遮蔽和投影。

English (原文): Frames the selection, or the whole model if nothing is selected.
简体中文: 完整显示所选对象；未选择时显示整个模型。

English (原文): Shows or hides the ground grid.
Shows or hides the shadow under the model.
简体中文: 显示或隐藏模型下方的阴影。

English (原文): Returns to the isometric view of the whole model.
简体中文: 返回显示整个模型的等轴测视图。

English (原文): Turns the view to face the selected face, plane or open sketch.
简体中文: 使视图正对所选面、平面或打开的草图。

English (原文): Turns the view around the model.
Slides the view sideways, up or down.
简体中文: 向左右或上下平移视图。

English (原文): Switches between orthographic and perspective views.
简体中文: 切换正交视图和透视视图。

English (原文): Chooses what a click picks: faces and edges, bodies, features, parts, components or sketch geometry.
简体中文: 切换单击时选取的对象：面和边、实体、特征、零件、组件或草图几何。

English (原文): A thin line that groups neighboring slots.
简体中文: 用于分组相邻槽位的细分隔线。

English (原文): Displays the drawing zoom and opens Fit sheet and Actual size.
简体中文: 显示图纸缩放比例，并打开适合图纸和实际尺寸选项。

English (原文): Keeps the view turning until you click or press a key.
简体中文: 持续旋转视图，直到点击或按键停止。

English (原文): Switches how the model is drawn: shaded, wireframe or with hidden edges.
简体中文: 切换着色、线框或带隐藏边线等模型绘制方式。

English (原文): Moves the view closer to or further from the model.
简体中文: 将视图拉近或远离模型。

English (原文): This design links to a file on network location {host}. Opening it connects to that computer and may send your Windows sign-in to it. Only allow servers you trust.
简体中文: 此设计链接到网络位置 {host} 上的文件。打开它会连接到该计算机，并可能向其发送你的 Windows 登录信息。只允许你信任的服务器。

message id: not supported yet: rotating a member inside a component
English (原文): not supported yet: rotating a member inside a component
简体中文: 尚不支持:旋转零部件内的构件
已取消 {count} 个等待中的命令

English (原文): Apply each change as you leave its field
简体中文: 离开字段时立即应用每项更改

English (原文): Off: changes wait until Apply or OK, then the design rebuilds once for all of them. Cancel or Escape drops them.
简体中文: 关闭时：更改会等到“应用”或“确定”，然后设计只为所有更改重建一次。“取消”或 Esc 会放弃这些更改。

English (原文): A pasted row needs a name and an expression to become a parameter
简体中文: 粘贴的行需要名称和表达式才能成为参数

English (原文): “{unit}” is not one of the units
Edit expressions and units. Changes wait for Apply or OK.
简体中文: 编辑表达式和单位。更改将等到“应用”或“确定”时生效。

English (原文): Hex socket set screw, flat point
Hex socket set screw, flat point
Large plain washer, product grade A
pick one or more holes to seat a part in each, or OK places it at the origin
简体中文: 选择一个或多个孔，在每个孔中各装一个零件；或按确定将其放在原点

English (原文): Counts include the original. Center balances copies; Flip chooses the extra side for even totals.
简体中文: 数量包含原始图形。居中时副本分布在两侧；数量为偶数时，反转可切换多一个副本的一侧。

English (原文): These bodies make up a whole component. Patterning the component places it again instead of copying every body: much faster, with far less memory.
简体中文: 这些实体构成一个完整组件。阵列该组件会重新放置它，而不是复制每个实体：速度快得多，内存也少得多。

English (原文): These bodies make up {count} whole components. Patterning the components places them again instead of copying every body: much faster, with far less memory.
简体中文: 这些实体构成 {count} 个完整组件。阵列这些组件会重新放置它们，而不是复制每个实体：速度快得多，内存也少得多。

English (原文): Click for details: frame-time graph, histogram and what the GPU drew
简体中文: 点击查看详情:帧耗时图、直方图和 GPU 绘制的内容

English (原文): pick a body or some of its faces
简体中文: 请选择一个实体或它的若干个面

message id: pick a hole to seat it, or OK places it at the origin
English (原文): pick a hole to seat it, or OK places it at the origin
简体中文: 选择一个孔放置，或单击确定放置在原点

message id: pick a plane or a face as the tool
English (原文): pick a plane or a face as the tool
简体中文: 请选择一个平面或一个面作为工具
请选择同一个实体的边

message id: pick edges of the holes to remove
English (原文): pick edges of the holes to remove
简体中文: 请选择要移除的孔的边
请选择同一个实体的面
请选择同一个草图的直线

message id: pick one or two vertices, edges or faces
English (原文): pick one or two vertices, edges or faces
简体中文: 选择一个或两个顶点、边或面

message id: pick one plane or face as the tool, or sketch curves
English (原文): pick one plane or face as the tool, or sketch curves
简体中文: 请选择一个平面或一个面作为工具，或选择草图曲线

message id: pick sections in two or more sketches
English (原文): pick sections in two or more sketches
简体中文: 请选择位于两个或更多草图中的截面
请选择要取消修剪的面

message id: pick what to keep of the other surface
English (原文): pick what to keep of the other surface
简体中文: 请选择另一个曲面上要保留的部分

English (原文): Contains {name} data. Turn the plugin on in Preferences › Plugins to edit it.
简体中文: 包含 {name} 的数据。请在 偏好设置 › 插件 中启用该插件以进行编辑。

English (原文): Contains {name} data (plugin {version}). Install it to edit.
简体中文: 包含 {name} 的数据（插件 {version}）。安装后即可编辑。

English (原文): Contains {name} data. Install the plugin to edit it.
简体中文: 包含 {name} 的数据。安装该插件后即可编辑。

English (原文): Contains {name} data from a newer version of the plugin ({version}). It's kept as it is; update the plugin to edit it.
简体中文: 包含由更新版本插件（{version}）保存的 {name} 数据。数据会原样保留；更新插件后即可编辑。

English (原文): the design it made is larger than {allowed} MiB, the most a plugin can hand over.
简体中文: 它生成的设计大于 {allowed} MiB，这是插件可交回的上限。

English (原文): it asks for {requested} fuel, and plugins may use {allowed}. Install the plugin again and allow its fuel request, or raise Max plugin fuel in Preferences › Plugins (in solidcraft-cli, max_fuel in the --plugin-limits file).
简体中文: 它请求 {requested} fuel，而插件最多可用 {allowed}。请重新安装插件并允许其 fuel 请求，或在“偏好设置 › 插件”中提高“插件fuel许可上限”（solidcraft-cli 中为 --plugin-limits 文件里的 max_fuel）。

English (原文): it asks for {requested} MiB of memory, and plugins may use {allowed} MiB. Install the plugin again and allow its memory request, or raise Max plugin memory (MiB) in Preferences › Plugins (in solidcraft-cli, max_memory_mib in the --plugin-limits file).
简体中文: 它请求 {requested} MiB 内存，而插件最多可用 {allowed} MiB。请重新安装该插件并允许其内存请求，或在“偏好设置 › 插件”中提高“插件内存许可上限（MiB）”（solidcraft-cli 中为 --plugin-limits 文件里的 max_memory_mib）。

English (原文): it used all {allowed} fuel it asks for and was stopped. Ask its author to raise its fuel limit.
简体中文: 它用完了所请求的全部 fuel（{allowed}），已被停止。请让作者提高其 fuel 上限。

English (原文): it needed more than the {allowed} MiB of memory it asks for and was stopped. Ask its author to raise its memory limit.
简体中文: 它需要的内存超过所请求的 {allowed} MiB，已被停止。请让作者提高其内存上限。

English (原文): it ran out of its {allowed} KiB stack and was stopped. Ask its author to raise its stack size.
简体中文: 它用完了 {allowed} KiB 的栈，已被停止。请让作者增大其栈大小。

English (原文): it ran longer than its time limit of {seconds} s and was stopped. Ask its author to raise its time limit.
简体中文: 它的运行时间超过了 {seconds} 秒的时限，已被停止。请让作者延长其时限。

English (原文): the design changed since this edit was calculated (expected {expected}; current {actual}). Run the calculation again.
简体中文: 计算此编辑后，设计已更改（预期 {expected}；当前 {actual}）。请重新计算。

English (原文): it stopped on an error inside the plugin ({reason}). Report this to its author.
简体中文: 它因插件内部错误而停止（{reason}）。请报告给作者。

English (原文): Nothing beyond changing the open design.
简体中文: 除修改打开的设计外，不请求任何权限。
使用 1 个 SolidCraft 命令
使用 {count} 个 SolidCraft 命令

English (原文): Read files in the folder you choose for “{name}”
简体中文: 读取你为“{name}”选择的文件夹中的文件

English (原文): Read and write files in the folder you choose for “{name}”
简体中文: 读写你为“{name}”选择的文件夹中的文件

English (原文): Reading the other files in the folder of a file it opens (an assembly's parts)
简体中文: 读取所打开文件所在文件夹中的其他文件（装配体的零件）

English (原文): Up to {memory} MiB of memory. Plugins get {limit} MiB unless you allow more.
简体中文: 最多 {memory} MiB 内存。除非您允许更多，插件只能使用 {limit} MiB。
将 {extensions} 文件作为新设计打开

English (原文): Writing {extensions} files from the open design
简体中文: 从打开的设计写入 {extensions} 文件

English (原文): Your organization manages some SolidCraft settings on this computer.
简体中文: 你的组织管理此计算机上的部分 SolidCraft 设置。

English (原文): Your organization turned off update checks on this computer.
简体中文: 您的组织已在此计算机上关闭更新检查。

English (原文): Alt / Option also frees manipulator arrows
简体中文: Alt / Option 也可自由拖动操纵器箭头

English (原文): Anti-aliasing uses 1× because the startup check drew nothing with multisampling and passed at 1×. You can choose another setting above; restart to apply it if the check passes.
简体中文: 由于启动检查在启用多重采样时未绘制任何内容，而在1×时通过了检查，抗锯齿已设为1×。您可以在上方选择其他设置；重启后若检查通过，该设置将生效。

English (原文): Changes the colors that carry a meaning: sketch states, axes, bends, analyses and icons.
简体中文: 更改具有含义的颜色：草图状态、坐标轴、折弯、分析和图标。

English (原文): Reloads when another tool rewrites the file.
简体中文: 其他工具重写文件时重新加载。

English (原文): Look At sketches move the view with the pointer.
简体中文: 草图的Look At操作会使视图随指针移动。

English (原文): Join, New Body or Cut, from what the material touches.
简体中文: 根据材料接触的对象选择合并、新建实体或切割。

English (原文): Could not read the background picture
Relative rendering cost. More bars usually mean more work.
简体中文: 相对渲染开销。条形越多，通常意味着处理工作越多。

English (原文): Unavailable on this graphics device or rendering path
简体中文: 此图形设备或渲染路径不支持此功能

English (原文): Blur quality was reduced to keep frames responsive. The radius is unchanged.
简体中文: 已降低模糊质量，以保持画面响应。模糊半径未改变。

English (原文): Disabled by the system's Reduce transparency setting
简体中文: 已被系统的降低透明度设置禁用
软件图形渲染不支持此功能 (gpu-software)

English (原文): Unavailable on this web rendering path
简体中文: 此网页渲染路径不支持此功能

English (原文): Arrow keys move through the Browser while it has focus
简体中文: 浏览器获得焦点时，方向键在浏览器中移动

English (原文): Each body in the browser folds open on the timeline features that built it, in timeline order.
简体中文: 浏览器中的每个实体都可展开，按时间线顺序显示构建它的时间线特征。

English (原文): Every component in the browser starts open, as before, instead of closed until you open it.
简体中文: 浏览器中的每个组件都像以前一样初始展开，而不是在您展开前保持折叠。
折叠箭头旁的眼睛图标

English (原文): Browser rows show their show/hide eye next to the fold arrow, as before, instead of in a column at the right end of the rows.
简体中文: 浏览器各行的显示切换像以前一样位于折叠箭头旁，而不是在行右端的一列中。

English (原文): Show the Origin item under the pointer in the Browser
简体中文: 在浏览器中显示指针下的原点项目

English (原文): Hovering an Origin plane, axis or point in the Browser shows it in the view, also when it is hidden. Off: only an origin plane that is already shown lights up.
简体中文: 在浏览器中将指针悬停在原点的平面、轴或点上时，即使它已隐藏，也会在视图中显示。关闭：只有已显示的原点平面会高亮。
浏览器中的行默认折叠

English (原文): Placements and folders in the Browser start closed, so a design with many components shows its top-level rows. Each opens with its arrow, Expand All or Find in Browser, which opens just the rows down to its body and closes again the ones the last find opened. A body picked in the 3D view leaves the Browser as it is. When off, folders start open, placements start as Components start open says, and a pick in the 3D view opens the Browser down to its body, as before.
简体中文: 浏览器中的放置和文件夹默认折叠，因此包含大量组件的设计只显示顶层行。每一行可通过其箭头、“全部展开”或“在浏览器中查找”打开；“在浏览器中查找”只展开通往该实体的行，并重新折叠上次查找展开的行。在 3D 视图中选取实体不会改变浏览器。关闭时文件夹默认展开，放置按“组件初始展开”的设置显示，在 3D 视图中选取会使浏览器展开到该实体，与以前相同。

English (原文): Automatic pans with two-finger scrolling, as trackpads expect, and offers once to make the wheel zoom when it sees a smooth-scroll mouse wheel. Always zoom makes vertical scrolling zoom, including smooth mouse wheels; hold Shift or the navigation modifiers to pan. Always pan never asks.
简体中文: 自动模式按触控板的习惯用双指滚动平移视图，并在检测到平滑滚动的鼠标滚轮时，询问一次是否让滚轮缩放。始终缩放会让垂直滚动缩放，包括平滑滚动的鼠标滚轮；按住 Shift 或导航修饰键可平移。始终平移则不再询问。
已清除 {count} 个缓存的导入结果
在标签页中显示视图状态

English (原文): Distinguish focused, on-screen, hidden, and detached views in the tab strip.
简体中文: 在标签栏中区分当前、在屏幕上、隐藏以及位于其他窗口的视图。

English (原文): How large constraint glyphs and their letters or icons are drawn in a sketch. 100% is the usual size; glyphs keep this screen size at every zoom.
简体中文: 草图中约束符号及其字母或图标的绘制大小。100% 为常规大小；任意缩放比例下符号都保持此屏幕大小。

English (原文): Group Construct tools by entity type
简体中文: 按实体类型分组构造工具

English (原文): Show Planes, Axes and Points headings. Off keeps the original menu order.
简体中文: 显示平面、轴和点标题。关闭时保留原始菜单顺序。

English (原文): Construction line tools work as before: a Construction/Normal switch beside their Length value, and the Sketch Palette's Line Type icons leave them alone. Off: those icons set the tool's line type.
简体中文: 构造线工具按以前的方式工作：长度值旁边有构造/普通切换，草图面板的线型图标不会改变它们。关闭：这些图标设置工具的线型。

English (原文): Soft shading where parts come close.
简体中文: 在零件相近处添加柔和阴影。

English (原文): Context menu · hold for the radial menu
简体中文: 上下文菜单 · 按住显示环形菜单

English (原文): Reports are kept on this computer, with the design and commands that reproduce the problem.
简体中文: 报告与重现问题的设计和命令一起保存在此计算机上。
以红色显示被移除的材料

English (原文): A preview fills the material a feature removes, and the shape it replaces, with a red see-through ghost. When off, those fills are fully transparent and only their outlines are drawn.
简体中文: 预览会用红色半透明幻影填充特征所移除的材料以及被替换的形状。关闭时，这些填充完全透明，仅绘制其轮廓。

English (原文): Keep the shape of dark parts
Shade the view in linear light with a soft sky fill, so dark faces keep a gradient instead of turning black
简体中文: 以线性光照和柔和的天空补光着色视图，使深色面保留渐变而不变成一片黑色

English (原文): The hatched band is the dead zone: motion inside it is ignored.
简体中文: 斜线区域为死区：此范围内的移动将被忽略。

English (原文): Reopen a design's views next time it opens
简体中文: 下次打开设计时重新打开它的视图

English (原文): A design opens with the views it had when you closed it. Off: it opens with its Model view only.
简体中文: 设计会以关闭时的视图打开。关闭：仅以模型视图打开。

English (原文): Reuse a view of the same sheet, sketch or workspace
简体中文: 重用同一图纸、草图或工作区的视图

English (原文): Opening it again shows the view you already have. Off: each opening makes a new view.
简体中文: 再次打开时显示已有的视图。关闭：每次打开都会新建视图。

English (原文): Open Render and Animate in a sub-tab
简体中文: 在子标签页中打开渲染和动画

English (原文): Render and Animate open as their own views of the design. Off: they replace the view you are in.
简体中文: 渲染和动画作为设计的独立视图打开。关闭：它们会替换当前视图。

English (原文): Open drawing sheets in a sub-tab
简体中文: 在子标签页中打开工程图图纸

English (原文): A drawing sheet opens as its own view of the design. Off: it replaces the view you are in.
简体中文: 工程图图纸作为设计的独立视图打开。关闭：它会替换当前视图。
在子标签页中打开草图

English (原文): Editing a sketch opens it as its own view; Finish Sketch returns to the previous one. Off: the sketch is edited in the view you are in.
简体中文: 编辑草图时会将其作为独立视图打开；完成草图后返回上一个视图。关闭：在当前视图中编辑草图。

English (原文): Or to edit a linked one in place.
简体中文: 或就地编辑链接的组件。

English (原文): Show moved parts' old place as a ghost
简体中文: 以虚影显示已移动零件的原位置

English (原文): Holes made in one go share a folder in History, closed at first; open it to edit a hole on its own.
简体中文: 一次创建的孔在历史中共用一个文件夹，初始为折叠；展开后可单独编辑每个孔。

English (原文): Picking the face again moves the hole instead of removing it.
简体中文: 再次选择该面会移动孔而非移除孔。

English (原文): Picking elsewhere on a face adds another hole; picking a hole removes it.
简体中文: 在面的其他位置选择会再添加一个孔；选择孔会移除该孔。

English (原文): The middle of a face and the centers of its round edges.
简体中文: 面的中点及其圆形边的圆心。

English (原文): Show views as tabs: each view is a tab inside its design's tab, falling back to the switcher when the bar is too narrow. Show one tab with a view switcher: each design keeps a single tab and lists its views in a menu.
简体中文: 以标签页显示视图：每个视图是其设计标签页内的标签页，栏过窄时退回到切换器。显示带视图切换器的单个标签页：每个设计只保留一个标签页，并在菜单中列出其视图。

English (原文): Show one tab with a view switcher
简体中文: 显示带视图切换器的单个标签页

English (原文): Dialog buttons answer their first letter
简体中文: 对话框按钮响应其首字母

English (原文): With a dialog open, typing the first letter of a button's label presses it: O for OK, C for Cancel. A letter that fits two buttons does nothing, and a focused text field keeps the keystroke. Off: typing does nothing to the buttons, as before.
简体中文: 打开对话框时，按下按钮标签的首字母即可触发该按钮：如“取”对应“取消”。一个字母若匹配两个按钮则不起作用，获得焦点的文本框保留按键输入。关闭时：按键不影响按钮，与以前相同。

English (原文): The theme's colors, or a color of your own for the lines, arrows and values. Selection, hover and conflicts keep their colors.
简体中文: 使用主题颜色，或为线条、箭头和数值指定自定义颜色。选择、悬停和冲突仍保留各自的颜色。

English (原文): What the window's arrows, Up/Down and the wheel add to an angle
简体中文: 窗口的箭头、上下方向键和滚轮给角度增减的量

English (原文): What the window's arrows, Up/Down and the wheel add to a length
简体中文: 窗口的箭头、上下方向键和滚轮给长度增减的量

English (原文): Scales dimension values in sketches and in shown dimensions.
简体中文: 缩放草图和显示尺寸中的尺寸值。

English (原文): Where you type a dimension's value. A window has arrows that step it; the Dimension tool places the text first.
简体中文: 输入尺寸值的位置。窗口带有可增减数值的箭头；尺寸工具会先放置文字。

English (原文): Esc closes analyses and the section view
简体中文: Esc 关闭分析和剖切视图

English (原文): Press Esc with nothing else open to turn off the newest analysis or the section view, as before. Off: they stay on until you close them from their status item, toggle or command.
简体中文: 在没有其他内容打开时按 Esc，会像以前一样关闭最新的分析或剖切视图。关闭时：它们保持开启，直到您通过其状态项、切换按钮或命令将其关闭。

English (原文): Exported body's name (the first one when there are several)
简体中文: 导出实体的名称（有多个时取第一个）
导出此设计时建议的名称：{name}

English (原文): Ctrl+left drag on empty space orbits; hold Space to pan.
简体中文: 在空白处按住Ctrl并用鼠标左键拖动可旋转；按住空格键可平移。

English (原文): Dragging Extrude's distance arrow stops at flat faces parallel to the profile, such as the far side of a block being cut, and outlines the face. Off: the arrow moves in round steps only.
简体中文: 拖动拉伸的距离箭头时，它会停在与轮廓平行的平面上（例如正在切除的块的另一侧），并勾勒出该面。关闭：箭头只按整数步长移动。

English (原文): The distance a new Extrude starts with: 10 in the design's unit, the distance of the last new extrude you applied, or a length you type. Editing an extrude leaves its distance as it is.
简体中文: 新建拉伸的起始距离：设计单位下的 10、上次应用的新建拉伸的距离，或您输入的长度。编辑已有拉伸时保留其自身的值。

English (原文): Turn the view to isometric when Extrude opens
简体中文: 打开拉伸时转到等轴测视图

English (原文): Go back to the earlier view when Extrude closes
简体中文: 关闭拉伸时回到之前的视图

English (原文): While a file opens or is inserted, or links are read again, the design waits behind a card with the file's progress and Cancel. Off: the file shows in the operations panel and you can keep working; an insert lands once you finish what you are doing, and a file opened meanwhile goes in a new tab.
简体中文: 打开或插入文件、重新读取链接时，设计会在显示进度和取消按钮的卡片后等待。关闭：文件显示在操作面板中，您可以继续工作；插入会在您完成当前操作后生效，期间打开的文件会放在新标签页中。

English (原文): Use the previous Solid Fillet radius default
简体中文: 使用之前的圆角半径默认值

English (原文): Off by default. When on, a new Solid Fillet opens at the number 2 read in the design's units ("2 in" in an inch design), as before; when off, it opens at the radius the tool ships with, 2 mm, shown in the design's units ("0.07874 in" in an inch design).
简体中文: 默认关闭。开启时：新的 Solid Fillet 以按设计单位读取的数字 2（"2 in"）开始，与之前相同。关闭时：它以该工具自带的半径 2 mm 开始，并按设计的单位显示（"0.07874 in"）。

English (原文): Glyphs the chosen font lacks fall back to the built-in font, so no label shows an empty box.
简体中文: 所选字体缺少的字符会使用内置字体，避免标签显示为空方框。

English (原文): The quick brown fox · Ø12.50 mm · 45.0° · 0123456789
The selected font could not be read.

简体中文: 配置文件、语言、文件和更新。

English (原文): Choose the graphics API used to open SolidCraft. If the next start cannot open the window, the previous choice is restored.
简体中文: 选择用于启动 SolidCraft 的图形 API。如果下次启动无法打开窗口，将恢复之前的选择。

English (原文): A launch override is controlling the graphics API. The saved choice will apply when SolidCraft is opened normally.
简体中文: 启动覆盖设置正在控制图形 API。正常打开 SolidCraft 时将应用已保存的选择。

English (原文): Applies after a restart. Unsaved designs are handled before closing.
简体中文: 重启后生效。关闭前会处理未保存的设计。

English (原文): Restart SolidCraft to apply the saved graphics API.
简体中文: 重启 SolidCraft 以应用已保存的图形 API。

English (原文): The graphics API choice could not be saved: {error}
简体中文: 无法保存图形 API 选择：{error}

English (原文): The selected graphics API could not be prepared: {error}
简体中文: 无法准备所选图形 API：{error}

English (原文): The previous start with {requested} did not open the window. SolidCraft restored {previous}.
简体中文: 上次使用 {requested} 启动时未能打开窗口。SolidCraft 已恢复为 {previous}。

English (原文): Graphics API selection is available in the desktop app.
简体中文: 图形 API 选择功能可在桌面应用中使用。

English (原文): The saved graphics card is unavailable; Automatic is used.
简体中文: 已保存的显卡不可用；将使用自动选择。

English (原文): Takes effect after restarting SolidCraft. WGPU_ADAPTER_NAME overrides this choice.
简体中文: 重启 SolidCraft 后生效。WGPU_ADAPTER_NAME 优先于此选择。

English (原文): The saved graphics card was not used for this window; the card in use is shown in Help › About and in the status line. Try Automatic, or set WGPU_ADAPTER_NAME to a unique part of the card's name.
简体中文: 已保存的显卡未用于此窗口；实际使用的显卡显示在“帮助 › 关于”和状态栏中。请尝试“自动”，或将 WGPU_ADAPTER_NAME 设为显卡名称中的唯一部分。

English (原文): Trade speed for smoothness. Each choice shows its effect on a sample.
简体中文: 在速度与平滑度之间取舍。每个选项均以示例展示效果。
透过实体的参考几何体
在速度与平滑度之间权衡。

English (原文): Only while the view is still
Presets set the choices below together.
简体中文: 预设会同时设置以下选项。

English (原文): Place the shadow below the lowest visible body. When off, raised models keep their shadow on the origin ground plane.
简体中文: 将阴影放在可见实体的最低点下方。关闭时，抬高模型的阴影仍位于经过原点的地面上。

English (原文): Heal imported parts that fail the check
简体中文: 修复未通过检查的导入零件

English (原文): When SMLib's check fails a STEP part only on tolerance-scale defects (edges shorter than their tolerance, slivers between coincident edges, curve pieces of no length), heal them in the background after the import, and heal them first in Repair. Turn off to keep such parts as read, with the check's warning.
简体中文: 当 SMLib 检查仅因公差尺度的缺陷（短于其公差的边、重合边之间的细长面、长度为零的曲线段）而判定 STEP 零件不合格时，导入后在后台修复，并在“修复”中首先修复。关闭后，这类零件保持读取时的样子，并带有检查警告。

English (原文): Hide constraint glyphs when zoomed out
Constraint glyphs leave the view when the sketch is zoomed out far enough that they would clutter it. Off: they stay at a fixed screen size at every zoom.
简体中文: 草图缩小到一定程度时隐藏约束符号，以免遮挡草图。关闭：任意缩放比例下符号仍保持固定屏幕大小。

English (原文): Dim rigid joints and joints whose parts are fully constrained, so you can see what can still move
简体中文: 调暗刚性关节和零件已完全约束的关节，以便看清哪些仍可移动

English (原文): Fold the History bar into groups

In a long history, a run of one component's features folds into one chip, and feature folders start folded. An inserted STEP assembly goes into a Group folder. Off shows each feature, starts folders open and makes no folder.
简体中文: 在较长的历史中，同一组件的连续特征折叠为一个标签，特征文件夹开始时为折叠状态。插入的 STEP 装配体放入 Group 文件夹。关闭后显示每个特征，文件夹开始时为展开状态，且不创建文件夹。
文件夹使用其中特征的图标

English (原文): A History folder whose features are all of one kind shows their icon.
简体中文: 历史中特征全部属于同一类型的文件夹显示该类型的图标。

English (原文): Two or more joints show as one button with their count, and a click shows each one. Off shows each joint.
简体中文: 两个或更多关节显示为一个带数量的按钮，单击即可显示每个关节。关闭后逐个显示每个关节。
在浏览器中显示历史记录

English (原文): List each component’s features in the Browser and hide the separate History panel.
简体中文: 在浏览器中列出各组件的特征，并隐藏独立的历史记录面板。

English (原文): Show origin and bodies at the top
简体中文: 在顶部显示原点和实体

English (原文): The History on the left or under the browser starts with the active component's Bodies folder and the Origin, with their eyes and menus as in the browser. The History at the bottom is unchanged.
简体中文: 左侧或浏览器下方的历史以活动组件的实体文件夹和原点开头，并带有与浏览器相同的显示切换和菜单。底部的历史保持不变。

English (原文): Play History button in the History controls
简体中文: 在历史控件中显示“播放历史”按钮

English (原文): Puts Play History between Go back one step and Go forward one step in the History controls. You can also right-click the controls to show or hide it.
简体中文: 在历史控件的“后退一步”和“前进一步”之间添加“播放历史”。也可以右键单击这些控件来显示或隐藏它。

English (原文): With Sketches set to Under their feature, the History at the left lists each sketch one level in, under the first feature built from it, whenever it is wide enough for names. The timeline at the bottom always keeps the creation order.
简体中文: 草图：选择“位于其特征下”后，左侧历史在宽度足以显示名称时，会将草图缩进一级，列在由其创建的第一个特征下。底部时间轴始终保持创建顺序。

English (原文): With a component active or picked, the History controls step through that component's features, as the History at the bottom shows them. Off: they step through every feature of the design. The History on the left or under the browser always steps through every feature.
简体中文: 当某个组件处于活动或选中状态时，历史控件按底部历史的显示，只在该组件的特征之间移动。关闭后，它们在设计的所有特征之间移动。左侧或浏览器下方的历史始终在所有特征之间移动。

English (原文): How much of the view the model fills when Home, Fit, an opened design or a navigator view change frames it, whether or not the setting below is on. 100 %: fills the view between the panels, the compass and the navigation bar.
简体中文: 主视图、适配、打开的设计或视图导航器切换视图框住模型时，模型占视图的比例，与下方设置是否开启无关。100 %：填满面板、罗盘和导航栏之间的视图。

English (原文): How SolidCraft looks and where its parts sit.
简体中文: SolidCraft 的外观和面板布局。

English (原文): The two curved arrows at the navigator's corner roll the view within the screen plane. On: the clockwise arrow rolls counterclockwise and the counterclockwise arrow rolls clockwise. Off: each arrow rolls the view the way it curls.
简体中文: 导航器角落的两个弯曲箭头在屏幕平面内翻滚视图。开启：顺时针箭头逆时针翻滚，逆时针箭头顺时针翻滚。关闭：每个箭头按其弯曲方向翻滚视图。
反转导航器的旋转箭头

English (原文): The arrows around the navigator orbit the camera the way they point, as in Fusion and Inventor: the arrow on the left points right and swings the camera right. Off: an arrow rotates the view toward the side it sits on, so the left arrow swings the camera left. The curved roll arrows are not affected.
简体中文: 导航器周围的箭头按箭头所指的方向转动相机，与 Fusion 和 Inventor 相同：左侧箭头指向右，相机向右转动。关闭：箭头把视图转向它所在的那一侧，因此左侧箭头使相机向左转动。弯曲的翻滚箭头不受影响。

English (原文): Turn parts on a ball joint like a trackball when dragged
简体中文: 拖动球关节上的零件时像轨迹球一样旋转

English (原文): Dragging a part that a ball joint holds turns it by the smallest turn about the joint, as if rolling a ball the size of the part. Off: the point you grabbed follows the pointer exactly, and the part may also spin about it.
简体中文: 拖动由球关节固定的零件时，它绕关节以最小的转动旋转，就像滚动一个与零件同样大小的球。关闭：抓取的点精确跟随指针，零件还可能绕该点自旋。

English (原文): Keep the highlight while the view moves
The face under the pointer keeps its highlight while the view moves under it (off: the highlight goes off while the view moves, as before, #2130)
简体中文: 指针下的面在视图于其下方移动时保持高亮（关闭：与以前一样，视图移动时高亮会消失 #2130）

English (原文): On: the print face of each body is tinted in the view at all times and saved in the design. Off: it is tinted only while Send to Slicer is open, and designs are saved and opened without print faces.
简体中文: 开启：每个实体的打印底面始终在视图中着色，并保存在设计中。关闭：仅在“发送到切片软件”打开时着色，设计保存和打开时不含打印底面。

English (原文): Still ask when the tab closes
简体中文: 关闭标签页时仍然询问

English (原文): With this off, the tab closes without the browser's box once every unsaved design's copy is current.
简体中文: 关闭此项后，只要每个未保存设计的副本都是最新的，标签页就会直接关闭，不显示浏览器的提示框。

English (原文): Keep unsaved work in this browser
简体中文: 在此浏览器中保留未保存的工作

English (原文): Each open design's unsaved changes are kept up to date in this browser's private storage. The next visit offers to restore them.
简体中文: 每个打开的设计的未保存更改都会在此浏览器的私有存储中保持最新。下次访问时会提示恢复。

English (原文): Keep dialogs and tools open when switching designs
简体中文: 切换设计时保持对话框和工具打开

English (原文): Each design tab keeps its open dialog or tool, with what you picked and typed in it, and its toolbar tab. They are there again when you come back to the design. Off: switching designs cancels them, and Remember each design's toolbar tab decides the toolbar tab.
简体中文: 每个设计标签页保留其打开的对话框或工具（包括其中已选择和输入的内容）以及工具栏选项卡。回到该设计时它们仍在原处。关闭时：切换设计会取消它们并显示“模型”选项卡。

English (原文): Floating surfaces have rounded corners and space around them. Compact surfaces sit flush with the window edges.
简体中文: 浮动外观使用圆角和周围留白。紧凑外观贴合窗口边缘。

English (原文): Click a ribbon panel name to open its menu. Hover another panel name to switch. Move outside the ribbon and open menu to close it.
简体中文: 点击功能区的面板名称打开菜单。将指针悬停在另一面板名称上即可切换菜单。将指针移到功能区和已打开菜单之外即可关闭菜单。
从菜单中排除固定命令

English (原文): Press and drag draws one line
简体中文: 按下并拖动绘制一条直线

English (原文): In the Line tool, pressing, dragging and letting go draws one line from the press to the release, and it ends there. Clicks still draw a chain. Off: a drag places a point where it is let go, as a click does.
简体中文: 在直线工具中，按下、拖动再松开，会从按下处到松开处绘制一条直线并在此结束。单击仍会绘制连续的直线。关闭时：拖动与单击一样，在松开处放置一个点。

English (原文): Rest on a line's last point to switch to a tangent arc
简体中文: 停留在直线的最后一点上以切换到相切圆弧

English (原文): In the Line tool, once a segment is drawn, move away from the chain's last point, come back and hold the pointer still on it: the next click ends a tangent arc, and the same gesture goes back to lines. Off: resting there does nothing.
简体中文: 在直线工具中，画好一段后，先离开连续线的最后一点，再回到该点并让指针保持不动：下一次单击将确定相切圆弧的终点，同样的操作可切回直线。关闭：停留在该点不起作用。

English (原文): No folders yet. A design that links to files in another folder asks before loading them.
简体中文: 还没有文件夹。链接到其他文件夹中文件的设计会在加载前询问。

English (原文): Linked files from other folders: a design opening loads them from these folders without asking. A folder is added when you choose Load.
简体中文: 设计打开时除自身文件夹外可以加载链接文件的文件夹。选择“加载”时会添加。

English (原文): Show the panel and the other panels in their proposed positions before you drop it. When off, an outline marks the drop position.
简体中文: 放下前，在预定位置显示正在拖动的面板和其他面板。关闭后，用轮廓标出放置位置。
可打开的最大文件：设计

English (原文): This run started with --max-file-size {size}, which applies until SolidCraft closes. These settings apply when it starts without it.
简体中文: 本次启动指定了 --max-file-size {size}，该值在关闭 SolidCraft 前有效。不带此选项启动时才会应用这些设置。

English (原文): Defaults: 512 MB and 256 MB; at most 16 GB. Opening a file takes several times its size in memory. A design that keeps a large import may need a higher design file limit to save and reopen.
简体中文: 默认值：512 MB 和 256 MB；上限为 16 GB。打开文件需要数倍于文件大小的内存。保留大型导入数据的设计可能需要提高设计文件上限，才能保存并重新打开。

English (原文): Largest file to open: STEP and import
简体中文: 可打开的最大文件：STEP 和导入

English (原文): The web app opens STEP and import files up to 512 MB and designs up to 256 MB: a browser tab can't hold larger files. The desktop app can raise these limits.
简体中文: 网页版可打开最大 512 MB 的 STEP 和导入文件，以及最大 256 MB 的设计：浏览器标签页无法容纳更大的文件。桌面版可提高这些上限。

English (原文): Highlight what is under the pointer while Move's arrows drag a component
简体中文: 用移动的箭头拖动组件时高亮指针下的对象

English (原文): Off: while Move's arrows drag a component, nothing under the pointer is highlighted, which keeps large assemblies smooth. With a section or an analysis shown it is highlighted all the same, and a part dragged along its joints never highlights it.
简体中文: 关闭：用移动的箭头拖动组件时，不高亮指针下的对象，大型装配体也能保持流畅。显示剖切或分析时仍照常高亮；沿关节拖动零件时从不高亮。

English (原文): Hold or flick the right button for a ring of tools.
简体中文: 按住或轻甩右键以显示工具环。

English (原文): How the mouse, trackpad and 3D mouse move the view.
简体中文: 鼠标、触控板和3D鼠标如何移动视图。

English (原文): Fit the model after a navigator view change
简体中文: 视图导航器切换视图后适配模型

English (原文): A face, corner or arrow of a navigator, or an axis of the gizmo, also looks at the middle of the model from the one distance that fits it from every side (its bounding sphere). Home uses the same zoom and center while this is on, so views chosen after it only turn. Off: the view turns in place, keeping its target and zoom.
简体中文: 点击导航器的面、角或箭头，或坐标轴指示器的轴时，也会从各个方向都能容纳模型的同一距离（其包围球）注视模型中心。开启期间主视图使用相同的缩放和中心，因此之后选择的视图只改变方向。关闭：视图原地旋转，保持目标点和缩放。
允许设计中的网络位置

English (原文): For organizations that keep designs on file servers. Off: only servers you allow.
简体中文: 适用于将设计存放在文件服务器上的组织。关闭时：仅允许您授权的服务器。

English (原文): Long operations (opening a file, computing a feature, an agent's command) show in the view's bottom-right corner with their progress and a button that cancels them. Off: a Computing notice, as before.
简体中文: 耗时的操作（打开文件、计算特征、智能体的命令）会连同进度和取消按钮显示在视图右下角。关闭：与以前一样显示“正在计算”提示。

English (原文): Hold Shift during orbit to snap to an axis.
简体中文: 旋转时按住Shift可捕捉到坐标轴。

English (原文): Origin axes across the whole view
Draw the X, Y and Z origin axes through the origin to the edges of the view, in both directions. Off: short axes at the origin.
简体中文: 将 X、Y、Z 原点轴穿过原点向两个方向绘制到视图边缘。关闭：在原点显示短轴。

English (原文): Names shown in the browser, dialogs and lists. {top} is XY, {front} is XZ and {right} is YZ, with Z up. Commands, scripts and saved designs keep XY, XZ and YZ.
简体中文: 浏览器、对话框和列表中显示的名称。{top} 即 XY，{front} 即 XZ，{right} 即 YZ（Z 轴朝上）。命令、脚本和已保存的设计仍使用 XY、XZ 和 YZ。

English (原文): Saved panel layouts could not be restored. The saved data is retained; Classic stays available.
简体中文: 无法恢复已保存的面板布局。保存的数据仍被保留，经典布局仍可使用。

English (原文): {count} saved panel layouts could not be restored and were reset: {names}. The rest of your layouts are kept.
简体中文: 有 {count} 个已保存的面板布局无法恢复，已重置：{names}。其余布局均已保留。

English (原文): {count} saved panel layouts could not be restored and were reset: {names}. Your saved layouts are left as they were; changes to layouts this session won't be saved.
简体中文: 有 {count} 个已保存的面板布局无法恢复，已重置：{names}。已保存的布局保持原样，本次会话中对布局的更改不会被保存。

English (原文): The most parameters Down arrow lists in an empty expression box.
简体中文: 在空表达式框中按向下箭头时列出的参数上限。

English (原文): In the web app: tap an item with a pen to add or remove it from the selection, double-tap it to select its whole body or sketch, and tap empty space to clear the selection. Fingers in the view only move the view, and a finger double-tap on a flat face starts a sketch on it. Buttons and panels take finger taps as usual.
简体中文: 在网页应用中：用触控笔轻点一个项目可将其加入或移出选区，双击可选中其整个实体或草图，轻点空白处可清除选区。视图中的手指只用于移动视图，用手指双击平面可在该面上开始草图。按钮和面板照常响应手指轻点。
突出显示已启用的功能区命令

English (原文): Highlight ribbon commands while their effects are on. Turn off to keep the previous neutral appearance and command help.
简体中文: 在效果启用时突出显示相应的功能区命令。关闭此选项可保留原来的中性外观和命令帮助。
没有符合这些筛选条件的主题。
随操作系统设置自动切换。

English (原文): Show pinned constraints in the constraint grid
简体中文: 在约束网格中显示已固定的约束

English (原文): Constraints you pin to the sketch ribbon's Constrain panel are drawn as small icons in its grid, next to the default ones. Off: each is a full-size button with its name.
简体中文: 固定到草图功能区“约束”面板的约束会以小图标显示在网格中，与默认约束并列。关闭时：每个约束都是带名称的全尺寸按钮。

English (原文): Reading or updating a plugin package…
简体中文: 正在读取或更新插件包…

English (原文): Refresh after design changes ({entry}); cannot edit, write files or start jobs
简体中文: 设计更改后刷新（{entry}）；无法编辑、写入文件或启动作业

English (原文): Enter an absolute folder path for each request. Approval grants only the listed access to these folders.
简体中文: 为每项请求输入绝对文件夹路径。批准后仅授予列出的文件夹访问权限。

English (原文): Change application settings and use application diagnostics.
简体中文: 更改应用设置并使用应用诊断功能。

English (原文): Read or write files within the approved folders.
简体中文: 在批准的文件夹中读取或写入文件。

English (原文): Inspect, install, remove or run other plugins.
简体中文: 检查、安装、移除或运行其他插件。
已批准文件夹中的文件

English (原文): Enter a positive whole-number fuel ceiling and memory from 1 to 4096 MiB.
简体中文: fuel必须为正整数，内存必须为1至4096 MiB的整数。

English (原文): Press Enter, Apply or OK to accept both values. These ceilings do not increase a package’s requested budget or approve its code. Review each package before running. Run defaults remain 10,000,000 fuel and 64 MiB. Choose limits that fit available RAM; Wasm32 supports at most 4096 MiB of linear memory.
简体中文: 按Enter、应用或确定以确认两个值。修改许可上限不会自动增加插件请求的预算或批准其代码。运行前请审查各个软件包。运行预算默认仍为1000万fuel和64 MiB。请选择适合可用RAM的上限；Wasm32线性内存最大为4096 MiB。

English (原文): The plugin could not refresh after the design changed: {error}
简体中文: 设计更改后，插件无法刷新：{error}

English (原文): Off by default. When enabled, reopening the same plugin command in a design keeps its last moved window position until the app closes.
简体中文: 默认关闭。启用后，在同一设计中重新打开插件命令时，将保留上次移动后的窗口位置，直到退出应用。

English (原文): Remove the installed package and its approved permissions. This takes effect immediately and is kept when Preferences is canceled.
简体中文: 移除已安装的插件包及其批准的权限。此操作立即生效，取消偏好设置时也会保留。

English (原文): The plugin package command returned an invalid reply.
简体中文: 插件包命令返回了无效响应。
菜单：{name}（无法识别的菜单显示在“插件”下）
功能区：{name}（无法识别的选项卡显示在“插件”下）

English (原文): Prefer movable sketch points when points overlap
简体中文: 草图点重合时优先选择可移动的点

English (原文): Tint new surface in a preview
简体中文: 在预览中为新表面着色

English (原文): A preview of a feature that changes a body can draw the surface it adds in the preview color. When off, the body is drawn as itself.
简体中文: 更改实体的特征，其预览可以用预览颜色绘制新增的表面。关闭时，实体按自身颜色绘制。

English (原文): How strongly the print face of a body is tinted and outlined in the view. 0 % shows no highlight.
简体中文: 视图中实体打印底面的着色和轮廓强度。0 % 不显示高亮。

English (原文): Your usage statistics were deleted from the server.
简体中文: 你的使用统计已从服务器删除。
已请求删除。新的安装 ID：{id}

English (原文): Turned off by DO_NOT_TRACK or SOLIDCRAFT_NO_TELEMETRY
简体中文: 已被 DO_NOT_TRACK 或 SOLIDCRAFT_NO_TELEMETRY 关闭

English (原文): Usage statistics: not included in this build
简体中文: 使用统计：此版本未包含

English (原文): Nothing is sent while usage statistics are off.
简体中文: 使用统计关闭时不会发送任何内容。

English (原文): New installation ID. What was kept under the old one is deleted.
简体中文: 已使用新的安装 ID。旧 ID 下保存的内容已删除。

English (原文): Once a day: a random installation ID, the version, operating system and architecture, the minutes you used SolidCraft, and for each tool and operation how often it was used or failed and how long it took, as counts. Never your designs, file names, parameters, error messages or anything you type.
简体中文: 每天一次：一个随机的安装 ID、版本、操作系统和架构、使用 SolidCraft 的分钟数，以及每个工具和操作的使用次数、失败次数和耗时（仅计数）。绝不包括你的设计、文件名、参数、错误消息或输入的任何内容。

English (原文): Nothing is counted or sent until you choose OK on the notice.
简体中文: 在你于通知中选择“确定”之前，不会统计或发送任何内容。

English (原文): What SolidCraft shares about how it is used.
简体中文: SolidCraft 会分享哪些关于使用情况的信息。

English (原文): Settings changed since the profile was saved. Save keeps them in it.
简体中文: 保存配置文件后设置已更改。“保存”会将其写入配置文件。
配置文件名称，例如 笔记本

English (原文): Records how long SMLib calls, kernel operations, features, commands and imports take. Agents read it with diagnostics.profile.
简体中文: 记录 SMLib 调用、内核操作、特征、命令和导入所用的时间。智能体通过 diagnostics.profile 读取。

English (原文): Current settings saved to the profile.
简体中文: 已将当前设置保存到配置文件。

English (原文): Profile applied; {n} setting(s) kept their current value (see the log).
简体中文: 已应用配置文件；{n} 项设置保留了当前值（见日志）。

English (原文): Shortcuts, the toolbar, navigation, the radial menu and interface settings, kept together under a name and switched at once.
简体中文: 将快捷键、工具栏、导航、径向菜单和界面设置一起以名称保存，并一次切换。

English (原文): On: choose Geometry or Bodies and Projection Link before projecting. Off: keep the previous direct-pick workflow.
简体中文: 开启：投影前选择“几何体”或“实体”以及“投影链接”。关闭：保留原有的直接选择工作流。

English (原文): Quick measurement in the view's corner
简体中文: 在视图角落显示快速测量

English (原文): The selection's size in the view's bottom right corner: an edge's length, or Ø and R for a round one, a face's area, a point's position, two items' distance and angle, several edges' or faces' total. A click copies it.
简体中文: 在视图右下角、历史记录上方显示所选对象的尺寸：边的长度（圆形边显示 Ø 和 R）、面的面积、点的位置、两个对象之间的距离和角度、多条边或多个面的总和。点击即可复制。

English (原文): Off by default. When on, after a command succeeds, its safe values and options are reused the next time you open the same command, until SolidCraft closes.
简体中文: 默认关闭。开启后，命令成功执行后，在关闭 SolidCraft 前，下次打开同一命令时会重用其安全的值和选项。

English (原文): Remember stand-up answers for files I've opened
简体中文: 记住已打开文件的摆正选择

English (原文): Apply the same stand-up answer when an unchanged file opens again. Turn off to ask each time.
简体中文: 再次打开未更改的文件时应用相同的摆正选择。关闭后每次都会询问。
记住每个设计的工具栏选项卡

English (原文): Each design comes back on the toolbar tab it was last using, such as Surface or Inspect, when you switch back to it. Off: switching designs shows the Model tab.
简体中文: 切换回某个设计时，它会回到上次使用的工具栏选项卡，例如曲面或检查。关闭时：切换设计会显示模型选项卡。
使用以前的渲染图像默认值

English (原文): Keep the previous manual workflow: new setups use CPU raster, CPU ray tracing keeps fixed sampling, and you open rendered results manually. Refit on Render entry, switch shots without restoring their cameras, and use the previous framing and navigation. Disable automatic live image feedback. Saved setups are unchanged.
简体中文: 保留以前的手动图像流程：新设置使用 CPU 光栅渲染，CPU 光线追踪使用固定采样，并手动打开结果。进入渲染时重新适配视图，切换镜头时不恢复其保存的相机，并使用以前的取景和导航方式。禁用自动实时图像反馈。已保存的设置保持不变。
使用以前的渲染内存检查

English (原文): Allow native renders within the fixed shared and host memory budgets even when their estimate exceeds available RAM. Device limits and allocation checks still apply.
简体中文: 即使估算用量超过可用RAM，也允许在固定的共享内存和主机内存限额内进行原生渲染。设备限制和内存分配检查仍然适用。

English (原文): Use previous Render preview geometry budget
简体中文: 使用先前的渲染预览几何内存预算

English (原文): Restore the previous fixed geometry limit (512 MiB on 64-bit desktop, 128 MiB elsewhere) instead of the device-based budget.
简体中文: 恢复先前的固定几何内存上限（64位桌面为512 MiB，其他平台为128 MiB），替代基于设备的预算。

English (原文): Report a bug opens a public GitHub draft instead
简体中文: “报告缺陷”改为打开公开的 GitHub 草稿

English (原文): Off: Report a bug files a ticket on tickets.solidcraft.io. On: it opens a public GitHub issue draft, as before.
简体中文: 关闭：“报告缺陷”会在 tickets.solidcraft.io 上创建工单。开启：像以前一样打开公开的 GitHub 议题草稿。
重用以前打开文件的导入结果

English (原文): Reopen unchanged STEP and IGES files from a local model cache. Turn off to import each time. Clear removes cached imports, keeping remembered stand-up answers.
简体中文: 从本地模型缓存重新打开未更改的 STEP 和 IGES 文件。关闭后每次都会重新导入。清除缓存会保留记住的摆正选择。

English (原文): Clicking the running tool's button ends it
简体中文: 单击正在运行的工具的按钮将结束该工具

English (原文): A click on the lit ribbon button of the sketch tool in use ends the tool, so clicks in the view select again. Off: the click starts the tool again.
简体中文: 单击正在使用的草图工具的高亮功能区按钮会结束该工具，在视图中单击即可再次选择。关闭：单击会重新启动该工具。

English (原文): Show search results in the ribbon
简体中文: 在功能区中显示搜索结果

English (原文): Hovering a result in Search commands shows where the command sits in the ribbon: its tab, its button or its row in a panel's drop-down. A command started from the search blinks there, and a running command from a drop-down marks its panel.
简体中文: 将指针悬停在“搜索命令”的结果上时，会显示该命令在功能区中的位置：其选项卡、按钮或面板下拉菜单中的行。从搜索启动的命令会在那里闪烁，从下拉菜单运行的命令会标记其面板。
仅显示功能区的选项卡

English (原文): The ribbon folds to its tab row. Clicking a tab shows its panels over the view until a command starts or the pointer leaves them. Ribbon Tabs Only in the View tab, or its shortcut, switches this.
简体中文: 功能区折叠为选项卡行。单击选项卡会在视图上方显示其面板，直到命令开始或指针离开面板。“视图”选项卡中的“仅功能区选项卡”或其快捷键可切换此项。

English (原文): Next start only: plain drawing without anti-aliasing, ambient occlusion, blur behind panels or the path tracer, on the graphics API wgpu picks. SolidCraft also starts this way by itself after a start that failed or lost its graphics device.
简体中文: 仅限下次启动：使用 wgpu 选择的图形 API 进行简单绘制，不使用抗锯齿、环境光遮蔽、面板背后模糊或路径追踪器。启动失败或丢失图形设备后，SolidCraft 也会自动以这种方式启动。

English (原文): Ask about each unsaved design separately when closing several
简体中文: 关闭多个设计时，逐个询问未保存的设计

English (原文): Show one save prompt per unsaved design instead of a combined list.
简体中文: 对每个未保存的设计分别显示保存提示，而不是合并列表。

English (原文): Also Ctrl + / Ctrl − in the window. Buttons are 28 px at 100%.
简体中文: 也可在窗口中使用 Ctrl + / Ctrl −。100% 时按钮高度为 28 像素。

English (原文): Encrypting design files with GnuPG is the next part of this work: encrypted designs and an encrypted indicator arrive together.
简体中文: 使用 GnuPG 加密设计文件是这项工作的下一部分：加密设计和加密指示器将一同推出。

English (原文): GnuPG was not found on this computer
简体中文: 在此计算机上未找到 GnuPG
正在读取 GnuPG 密钥…
使用 GnuPG 为保存的设计签名

English (原文): Each save adds a signature from your GnuPG key. A key on a YubiKey stays on the smartcard; GnuPG asks for its PIN.
简体中文: 每次保存都会添加来自你的 GnuPG 密钥的签名。YubiKey 上的密钥保留在智能卡中；GnuPG 会询问其 PIN。

English (原文): A key fingerprint or user id. Empty uses GnuPG's default signing key.
简体中文: 密钥指纹或用户 ID。留空则使用 GnuPG 的默认签名密钥。
留空：GnuPG 的默认签名密钥

English (原文): Only a signature from one of these key fingerprints is shown as verified. Separate fingerprints with commas; spaces inside a fingerprint (as gpg prints it) are ignored. The user id in a file is not proof of who signed it.
简体中文: 只有来自这些密钥指纹的签名才会显示为已验证。请用逗号分隔指纹；指纹内部的空格（gpg 的输出格式）会被忽略。文件中的用户 ID 并不能证明签名者身份。

English (原文): Empty: no signing key is trusted
简体中文: 留空：没有受信任的签名密钥

English (原文): Reads every payload to check the signature. Off: a signed design opens without that extra read, and File > Verify Signature checks it on request.
简体中文: 读取所有负载以检查签名。关闭时：已签名的设计无需额外读取即可打开，并在需要时通过“文件 > 验证签名”检查。

English (原文): Signing and checking the designs you save. Off by default.
简体中文: 为你保存的设计签名并检查。默认关闭。

English (原文): Edge picks, including for Fillet and Chamfer, can pick an edge behind a face in any visual style. Off keeps v0.30.1 selection behavior. Hidden bodies stay unselectable.
简体中文: 边的选择（包括圆角和倒角）在任何显示样式下都可以选取面后方的边。关闭时保留v0.30.1的选择行为。隐藏的实体仍不可选择。

English (原文): Select hidden geometry with Select Other
简体中文: 使用“选择其他”选择隐藏几何体

English (原文): On: include hidden bodies, sketches and occluded edges near the pointer. Off: use the original list of visible geometry under the pointer.
简体中文: 开启：包括指针附近的隐藏实体、草图和被遮挡的边。关闭：恢复原来的列表，仅包含指针正下方的可见几何体。

English (原文): Shift adds only; Ctrl / Cmd toggles
简体中文: Shift 仅添加；Ctrl / Cmd 切换选择

English (原文): On: Shift adds, Ctrl / Cmd toggles. Off (default): both toggle.
简体中文: 开启：Shift 添加，Ctrl / Cmd 切换选择。关闭（默认）：两者均切换选择。

English (原文): Every design tab shows its view switcher, and editing a sketch or opening Render adds a view of its own. Off: a design tab shows no switcher until you open a second view of the design (Ctrl+T).
简体中文: 每个设计标签页都显示其视图切换器，编辑草图或打开 Render 会添加其自己的视图。关闭：在你打开设计的第二个视图（Ctrl+T）之前，设计标签页不显示切换器。

English (原文): A Discord pill in the title bar, before Report a bug. The × on it turns it off; the Help menu, About and Home keep the Discord link either way.
简体中文: 在标题栏的“报告错误”之前显示 Discord 按钮。点击 × 可隐藏；帮助菜单、关于和主页始终保留该链接。

English (原文): A Donate pill in the title bar, before Report a bug. The × on it turns it off; the Help menu, About and Home keep the Ko-fi link either way.
简体中文: 在标题栏的“报告错误”之前显示捐赠按钮。点击 × 可隐藏；帮助菜单、关于和主页始终保留该链接。

English (原文): Show hidden edges of selected bodies
简体中文: 显示所选实体的隐藏边

English (原文): Draw a selected body's edges dimmed where the model hides them
简体中文: 在模型遮挡处以淡色绘制所选实体的边

English (原文): When off, surface shading and Continuity can stay on together. Turning this on keeps the last analysis started or changed.
简体中文: 关闭时，曲面着色分析和连续性分析可以同时保持启用。开启时，仅保留最后启动或修改的分析。

English (原文): Line up with other sketch points
Drawing lines align with points on both axes at once.
简体中文: 绘制的线同时与两个轴上的点对齐。
为新形状标注全部尺寸

English (原文): Typed values plus every dimension that fixes the shape.
简体中文: 输入的数值以及确定形状所需的所有尺寸。

English (原文): Show the cursor's coordinates in a sketch
简体中文: 在草图中显示光标坐标

English (原文): Beside the pointer, its X and Y from the sketch origin, also with no tool running. Off: only while a tool places a point.
简体中文: 即使没有运行工具，也在指针旁显示其相对于草图原点的 X 和 Y。关闭：仅在工具放置点时显示。

English (原文): The major and minor axes as construction lines, so the half-axes and axes can be dimensioned. Off: the ellipse alone, and D on it gives its minor radius wherever the value is pulled, drawn and labeled R as before.
简体中文: 将长轴和短轴绘制为构造线，以便标注半轴和轴。关闭：仅绘制椭圆，对其按 D 得到短半径，无论将数值拖到何处，都像以前一样绘制并标注 R。
连按两次 Esc 结束草图

English (原文): Two quick presses of Esc end the sketch. Off: Esc only cancels the tool or the selection, and Finish Sketch ends the sketch.
简体中文: 快速按两次 Esc 会结束草图。关闭时：Esc 只取消工具或选择，用“完成草图”结束草图。

English (原文): The most points or curves one sketch holds: 20000 by default, at most 200000. Insert SVG and Insert DXF refuse a larger drawing. A large sketch solves and draws more slowly.
简体中文: 一个草图可容纳的点或曲线的最大数量：默认 20000，最多 200000。插入 SVG 和插入 DXF 会拒绝更大的图形。大型草图的求解和绘制会更慢。

English (原文): Prefer movable points where they overlap
简体中文: 重叠时优先选择可移动点

English (原文): Snap to where two guides cross
简体中文: 捕捉两条辅助线的交点
选择 3D 草图曲线上的点

English (原文): Show and select points on drawn 3D sketch curves for construction references.
简体中文: 显示绘制的 3D 草图曲线上的点，并将其选作构造参照。
选择其他对象可选中隐藏几何体

English (原文): Pressing an active tool's shortcut again closes it
简体中文: 再次按下活动工具的快捷键将其关闭

English (原文): Pressing the shortcut for the active tool or dialog again closes it, as Esc does. Off: pressing the shortcut restarts the tool or dialog.
简体中文: 再次按下活动工具或对话框的快捷键会像按 Esc 一样将其关闭。关闭此项：再次按下会重新启动该工具或对话框。
再次按快捷键切换模式

English (原文): Off: it starts the tool again.
Snap to the grid's visible crossings
Temporary horizontal and vertical guides from hovered centers and edge midpoints.
简体中文: 从悬停的圆心和边中点显示临时水平和垂直辅助线。
也从草图点显示辅助线

English (原文): Line up with other sketch points while drawing
简体中文: 绘制时与其他草图点对齐

English (原文): While drawing, a point lines up horizontally with one sketch point and vertically with another at the same time, with a dotted guide, and the click keeps both alignments. Off: only with the previous point, one axis at a time.
简体中文: 绘制时，点可同时与一个草图点水平对齐、与另一个草图点竖直对齐，并显示虚线参考线；单击后保留两个对齐约束。关闭：仅与上一点对齐，每次一个方向。

English (原文): Conflicting geometry in the conflict color
简体中文: 以冲突颜色显示冲突的几何图形

English (原文): While a sketch's constraints conflict, the curves and points a failing constraint holds are drawn in the conflict color too, not only its glyph or dimension. Off: they keep their usual colors.
简体中文: 草图约束冲突时，不仅失败约束的符号或尺寸，该约束所约束的曲线和点也以冲突颜色绘制。关闭：它们保持平常的颜色。

English (原文): Where the view goes after Finish Sketch, Cancel or a double Esc.
简体中文: “完成草图”、取消或连按两次 Esc 后视图的去向。

English (原文): Sketching on a part's face makes that part active
简体中文: 在零件的面上绘制草图时激活该零件

English (原文): A sketch started on a face of another component's body activates that component first, so the sketch belongs to it and stays with that part in the browser. The part stays active afterwards. Off: the sketch belongs to the active component.
简体中文: 在另一个组件的实体面上开始的草图会先激活该组件，因此草图属于它，并在浏览器中留在该零件下。之后该零件保持激活。关闭时：草图属于当前激活的组件。

English (原文): Use the preselected construction line for Mirror
简体中文: 将预选的构造直线用作镜像线

English (原文): Turn to face a sketch when it opens
简体中文: 打开草图时转向正对草图

English (原文): Off: creating or editing a sketch leaves the view as it is. Look At faces the sketch when you want it.
简体中文: 关闭：创建或编辑草图时视图保持不变。需要时用“朝向”正对草图。

English (原文): Auto snap to recent centers and midpoints
简体中文: 自动吸附到最近的圆心和中点

English (原文): While drawing, snap the cursor where the guides of the two most recent circle centers or straight-edge midpoints cross. Off: those guides stay visual and the cursor does not move.
简体中文: 绘图时，将光标吸附到最近两个圆心或直线边中点的辅助线相交处。关闭：辅助线仅作显示，光标不会移动。

English (原文): How sketches snap and how clicks select.
简体中文: 草图如何捕捉，以及单击如何选择。

English (原文): A point in a sketch snaps to the crossings of the lines the grid draws when the pointer means one, and to the finer lattice between them otherwise. Off: the point snaps to the finer lattice only, as before.
简体中文: 当指针指向网格绘制的线的交点时，草图中的点捕捉到该交点，否则捕捉到交点之间更细的网格。关闭：点只捕捉到更细的网格，与之前相同。

English (原文): Shift makes a rectangle a square while drawing it
简体中文: 绘制矩形时按住 Shift 可画成正方形

English (原文): Sketch icons in the color of their state
简体中文: 以草图状态的颜色显示草图图标

English (原文): In History and the browser, a sketch's icon takes the color of its state (under constrained, fully constrained or conflicting) and its tooltip names the state. Off: every sketch has the same icon.
简体中文: 在历史和浏览器中，草图图标采用其状态（欠约束、完全约束或冲突）的颜色，工具提示会说明状态。关闭：所有草图使用相同的图标。

English (原文): The Sketch tab stays in the ribbon, right after Model, while no sketch is open. Its drawing tools then start a sketch on the selected plane or face, or on the plane you pick next, with the tool ready in it.
简体中文: 未打开草图时，草图选项卡也保留在功能区中紧随模型之后。其中的绘图工具会先在所选平面或面上（否则在接下来选取的平面上）创建草图，并在其中准备好该工具。
圆心和中点对齐辅助线

English (原文): Hover over a circle center or straight-edge midpoint, then move horizontally or vertically to show a temporary dotted guide.
简体中文: 将光标悬停在圆心或直线边的中点，然后水平或垂直移动以显示临时虚线辅助线。

English (原文): Alignment guides from end points and corners while drawing
简体中文: 绘制时也从端点和角点显示对齐辅助线

English (原文): While a drawing tool waits for a point, hovering a line or arc end, a rectangle corner or a free point shows the same temporary dotted guide as a center or midpoint. Off: only centers and midpoints.
简体中文: 绘图工具等待点时，将光标悬停在直线或圆弧的端点、矩形的角点或独立点上，会显示与圆心或中点相同的临时虚线辅助线。关闭：仅圆心和中点。

English (原文): While drawing or dragging a sketch point.
简体中文: 在绘制或拖动草图点时使用。

English (原文): After a STEP or IGES file opens with Z up, offer a quarter turn about X.
简体中文: 以 Z 轴向上打开 STEP 或 IGES 文件后，询问是否绕 X 轴旋转 90°。

English (原文): How the offer is made when the file names no known program.
简体中文: 文件未注明已知程序时如何提出建议。

English (原文): A thin bar along the window's bottom edge shows what is being edited, the open sketch's state in its color and the design's units; a click on the units changes them. The sketch's state then no longer shows in the view's corner.
简体中文: 窗口底边的一条细栏显示正在编辑的对象、打开的草图的状态（以其颜色显示）以及设计的单位；单击单位即可更改。草图的状态随后不再显示在视图的角落。

English (原文): Where the parts of the window sit.
Mouse and trackpad. The 3D mouse has its own page.
简体中文: 鼠标和触控板。3D 鼠标有单独的页面。

English (原文): Draws the view larger and filters it down: very crisp, and heavier.
简体中文: 以更高分辨率绘制后滤波缩小：更清晰，但负载更高。

English (原文): The accent follows the active tab
简体中文: 强调色跟随当前选项卡

English (原文): Double-click a design tab to rename it
简体中文: 双击设计选项卡以重命名

English (原文): Type the new name, then press Enter or click elsewhere to keep it, or Esc to cancel. Off: a double-click on a tab maximizes the window, as on the empty part of the bar.
简体中文: 输入新名称，然后按 Enter 或点击别处即可保留，按 Esc 取消。关闭时：双击选项卡会最大化窗口，与栏的空白处相同。

English (原文): Not applied: {error}. The last good theme stays on.
简体中文: 未应用：{error}。保留上次有效的主题。

English (原文): Followed for this run only (--theme-file); reloaded whenever another tool rewrites it.
简体中文: 仅本次运行跟随 (--theme-file)；其他工具改写文件时会重新加载。

English (原文): Reloaded whenever another tool rewrites it. Choosing a theme stops following it.
简体中文: 其他工具改写文件时会重新加载。选择主题将停止跟随。

English (原文): Click to choose a theme file, drop one here, or press Ctrl+V (Cmd+V on a Mac) with a theme copied
简体中文: 单击选择主题文件，拖放到此处，或复制主题后按 Ctrl+V（Mac 上为 Cmd+V）

English (原文): Blur behind translucent panels, in physical pixels. Zero is off.
简体中文: 半透明面板背后的模糊程度，以物理像素为单位。0 表示关闭。

English (原文): Saved value for {option} is invalid; using the theme default. The saved value is kept.
简体中文: {option} 的已保存值无效；正在使用主题默认值。已保存值将予以保留。

English (原文): Adjust floating panel opacity. A readability floor protects text over viewport colors.
简体中文: 调整浮动面板的不透明度。最低不透明度限制可确保文字在视口颜色上清晰可读。

English (原文): Use this theme’s panel and viewport colors for each ribbon tab.
简体中文: 为每个功能区选项卡使用主题的面板和视口颜色。

English (原文): Fade panel and viewport colors when switching tabs. Zero switches instantly.
简体中文: 切换选项卡时渐变面板和视口颜色。设为零可立即切换。

English (原文): This theme requires a newer SolidCraft. Upgrade, then reimport the original theme to recover its option definitions.
简体中文: 此主题需要更新版本的 SolidCraft。升级后，请重新导入原始主题以恢复其选项定义。

English (原文): The clipboard holds no SolidCraft theme
简体中文: 剪贴板中没有 SolidCraft 主题

English (原文): Add the item, or take it out again
Rotating two fingers on the trackpad turns the view about the up axis, around the point Orbit around sets. Off: the twist does nothing
简体中文: 在触控板上旋转两根手指，视图会绕向上轴、围绕“环绕”设定的点转动。关闭：旋转手势不起作用

English (原文): Zoom with two-finger scroll while holding
简体中文: 按住以下按键时用双指滚动缩放

English (原文): Hold only this key to zoom at the pointer with vertical scroll. Off keeps the existing scroll behavior.
简体中文: 仅按住此键并垂直滚动，即可以指针位置为中心缩放。关闭时保留现有滚动行为。

English (原文):
After every step: checks each sweep, boolean and blend.
Once per feature: checks each feature's result once.
Off (experimental): no check.
简体中文:
每一步之后：检查每次扫掠、布尔运算和倒圆。
每个特征一次：每个特征的结果检查一次。
关闭（实验性）：不检查。

English (原文): Extrude's Distance, Fillet's Radius... as a box in the view.
简体中文: 将拉伸距离、圆角半径等显示为视图中的输入框。

English (原文): OK and Cancel in the view's corner
简体中文: 在视图角落显示确定和取消

English (原文): While a dialog or a sketch is open, a check and a cross at the top right of the view do what the dialog's OK and Cancel do, or finish and cancel the sketch. The view navigator moves down below them.
简体中文: 打开对话框或草图时，视图右上角的勾号和叉号与对话框的确定和取消作用相同，或完成和取消草图。视图导航器会下移到它们下方。

English (原文): Show active analyses above the viewport and open their legends from each item. Turn off to restore corner legends.
简体中文: 在视口上方显示启用的分析，从各项目打开图例，并按 Esc 关闭最近启用的分析。关闭此选项可恢复角落图例和原来的 Esc 行为。

English (原文): Bodies are lit by a soft studio: metal and glossy appearances reflect it, other bodies get a satin sheen. Off: flat shading in their color, as before
简体中文: 实体由柔和的影棚光照亮：金属和光泽外观会反射它，其他实体呈现缎面光泽。关闭：按其颜色平面着色，与以前相同

English (原文): Show the section setting in the viewport. Escape and the active ribbon button turn it off. Disable to keep the previous section controls.
简体中文: 在视口中显示剖面设置。按 Escape 或单击活动的功能区按钮可关闭剖面。禁用以保留原有剖面控件。

English (原文): Edit active analysis and section settings in standard details cards. Disable to restore read-only analysis keys and the Section dialog.
简体中文: 在标准详情卡片中编辑当前分析和剖面设置。禁用后恢复只读分析图例和剖面对话框。

English (原文): Fold three or more viewport status items into one summary badge. Disable to keep every item in the full row.
简体中文: 将三个或更多视口状态项折叠为一个汇总徽章。禁用后，所有项目仍显示在完整的一行中。

English (原文): Pause drawing while the window is dragged, so it moves smoothly
简体中文: 拖动窗口时暂停绘制，使其平稳移动

English (原文): While you drag the window by its title bar, SolidCraft draws nothing and the window follows the pointer smoothly. Animations and progress pause until you let go. Off: SolidCraft keeps drawing during the drag, and the window can move unevenly.
简体中文: 通过标题栏拖动窗口时，SolidCraft 不绘制任何内容，窗口平稳地跟随指针。动画和进度会暂停，直到松开为止。关闭时：拖动期间 SolidCraft 继续绘制，窗口可能移动不均匀。
切换工作区时聚焦视图
缩放到模型表面时停止

English (原文): The 3D mouse and device app zoom toward the surface in the middle of the view; drag-zoom holds the point where the drag began. Off: zoom can pass through the model. Wheel and pinch use Zoom to the cursor separately
简体中文: 3D 鼠标和设备应用向视图中央的表面缩放；拖动缩放固定拖动开始时的点。关闭后可穿过模型。滚轮和捏合手势单独使用向光标缩放设置
{file} · {features} 个特征 · 自动保存于 {when}

English (原文): Changes that weren't saved when this page last closed are kept in this browser.
简体中文: 此页面上次关闭时未保存的更改保留在此浏览器中。
恢复未保存的设计：{name}，更改于{when}？

English (原文): One of its curved faces can't be used for modeling.
简体中文: 它的一个曲面无法用于建模。

English (原文): One of its flat faces can't be used for modeling.
简体中文: 它的一个平面无法用于建模。

English (原文): One of its freeform faces can't be used for modeling.
简体中文: 它的一个自由曲面无法用于建模。

English (原文): One of its rounded faces can't be used for modeling.
简体中文: 它的一个圆角面无法用于建模。

English (原文): Its faces don't meet closely enough to be used for modeling.
简体中文: 它的面贴合得不够紧密，无法用于建模。

English (原文): Pilot images guide allocation and are excluded from the final image. Production iterations use a separate budget for each pixel; the iteration count is not uniform samples per pixel.
简体中文: 预采样图像用于分配预算，不计入最终图像。正式采样为每个像素使用独立预算；迭代次数不表示所有像素具有相同的采样数。
自适应正式采样 · {current}/{target} 轮迭代
使用独立预采样分配样本

English (原文): Independent pilot samples are discarded, then choose 16 or more production samples per pixel up to Samples per pixel. CPU resource limits include both stages. RGB and coverage variance guide allocation; capped pixels can remain noisy. The final report counts actual samples.
简体中文: 独立的先导样本会被丢弃，随后为每个像素分配至少16个、不超过“每像素样本数”的正式样本。CPU资源限制包含两个阶段。RGB与覆盖率方差决定分配，达到上限的像素仍可能有噪点。最终报告记录实际样本数。

English (原文): Independent-pilot adaptive allocation is available for CPU and GPU. Conditional Fresnel strata require GPU. Statistical allocation does not certify convergence.
简体中文: CPU和GPU均支持独立先导样本的自适应分配。条件菲涅耳分层需要GPU。统计分配不保证收敛。

English (原文): One finite homogeneous GPU medium is available under explicit limits. Density grids, nested glass/volume combinations, subsurface surfaces, displacement, spectral transport and unbound advanced material concepts remain unavailable.
简体中文: 可使用具有明确限制的单个有限均匀 GPU 介质。尚不支持密度网格、嵌套玻璃与体积、次表面散射表面、置换、光谱传输及未实现的高级材料概念。
悬浮灰尘 / 参与介质

English (原文): Airborne dust is a separate finite homogeneous scattering volume. It changes transport and raw EXR, not the surface-aging stack. Existing volume/glass/denoising restrictions remain explicit; no atmosphere is added automatically.
简体中文: 悬浮灰尘是独立的有限均匀散射体积。改变光传输和原始 EXR，而不是表面层。保留体积与玻璃、降噪之间的限制；不自动添加大气。
所有符合条件的不透明实体

English (原文): No aging layers: the original surfaces remain unchanged.
简体中文: 没有老化层：保留原始表面。

English (原文): Combine up to eight optical layers, in order. Rust and patina are authored appearances, not age/corrosion simulations. Scale is in world millimeters. No geometry, mass or engineering property is changed; glass and passive stages are excluded.
简体中文: 按顺序组合最多8层光学外观。锈蚀和铜绿是艺术表现，不是老化或腐蚀模拟。尺度使用世界坐标毫米。不改变几何、质量或工程属性；排除玻璃和被动舞台。
场原点 · 世界坐标 mm

English (原文): Aging is applied by CPU ray tracing and GPU path tracing. Raster keeps schematic rendering.
简体中文: 老化效果适用于CPU光线追踪和GPU路径追踪。光栅保持示意渲染。

English (原文): A named target must still match its captured index and name. Global masks are world-anchored; they do not follow moving parts. This is neither cavity detection nor true edge wear. Filter the list to reach additional bodies.
简体中文: 指定目标必须匹配捕获时的索引和名称。遮罩固定于世界坐标，不随运动零件移动。不是凹槽检测或真实边缘磨损。筛选列表可查找其他实体。

English (原文): Dense inspection of all current controls. Section pages provide focused editing without changing the underlying request.
简体中文: 集中显示当前所有控件；各分页可针对相应任务编辑，不改变底层请求。

English (原文): Optical bindings target one whole body. Pick Body to edit these controls.
简体中文: 光学绑定针对单个完整实体。选择实体后可编辑这些控件。
需要 CPU 光线追踪。
放弃未保存的光学编辑

English (原文): Use physical glass on this body
简体中文: 对此实体使用物理玻璃

English (原文): Closed glass uses geometric distance. It cannot share a body with clear coat or maps.
简体中文: 封闭玻璃使用几何距离。同一实体不能同时使用清漆或贴图。
需要 GPU 路径追踪。

English (原文): Remove the saved optics from this shot. Geometry and assigned looks are kept.
简体中文: 从此镜头中移除已保存的光学设置。几何形状和已分配的外观保持不变。
移除已保存的光学设置？
替换此实体已保存的光学设置

English (原文): To save Glass, enable it on a current CPU or GPU body. Use Save coat to shot for clear coat. Local image files remain temporary.
简体中文: 要保存玻璃，请在当前CPU或GPU实体上启用它。清漆请使用“将清漆保存到镜头”。本地图像文件仍为临时设置。

English (原文): These optics are saved with this shot.
简体中文: 这些光学设置已随此镜头保存。

English (原文): Interior scattering needs a closed solid boundary.
简体中文: 内部散射需要封闭实体边界。

English (原文): These optics are temporary on this tab. Save them to keep them with the shot.
简体中文: 这些光学设置仅在此标签页临时生效。保存后可随镜头保留。

English (原文): Thickness applies to thin sheets; closed glass uses geometric distance.
简体中文: 厚度适用于薄片；封闭玻璃使用几何距离。

English (原文): Visual appearance does not assign density, thermal data or other engineering properties.
简体中文: 视觉外观不会分配密度、热学数据或其他工程属性。

English (原文): Click to apply to the selection; drag to preview and drop, or click with nothing selected to paint.
简体中文: 单击应用到所选对象；拖动预览并放置，未选择对象时单击进入涂刷。
原生组合；应用前请审阅

English (原文): Supported projection; see scope and omissions
简体中文: 支持的部分映射；请查看范围和省略项

English (原文): Reference data; not an automatic assignment
简体中文: 参考数据；不会自动分配

English (原文): Choose this backdrop or transparent PNG output; the renderer will not silently ignore either setting.
简体中文: 请选择此背景或透明 PNG 输出；渲染器不会暗中忽略任一设置。
使用相机专用渐变背景

English (原文): This screen-space backdrop does not illuminate, cast shadows, reflect or represent terrain. It is excluded from raw EXR. Geometry, lights and the HDR environment stay independent.
简体中文: 此屏幕空间背景不发光、不投影、不参与反射，也不代表地形；不包含在原始 EXR 中，与几何、灯光和 HDR 环境相互独立。
相机背景 · PNG 显示

English (原文): The displayed result is a frozen completed image. Editing a background does not repaint that result automatically. Use Regrade for camera-only changes, or Render for a new physical stage.
简体中文: 当前结果是已完成的固定图像。编辑背景不会自动重绘结果。相机背景请重新调整；物理舞台更改请重新渲染。

English (原文): The current HDR resources illuminate and reflect on surfaces; they are not automatically displayed as a panorama behind the subject. Changing a gradient does not rotate or recolor the lighting.
简体中文: 当前 HDR 资源用于照明和表面反射，不会自动作为主体后方的全景显示。改变渐变不会旋转或改变照明颜色。

English (原文): HDR illumination · separate from camera background
简体中文: HDR 照明 · 独立于相机背景

English (原文): A camera background is not added to transparent output silently. Raw-master regrading uses captured coverage and does not reapply denoising; the source EXR remains unchanged.
简体中文: 不会悄悄将相机背景添加到透明输出。母版重新调整使用已捕获的覆盖率，不再次降噪；原始 EXR 保持不变。

English (原文): Background color is presentation, not an additional lighting source.
