简体中文: 背景颜色仅用于呈现，不是额外光源。
应用于保留的原始母版

English (原文): This shot includes physical stage geometry. A large floor or wall can fill the frame and hide a camera-only background. Clear or resize the stage deliberately, or change its physical reflectance. Regrading cannot remove captured geometry.
简体中文: 此镜头包含物理舞台。大地面或墙壁可能覆盖画面并遮住相机背景。请明确清除或调整舞台，或改变其物理反射率。重新调整不能删除已捕获的几何。

English (原文): Choose the background you intend: a camera-only color/gradient, a physical stage that receives light, or HDR illumination. They are independent. Live Preview is a modeling view; render a new image or regrade a retained master to see camera finishing.
简体中文: 相机专用颜色/渐变、接收光照的物理舞台和 HDR 照明是独立设置。实时预览是建模视图；新建渲染或重新调整保留母版才能查看相机背景。

English (原文): One undoable visual assignment to the reviewed exact body. Existing face-specific looks and engineering materials remain separate.
简体中文: 对已确认的精确实体进行一次可撤销的外观分配；现有逐面外观和工程材料保持独立。

English (原文): This editor preserves opaque body semantics. Use the explicit glass controls for optical transmission.
简体中文: 此编辑器保留不透明实体语义；光学透射请使用明确的玻璃控件。

English (原文): Uses the current image settings with each saved shot camera, one shot at a time.
简体中文: 使用当前图像设置和各个已保存镜头的相机，逐个渲染镜头。

English (原文): Save a shot before rendering all shots.
简体中文: 渲染所有镜头前请先保存镜头。

English (原文): Render all shots is limited to 32 shots.
At most 32 document shot queues can be retained. Finish or cancel an existing queue first.
简体中文: 最多可保留32个文档的镜头队列。请先完成或取消现有队列。
{running} 个运行中 · {waiting} 个等待中

English (原文): Creative output-only glow from positive linear highlights, spread with three normalized box passes. Radius is in output pixels. Added in linear display light before sRGB; not a lens, volumetric effect or convergence improvement. The raw EXR is unchanged.
简体中文: 仅用于输出的创意辉光，将正线性高光经过三次归一化滤波扩散。半径以输出像素计，在 sRGB 前叠加；不模拟镜头或体积，也不改善收敛。原始 EXR 不变。

English (原文): Bloom requires opaque output. Transparent PNG is refused, not silently flattened.
简体中文: 泛光需要不透明输出；会拒绝透明 PNG，而非暗中合成背景。
浏览原创 HDR 环境
浏览已制作的灯光组合

English (原文): World millimeters; angles are displayed in degrees and saved as radians. Navigation uses the same camera as the viewport.
简体中文: 世界坐标以毫米为单位；角度显示为度、保存为弧度。导航与视口使用同一相机。

English (原文): Glass caustics from point and directional lights
简体中文: 点光源和方向光的玻璃焦散

English (原文): Photon count controls noise and work. Gather radius trades sharp detail for a smoother estimate. CPU requires Indirect lighting.
简体中文: 光子数控制噪点和计算量。增大收集半径可得到更平滑的估计，但会损失细节。CPU需要间接照明。

English (原文): CPU supports certified planar Glass sheets and axis-aligned boxes. General closed meshes, nesting and interior scattering require Indirect lighting. Closed transmitted shadows remain unsupported.
简体中文: CPU 支持经验证的平面玻璃薄片和轴对齐盒体。一般闭合网格、嵌套和内部散射需要间接光照。仍不支持穿过闭合玻璃的透射阴影。

English (原文): GPU supports certified disjoint Glass or explicit certified nesting. Nesting requires convex parents, strictly contained children and no touching boundaries.
简体中文: GPU 支持经验证的互不相交玻璃介质，或明确启用的经验证嵌套。嵌套要求外层物体为凸体、内层物体严格包含于其中，且边界互不接触。

English (原文): Density grids, displacement, full spectral integration and propagated polarization remain unavailable.
简体中文: 密度网格、置换、完整光谱积分和偏振状态传播仍不受支持。

English (原文): Active interior scattering needs a closed Glass medium, straight shadow transmission off and Denoise off. GPU also needs one Fresnel stratum. Active exterior Atmosphere cannot combine with Glass or surface Denoise.
简体中文: 启用内部散射需要闭合玻璃介质，并关闭直线阴影透射和降噪。GPU 还需要只使用一个菲涅耳分层。启用的外部大气不能与玻璃或表面降噪同时使用。

English (原文): Transparency: opaque surfaces only; background alpha is supported.
简体中文: 透明度：仅不透明表面；支持背景 Alpha。
透明度：排序 Alpha 近似。

English (原文): Add a look to edit its enabled state and strength.
简体中文: 添加风格以编辑启用状态和强度。

English (原文): These effects need GPU path tracing. Opening this never changes the method.
简体中文: 这些效果需要GPU路径追踪。打开此编辑器不会更改渲染方式。

English (原文): Enable independent pilots to edit the adaptive limits.
简体中文: 启用独立预采样以编辑自适应限制。

English (原文): Enable bloom to edit its strength, threshold and radius.
简体中文: 启用泛光以编辑强度、阈值和半径。

English (原文): Needs CPU ray tracing. Opening this never changes the method.
简体中文: 需要CPU光线追踪。打开此编辑器不会更改渲染方式。

English (原文): Choose Progressive to edit its sample count and seed.
简体中文: 选择渐进模式以编辑采样数和种子。

English (原文): Choose a look in Appearances first
简体中文: 请先在外观库中选择外观

English (原文): This coat edit is unsaved. Save it with the shot or discard it.
简体中文: 清漆编辑尚未保存。请保存到镜头或放弃编辑。

English (原文): Removes this target’s coat from the shot. Geometry, appearances and physical materials stay unchanged.
简体中文: 从镜头中移除此目标的清漆。几何、外观和物理材料保持不变。

English (原文): The saved coat changed. Discard this edit and reopen the target before editing it again.
简体中文: 已保存的清漆发生了变化。请放弃此编辑，重新打开目标后再编辑。

English (原文): Clear coat adds a glossy layer to opaque surfaces. Save it with the shot. Glass cannot share this target. CPU custom reflection and anisotropy overrides cannot share it either.
简体中文: 清漆为不透明表面添加光泽层。请随镜头保存。同一目标不能使用玻璃，也不能使用CPU自定义反射或各向异性覆盖。
{shot} · {width} × {height} · PNG · {seconds} 秒 · {renderer} · 捕获于修订版 {revision}

English (原文): Spatial samples: more samples improve edges and increase render time.
简体中文: 增加空间采样可改善边缘，但会增加渲染时间。
添加 CPU 矩形光源

English (原文): Full side vectors in millimeters; U cross V points toward the emitting side. This differs from GPU half-edge vectors.
简体中文: 完整边向量以毫米表示；U 叉乘 V 指向发光侧。这与 GPU 的半边向量不同。

English (原文): The scene changed. Confirm this reflection target again before rendering.
简体中文: 场景已更改。请在渲染前重新确认此反射目标。

English (原文): Refine the filter to see more bodies.
简体中文: 请缩小筛选范围以显示更多实体。

English (原文): A reflection target is missing, hidden, ambiguous or has a name longer than 512 bytes. Choose it again.
简体中文: 反射目标不存在、已隐藏、名称有歧义或超过512字节。请重新选择。

English (原文): Choose larger limits explicitly. Resolution and samples are never reduced automatically.
简体中文: 请明确选择更大的限制；不会自动降低分辨率或样本数。

English (原文): These are admission ceilings, not a RAM reservation or a speed guarantee. Geometry, film and retained previews share the memory budget; rendering remains cancelable.
简体中文: 这些是准入上限，不是预留内存或速度保证。几何、图像缓冲和保留的预览共用内存预算；渲染仍可取消。

English (原文): The draft exceeds this CPU profile or its camera-sample budget. Accept smaller dimensions explicitly or select a larger profile.
简体中文: 草稿超出此 CPU 配置或相机样本预算；请明确接受较小尺寸，或选择更大的配置。

English (原文): CPU ray tracing with indirect lighting · path depth {depth} · {spp} SPP · traced shadows · seed {seed} · 1 primary sample
简体中文: CPU 光线追踪与间接照明 · 路径深度 {depth} · {spp} SPP · 追踪阴影 · 种子 {seed} · 1 个主样本

English (原文): CPU ray tracing with indirect lighting
简体中文: CPU 光线追踪与间接照明

English (原文): Finite Sun and gradient Sky use CPU indirect lighting.
简体中文: 有限太阳和渐变天空使用 CPU 间接照明。

English (原文): Choose CPU ray tracing with indirect lighting to keep this Sun or Sky.
简体中文: 选择带间接照明的 CPU 光线追踪，以保留此太阳或天空。

English (原文): Keep GPU path tracing for the current transmission sample settings.
简体中文: 当前透射采样设置请继续使用 GPU 路径追踪。

English (原文): Check and Start verify the same file digest or use the embedded HDR. Each image keeps its captured source.
简体中文: 检查和开始会验证相同的文件哈希，或使用嵌入的HDR。每张图像保留各自捕获的源数据。

English (原文): The controls or model changed after this check. Check again before rendering.
简体中文: 设置或模型在上次检查后发生了变化。请在渲染前重新检查。

English (原文): Without Indirect lighting, this constant source can appear in reflections and through Glass. It does not light opaque surfaces. Enable Indirect lighting to use it for scene lighting.
简体中文: 未启用间接照明时，此恒定光源可能出现在反射中或透过玻璃可见，但不会照亮不透明表面。要用它照亮场景，请启用间接照明。

English (原文): Path depth {depth}; progressive sampling at {spp} samples/pixel (seed {seed}); one primary ray per sample; traced shadows. Keeps your image size, CPU budget and other settings.
简体中文: 路径深度 {depth}；每像素 {spp} 个样本的渐进采样（种子 {seed}）；每个样本一条主光线；光线追踪阴影。保留图像尺寸、CPU预算和其他设置。

English (原文): Constant radiance is visible to reflected or transmitted rays. It does not provide direct diffuse lighting.
简体中文: 恒定辐亮度作用于反射或透射光线，不提供直接漫反射照明。

English (原文): Replace preset with custom directional lights
简体中文: 用自定义平行光替代预设

English (原文): Reduces noise in every image update. It may soften fine detail and depth-of-field edges. Raw EXR is unchanged. Adjusting a completed image uses its raw image and does not apply noise reduction again.
简体中文: 每次图像更新时减少噪点，可能使细节和景深模糊边缘变柔。原始EXR保持不变。调整已完成的图像时使用其原始图像，不会再次降噪。

English (原文): The image background stays separate from environment lighting.
简体中文: 图像背景与环境照明分开设置。

English (原文): CPU intensity must be 0–64, HDR rotation finite within ±1,000,000 radians, and HDR samples 1, 4, 16 or 64.
简体中文: CPU强度须为0–64，HDR旋转须为±1,000,000弧度以内的有限值，HDR采样数为1、4、16或64。
用于次级光线的恒定环境

English (原文): CPU exposure must be between −16 and 16 EV. A GPU exposure outside that range is retained until you change it.
简体中文: CPU曝光必须在−16至16 EV之间。超出此范围的GPU曝光会保留，直到你修改。

English (原文): Radiance .hdr, 2:1 panorama, up to 2048 × 1024 and 16 MiB. CPU requires explicit sRGB/D65 primaries in the file; unspecified primaries and EXR are refused.
简体中文: 支持Radiance .hdr、2:1全景图，最大2048 × 1024、16 MiB。CPU要求文件明确声明sRGB/D65原色，不接受未指定原色或EXR。

English (原文): HDR rough reflections require fully metallic body and face surfaces. Check reports unsupported combinations.
简体中文: HDR粗糙反射要求实体及其面的表面完全为金属。检查会报告不支持的组合。

English (原文): Choose CPU ray tracing to enable this Indirect lighting mode.
简体中文: 请选择CPU光线追踪以启用此间接照明模式。

English (原文): Up to eight directional lights. An empty custom list turns them off; selecting a preset restores its lights. Colors are linear RGB and intensity is relative, not watts.
简体中文: 最多8个平行光。自定义列表为空时关闭平行光；选择预设可恢复预设光源。颜色为线性RGB，强度为相对值而非瓦特。

English (原文): CPU renders can use saved opaque maps: choose a surface here, then Save maps to shot. With Indirect lighting, Glass can be on another body; a mapped body cannot use Glass. Selected reflections, anisotropy and procedural surface effects must be off. Temporary map file paths use GPU.
简体中文: CPU 渲染可使用已保存的不透明表面贴图：在此选择表面，再将贴图保存到镜头。使用间接光照时，其他实体可以使用玻璃；带有贴图的实体不能使用玻璃。请关闭选定的反射、各向异性和程序化表面效果。临时贴图文件路径使用 GPU。

English (原文): CPU Check validates supported Glass geometry before rendering. Closed Glass uses geometric distance.
简体中文: CPU 检查会在渲染前验证所支持的玻璃几何体。封闭玻璃使用几何距离。

English (原文): CPU ray tracing uses an opaque background.
简体中文: CPU光线追踪使用不透明背景。

English (原文): CPU ray tracing needs an opaque background. Clear Transparent background to continue.
简体中文: CPU 光线追踪需要不透明背景。请关闭透明背景。

English (原文): This CPU panel cannot edit emission, surface effects, glass or anisotropy yet. Clear those API options before using it.
简体中文: 此CPU面板暂不支持编辑自发光、表面效果、玻璃或各向异性。使用前请清除这些API选项。

English (原文): Adds light bouncing between opaque surfaces and through supported Glass shapes. Requires progressive rendering and traced shadows. Path depth counts shaded surfaces, Glass boundaries and scattering events, starting with the first hit (1–64). Depth 1 gives direct lighting on opaque surfaces; higher values allow more bounces or Glass crossings and may take longer. Turn off Indirect lighting to use custom reflections or anisotropy.
简体中文: 计算在不透明表面之间反射并穿过受支持玻璃形状的光。需要渐进渲染和光线追踪阴影。路径深度从首次相交开始计算着色表面、玻璃边界和散射事件（1–64）。深度 1 只计算不透明表面的直接照明；更高的值允许更多反射或玻璃穿越，也可能耗时更长。使用自定义反射或各向异性时，请关闭间接照明。

English (原文): Your settings are kept. Turn off Indirect lighting to use custom reflections or anisotropy.
简体中文: 设置会保留。使用自定义反射或各向异性时，请关闭间接照明。

English (原文): Up to eight point lights, added to the selected directional lighting. Distances are in mm; the minimum must not exceed the reference distance.
简体中文: 最多可在所选平行光照明基础上添加8个点光源。距离单位为mm，最小距离不得大于参考距离。

English (原文): Adopting progressive uses one camera sample per pass. Image size, lights and reflection settings stay unchanged.
简体中文: 启用后每轮使用一个相机样本。图像大小、灯光和反射设置保持不变。

English (原文): Accumulate fresh CPU camera samples and show every complete pass. Selected reflections use one attempt per camera sample; certified glass and planar anisotropy keep their existing limits. Adaptive pilots and production share the CPU profile budget.
简体中文: 累积新的CPU相机样本并显示每个完整的渲染轮次。选定反射在每个相机样本中尝试一次；经认证的玻璃和平面各向异性保留原有限制。自适应先导样本和正式样本共享CPU配置预算。

English (原文): At most 1,048,576 pixels and 16,777,216 pixel × sample evaluations. Changing samples never resizes the image automatically.
简体中文: 最多1,048,576像素，像素×采样总数不超过16,777,216。更改采样数不会自动调整图像尺寸。

English (原文): Set selected reflection attempts to 1 before adopting progressive sampling.
简体中文: 启用渐进采样前，请将所选反射的尝试次数设为1。

English (原文): Changes size, production sample cap, seed and CPU resource profile. Camera, lens, lighting, GI depth and effects are kept.
简体中文: 更改尺寸、正式样本上限、种子和CPU资源配置。保留相机、镜头、照明、GI深度和效果。

English (原文): Enable progressive sampling below before choosing a CPU budget.
简体中文: 选择CPU预算前，请先在下方启用渐进采样。

English (原文): No bodies selected: scene reflections are off.
简体中文: 尚未选择实体，场景反射已关闭。

English (原文): Choose bodies and set Off, Mirror or Rough. Rough uses the assigned surface roughness. More samples and bounces increase time; this is bounded specular transport, not global illumination.
简体中文: 为实体选择关闭、镜面或粗糙反射。粗糙反射使用已指定的表面粗糙度。更多采样和反弹会增加耗时；这属于有界镜面传输，不计算全局照明。

English (原文): Up to 64 reflected bodies are supported.
Numeric light and environment settings are saved with the setup. Body reflections and HDR files remain temporary. Existing area-light and spot-cone values are retained.
简体中文: 照明和环境的数值设置会随配置保存。实体反射和HDR文件仍为临时设置。已有面光源和聚光锥数值会保留。

English (原文): Sky rotation must be finite within ±1,000,000 radians; intensity must be 0–100.
简体中文: 天空旋转必须为 ±1,000,000 弧度内的有限值；强度必须为 0–100。

English (原文): Enable indirect lighting for this rig
简体中文: 为此灯组启用间接光照

English (原文): This Sun rig needs indirect lighting at depth 8, traced shadows and one camera sample per pass. If progressive rendering is off, it starts at 16 samples per pixel with seed 0. Existing progressive settings and the resource profile are kept. Incompatible settings stop the apply without changing them.
简体中文: 此太阳灯组需要深度为8的间接光照、追踪阴影，以及每轮一个相机采样。如果渐进渲染关闭，则以每像素16个采样和种子0开始。保留现有渐进设置和资源配置。不兼容的设置会阻止应用，且不会被更改。

English (原文): This rig has area radiance {radiance}, above the CPU limit of 64. Its authored lighting is kept; choose another rig or GPU.
简体中文: 此灯组的面光源辐射亮度为{radiance}，超过CPU上限64。保留原有灯光，请选择其他灯组或GPU。

English (原文): CPU subsurface scattering needs Denoise off. Your settings are kept.
简体中文: CPU 内部散射需要关闭降噪。设置会保留。

English (原文): Scattering redirects light inside closed Glass. Positive rates need Indirect lighting with Denoise off. The rate is collisions per mm; 0 adds no scattering. Positive phase bias favors forward directions; negative favors backward.
简体中文: 散射会改变闭合玻璃内部的光线方向。正散射率需要开启间接光照并关闭降噪。散射率表示每毫米的碰撞次数；0 不增加散射。方向偏置为正时偏向前方，为负时偏向后方。

English (原文): CPU ray tracing · reflections · HDR · directional and point lights
简体中文: CPU光线追踪 · 反射 · HDR · 平行光与点光源

English (原文): Auto uses available CPU workers. One worker runs serially. More workers can need more memory.
简体中文: 自动模式使用可用的 CPU 工作线程。单线程按顺序执行。更多线程可能需要更多内存。

English (原文): Browser rendering uses one cooperative worker. The saved desktop worker choice is preserved.
简体中文: 浏览器渲染使用一个协作式工作线程。已保存的桌面线程选择会保留。

English (原文): Transparent PNG removes the background and keeps edge coverage. Body and face opacity must stay at 100%.
简体中文: 透明PNG移除背景并保留边缘覆盖率。实体和面的不透明度必须保持100%。

English (原文): CPU ray tracing · path depth {depth} · {spp} samples/pixel · seed {seed} · traced shadows. Keeps the authored atmosphere and image budget.
简体中文: CPU 光线追踪 · 路径深度 {depth} · 每像素 {spp} 个采样 · 种子 {seed} · 追踪阴影。保留已编写的大气和图像预算。

English (原文): CPU Atmosphere uses Indirect lighting. Zero extinction keeps the saved box without fog.
简体中文: CPU 大气使用间接照明。消光系数为零时，已保存的包围盒仍会保留，但不会产生雾。

English (原文): CPU ray tracing with indirect lighting
简体中文: 使用间接照明的 CPU 光线追踪

English (原文): These light, sampling or atmosphere settings cannot be transferred to this method. Your settings are kept.
简体中文: 这些灯光、采样或大气设置无法转移到此方式。您的设置会保留。

English (原文): Enable Indirect lighting to use CPU Atmosphere.
简体中文: 启用间接照明以使用 CPU 大气。
内部尺寸 {width} × {height} 下的像素计数。

English (原文): Collects eligible and skipped pixel counts even when denoising is off. Counts use the internal render size; the mask uses the output size.
简体中文: 即使关闭降噪，也会收集可滤波和跳过的像素数量。计数基于内部渲染尺寸；蒙版使用输出尺寸。

English (原文): Export the denoising mask as PNG, or return to the rendered image to copy it.
简体中文: 将降噪蒙版导出为 PNG，或返回渲染图像后复制图像。

English (原文): Enable denoising diagnostics and render an image to inspect its mask.
简体中文: 启用降噪诊断并渲染图像后，即可查看其蒙版。

English (原文): Filter eligible reflected and transmitted light. Turn off to denoise opaque surfaces only.
简体中文: 对符合条件的反射光和透射光进行过滤。关闭后，仅对不透明表面降噪。

English (原文): More passes smooth a wider area. Strength controls how much filtering each pass applies. Unsupported optical paths remain unfiltered.
简体中文: 更多轮次会平滑更大范围。强度控制每轮滤波的应用程度。不支持的光路保持未滤波状态。

English (原文): GPU lighting supports eight directional sources in total, including at most one soft Sun. Duplicate a hard directional light to add another distant source.
简体中文: GPU 总共支持八个平行光源，其中最多一个为柔和太阳光。复制硬阴影平行光可添加另一个远处光源。

English (原文): The current render draft has unapplied edits. Save them before switching, discard them explicitly, or keep editing.
简体中文: 当前渲染草稿有尚未应用的修改；切换前请保存、明确放弃，或继续编辑。
保留已编辑的渲染设置

English (原文): These effects require GPU path tracing. Changing the page never switches the renderer automatically.
简体中文: 这些效果需要 GPU 路径追踪。打开页面不会自动切换渲染器。

English (原文): Combine ordered color looks and image-space lens effects. Rendering and raw-master regrading use the same saved settings. Raw EXR stays unchanged. These are original artistic controls, not calibrated lens or branded-film emulations.
简体中文: 组合有序颜色风格和图像空间镜头效果。渲染和原始母版重新调整使用相同保存设置。原始 EXR 保持不变。这些是原创艺术控制，不是校准镜头或品牌胶片仿真。

English (原文): Environment visibility and background blur are not supported by the renderer yet.
简体中文: 渲染器尚不支持环境背景显示和模糊。

English (原文): Choose an environment in Studios and Environments before editing the lighting.
简体中文: 编辑照明前，请在摄影棚与环境中选择环境。

English (原文): Physical ground receives shadows as a finite diffuse surface. Shadow-only catching and ground reflections are not supported yet.
简体中文: 实体地面作为有限漫反射表面接收阴影。尚不支持仅捕捉阴影和地面反射。

English (原文): Illustrative sphere sample; not a preview of the selected environment.
简体中文: 球体示例，并非所选环境的预览。

English (原文): Drag the ring to rotate the lighting. Hold Shift to snap to 15°.
简体中文: 拖动圆环旋转照明。按住 Shift 以15°为增量吸附。

English (原文): Ground edits require raytracing and a single ground panel. Use Scene to edit other stage panels.
简体中文: 地面编辑需要光线追踪和单个地面面板。其他舞台面板请在场景中编辑。

English (原文): A backdrop is seen by the camera only. It never lights, casts shadows or reflects, and is refused with transparent output.
简体中文: 背景仅对相机可见，不参与照明、投影或反射，且不允许与透明输出同时使用。

English (原文): Blur is unavailable: the renderer has no backdrop blur setting.
简体中文: 模糊不可用：渲染器没有背景模糊设置。

English (原文): HDR file checked. Saving embeds these bytes.
简体中文: HDR 文件已检查。保存时将嵌入这些字节。

English (原文): Gradient backdrop needs GPU path tracing.
简体中文: 渐变背景需要 GPU 路径追踪。
需要 GPU 路径追踪。

English (原文): Treat unspecified primaries as linear sRGB
简体中文: 将未指定原色视为线性 sRGB

English (原文): Interpreting unspecified primaries needs GPU path tracing.
简体中文: 解释未指定原色需要 GPU 路径追踪。

English (原文): Center and radius apply to Radial mode.
简体中文: 中心和半径适用于径向模式。

English (原文): Removes the {count} passive panels from this shot. The camera backdrop stays.
简体中文: 从此镜头中移除 {count} 个被动面板。相机背景保持不变。

English (原文): Rotation needs an HDR source for CPU ray tracing.
简体中文: CPU 光线追踪的旋转需要 HDR 光源。

English (原文): Lighting samples are set by the GPU path tracing budget; this setting needs CPU ray tracing.
简体中文: GPU 光照采样由路径预算决定；此设置需要 CPU 光线追踪。

English (原文): Original sky gradient for lighting; not a calibrated atmosphere.
简体中文: 用于照明的原创天空渐变；并非经过校准的大气模型。

English (原文): Environment sources need CPU or GPU ray tracing.
简体中文: 环境光源需要 CPU 或 GPU 光线追踪。

English (原文): Physical stages need CPU or GPU ray tracing.
简体中文: 物理舞台需要 CPU 或 GPU 光线追踪。

English (原文): World backdrop is unavailable: camera visibility of the environment has no saved setting yet.
简体中文: 世界背景不可用：尚无保存环境相机可见性的设置。

English (原文): Environments require CPU or GPU ray tracing. Select it in the Output editor.
简体中文: 环境需要 CPU 或 GPU 光线追踪。请在输出编辑器中选择。

English (原文): product preview exceeds its captured-body bound
简体中文: 产品预览超出捕获实体数上限

English (原文): checkpoint dimensions differ from the captured request
简体中文: 检查点尺寸与捕获的请求不同

English (原文): image display cannot fit this device
简体中文: 图像显示无法适配此设备

English (原文): The render export document changed while choosing its destination
简体中文: 选择目标位置时渲染导出文档已更改

English (原文): product preview exceeds the face-appearance admission cap
简体中文: 产品预览超出面外观数量上限

English (原文): finish the modeling gesture before previewing
简体中文: 请先完成建模操作再预览

English (原文): finish the current modeling operation before entering Render
简体中文: 请先完成当前建模操作再进入渲染

English (原文): fixed studio preview requires exposure 0, environment rotation 0 and intensity 1
简体中文: 固定工作室预览要求曝光为 0、环境旋转为 0、强度为 1
产品几何数据大小溢出

English (原文): GPU product preview is unavailable on this host. Saved setups remain available.
简体中文: 此主机不支持 GPU 产品预览。已保存的设置仍可使用。
不支持的 GPU 采样数

English (原文): render image dimensions do not match its job
简体中文: 渲染图像尺寸与任务不匹配

English (原文): render image exceeds its captured resource profile
简体中文: 渲染图像超出捕获的资源配置
未绑定的交互式渲染命令
不是交互式图像任务操作
没有已完成的渲染图像
产品外观不透明度无效
不透明 PBR 要求不透明度为 1

English (原文): the selected recipe is not physical glass
简体中文: 所选配方不是物理玻璃

English (原文): product preview requires an installed device with a depth buffer
简体中文: 产品预览需要带深度缓冲区的设备

English (原文): invalid provisional render identity or sample count
简体中文: 临时渲染标识或采样数无效
质量映射超出原生限制

English (原文): quality projection requires the same explicit GPU method
简体中文: 质量映射要求相同的显式 GPU 方法

English (原文): render scene exceeds its body limit
简体中文: 渲染场景超出实体数上限
GPU 路径追踪器初始化异常

English (原文): setup worker stopped without returning a host
简体中文: 初始化任务停止且未返回主机

English (原文): source preview exceeds its byte envelope
简体中文: 源预览超出字节数上限
PBR 要求非零表面法线

English (原文): product preview exceeds its eight-million-triangle source bound
简体中文: 产品预览超出源数据八百万三角形上限
产品预览上传槽不可用
产品预览顶点内存分配失败

English (原文): product preview exceeds its {limit} MiB vertex payload envelope; geometry was not simplified
简体中文: 产品预览超出 {limit} MiB 顶点数据上限；未简化几何形状

English (原文): product preview packing differs from its admitted vertex payload
简体中文: 产品预览打包与允许的顶点数据不符

English (原文): Create a visible solid in Design to preview it here.
简体中文: 请在设计中创建可见实体以在此预览。

English (原文): CPU ray tracing and GPU path tracing can retain raw linear EXR. Compression, multilayer images and auxiliary render passes remain unavailable.
简体中文: CPU 光线追踪和 GPU 路径追踪可保留原始线性 EXR；压缩、多层和辅助通道仍未实现。
没有可用的镜头副本名称

English (原文): Glass roughness scatters transmitted rays. Dispersion and film color use three wavelength bands. Rough sheets require straight transmitted shadows off.
简体中文: 玻璃粗糙度会散射透射光线。色散和薄膜颜色使用三个波长波段。粗糙薄片需要关闭直线透射阴影。
准备着色器可能需要几分钟

English (原文): Samples, depth, seed and exposure are saved with this setup. Only the active image method is saved.
简体中文: 采样数、深度、种子和曝光会随此配置保存。仅保存当前图像方法。

English (原文): SolidCraft closed while setting it up on this graphics adapter last time, most likely inside the graphics driver, so it is not set up again by itself. Choose CPU ray tracing instead, or try again (a driver update also tries again).
简体中文: 上次在此图形适配器上设置时 SolidCraft 关闭了，很可能是在图形驱动程序内部，因此不会再自动设置。请改用 CPU 光线追踪，或重试（更新驱动程序后也会重试）。
GPU 路径追踪器不可用

English (原文): The first setup on this GPU can take several minutes; SolidCraft stays usable meanwhile. Later starts reuse the compiled shaders where the driver keeps them.
简体中文: 首次在此 GPU 上设置可能需要几分钟，期间 SolidCraft 仍可正常使用。之后启动时，如果驱动程序保留了已编译的着色器，将直接复用。

English (原文): GPU path tracer setup has not started.
简体中文: GPU路径追踪器的设置尚未开始。
GPU 路径追踪器：正在编译着色器…

English (原文): GPU path tracing is not ready on this device.
简体中文: 此设备上的 GPU 路径追踪尚未就绪。

English (原文): Changing graphics API restarts SolidCraft and asks you to save unsaved designs. If the new API cannot open the window, the previous choice is restored on the next start.
简体中文: 更改图形 API 将重启 SolidCraft，并提示保存未保存的设计。如果新 API 无法打开窗口，下次启动时将恢复之前的选择。

English (原文): GPU path tracing needs Vulkan in this session. Restart with Vulkan, or keep using a CPU image method.
简体中文: 本次会话的 GPU 路径追踪需要 Vulkan。请使用 Vulkan 重启，或继续使用 CPU 图像方式。
漫反射率 · 线性 RGB

English (原文): Rendering uses the bytes included in the design; the original file is no longer needed.
简体中文: 渲染使用设计内保存的字节，不再需要原始文件。

English (原文): HDR file checked. Save will embed these bytes; if the file changes, check it again explicitly.
简体中文: 已检查HDR文件。保存时会嵌入这些字节；若文件发生变化，请明确重新检查。

English (原文): Select and check an HDR file before saving or rendering.
简体中文: 保存或渲染前，请选择并检查HDR文件。

English (原文): The source declares its color primaries.
简体中文: 源文件声明了颜色原色。

English (原文): The source does not declare primaries; review the renderer color requirements.
简体中文: 源文件未声明原色；请查看渲染器的颜色要求。

English (原文): This design is missing the saved HDR resource.
简体中文: 此设计缺少已保存的HDR资源。

English (原文): CPU preview image · PNG · approximate transparency
简体中文: CPU 预览图像 · PNG · 近似透明度

English (原文): Try a smaller image or simpler scene.
简体中文: 请尝试更小的图像或更简单的场景。

English (原文): Finish the modeling gesture or refresh the scene before checking or starting an image.
简体中文: 检查或开始图像前，请完成建模操作或刷新场景。

English (原文): This image uses the scene captured before subsequent changes.
简体中文: 此图像使用后续更改之前捕获的场景。

English (原文): Render request is supported; the queue and memory pool are checked again at start.
简体中文: 支持此渲染请求；开始时将再次检查队列和内存池。

English (原文): Over the image limit: 4096 pixels per side and 4,194,304 pixels in all.
简体中文: 超出图像限制：每边 4096 像素，总计 4,194,304 像素。

English (原文): Use the largest size at this aspect:
简体中文: 使用此宽高比下的最大尺寸：
包含被动反光板和遮光板

English (原文): Finish and optical fields use opaque PBR (opacity 1). Lower opacity uses scalar shading.
简体中文: 表面处理和光学字段使用不透明 PBR（不透明度为 1）。降低不透明度会使用标量着色。

English (原文): Pick a target of this type to inspect its appearance.
简体中文: 拾取此类型的目标以检查其外观。

English (原文): Mixed appearances. Editing sets the look on all selected targets.
简体中文: 外观混合。编辑会将外观设置到所有选定目标。

English (原文): Select at most 10000 targets to inspect appearances.
简体中文: 最多选择 10000 个目标以检查外观。

English (原文): Flare uses up to four separated bright sources in the actual linear image. Ghosts, halo, streaks, chromatic offsets and radial distortion are artistic image-space approximations. Spatial effects need opaque output; outside samples extend the image edge. Grain is deterministic. No physics, EXR or geometry is altered.
简体中文: 耀斑使用实际线性图像中最多4个分离的明亮光源。鬼影、光晕、光条、色差和畸变是图像空间的艺术近似。空间效果需要不透明输出；边界外采样延伸边缘颜色。颗粒具有确定性。不改变物理、EXR 或几何。

English (原文): Resource projection applied. Check the complete render request before starting.
简体中文: 资源映射已应用；开始前请检查完整渲染请求。
使用此 HDR 环境保存

English (原文): Click to apply · drag onto the model
简体中文: 点击应用 · 拖到模型上
使用已制作的 GPU 表面贴图
保存已制作的工作室映射

English (原文): Original authored resources are illustrative, not measured engineering data. Each action applies only its stated projection.
简体中文: 原创制作资源用于示意，不是实测工程数据；每项操作仅应用其声明的映射。

English (原文): Use emitters only; omit the documented passive cards
简体中文: 仅使用发光体；省略已说明的被动反光板

English (原文): No matching resources. Try a different query or availability filter.
简体中文: 没有匹配的资源；请更改搜索词或可用性筛选。

English (原文): Embeds the original HDR in the saved setup. The authored longitude origin is converted explicitly; no external file is needed after saving.
简体中文: 将原始 HDR 嵌入已保存设置。明确转换创作时的经度原点；保存后不再需要外部文件。

English (原文): Select to inspect; nothing is applied automatically. Favorites and recent history belong to this open document session.
简体中文: 选择仅用于检查，不会自动应用；收藏和最近记录属于当前打开的文档会话。

English (原文): Built-in maps can be saved with pinned sources and local occurrence mapping. Temporary optical overrides remain a separate mode.
简体中文: 内置贴图可连同固定源和局部实例映射一起保存；临时光学覆盖仍属于独立模式。

English (原文): Replace saved lighting, environment and stage
简体中文: 替换已保存的照明、环境和舞台

English (原文): Fit once at an explicit center and physical extent. Complete rigs include passive cards; calibration blockers still refuse. Conservative emitter/card clearance is checked before saving.
简体中文: 在明确的中心和物理范围下适配一次。完整组合包含被动反光板；需要校准时仍会拒绝。保存前检查发光体及反光板的保守间隙。

English (原文): Choose a resource in the Library to inspect its supported actions and limitations.
简体中文: 在资源库中选择资源，以查看支持的操作和限制。

English (原文): Authored base-color source map. This is not a rendered or measured material preview.
简体中文: 这是制作的基础颜色源贴图，不是渲染图像或实测材质预览。

English (原文): Specification only: not a complete executable preset. Required effects, resources and subject roles still need explicit implementation and binding.
简体中文: 仅为规格，不是完整可执行预设；所需效果、资源和主体角色仍需明确实现和绑定。
已制作的 PBR 表面

English (原文): Use the uniform approximation without spatial or advanced effects
简体中文: 使用不含空间或高级效果的均匀近似

English (原文): Changing the light coordinate frame is not supported yet.
简体中文: 暂不支持更改灯光坐标系。

English (原文): Choose CPU ray tracing or an explicit GPU studio to edit lights. Legacy GPU studio lights remain read-only.
简体中文: 请选择 CPU 光线追踪或明确的 GPU 灯光棚以编辑灯光。旧版 GPU 灯光棚为只读。

English (原文): Point and Spot lights are available with CPU ray tracing.
简体中文: 点光和聚光可用于 CPU 光线追踪。

English (原文): This light has hard shadows; emitter softness is unavailable.
简体中文: 此灯光仅支持硬阴影，无法调整光源柔和度。

English (原文): This light no longer exists. Select a light in the Browser.
简体中文: 此灯光已不存在。请在浏览器中选择灯光。

English (原文): Highlight placement needs viewport light picking and is not supported yet.
简体中文: 按高光放置需要视口灯光拾取，目前尚不支持。

English (原文): Live view is unshadowed; Area lights use a center-sample approximation. Render uses the complete light model.
简体中文: 实时视图不含阴影，区域光使用中心采样近似；渲染使用完整灯光模型。

English (原文): Light positions and directions use world coordinates. Orbiting the camera does not move them.
简体中文: 光源的位置和方向使用世界坐标。环绕旋转相机不会移动光源。

English (原文): Approximate blackbody tint; saved as linear RGB.
简体中文: 近似黑体色调，以线性 RGB 保存。

English (原文): Solo and mute affect this view and its renders; they are never saved in the design.
简体中文: 独显和静音仅影响此视图及其渲染，不会保存到设计中。

English (原文): Counts are read-only. Add, duplicate or delete lights to change them; the method sets the limits.
简体中文: 数量为只读。通过添加、复制或删除灯光来更改；上限由渲染方式决定。

English (原文): Replace the directional lights with this preset
简体中文: 用此预设替换平行光源

English (原文): Choosing Custom turns the preset into editable lights, one row each in the tree.
简体中文: 选择自定义后，预设将变为可编辑灯光，每个灯光在树中占一行。

English (原文): Or type a direction toward the light (X Y Z).
简体中文: 或输入朝向光源的方向 (X Y Z)。

English (原文): Intensity is quoted at the reference distance.
简体中文: 强度以参考距离处的数值表示。

English (原文): Directional studio presets require CPU ray tracing. GPU lighting uses explicit Sun and Area lights.
简体中文: 平行光摄影棚预设需要 CPU 光线追踪。GPU 照明使用显式的太阳光和面光源。

English (原文): Replaces the directional light list. Keeps point and area lights, environment, shadows, camera and all other shot settings.
简体中文: 替换平行光源列表。保留点光源、面光源、环境、阴影、相机及其他镜头设置。

English (原文): Area-light samples apply to CPU ray tracing.
简体中文: 面光源采样仅适用于 CPU 光线追踪。

English (原文): Add a CPU area light to set area samples.
简体中文: 添加 CPU 面光源以设置采样数。
面光源采样数必须为 1、4、16 或 64。

English (原文): The shadow switch requires CPU ray tracing. GPU path tracing always casts shadows.
简体中文: 阴影开关需要 CPU 光线追踪。GPU 路径追踪始终投射阴影。

English (原文): This point light retains its saved spot cone until its type is changed.
简体中文: 此点光源保留已保存的聚光锥，直到更改其类型。

English (原文): Sun direction is independent of distance and aim point.
简体中文: 太阳光方向与距离和目标点无关。
世界坐标 X Y Z

English (原文): Keeps a 32-bit float RGBA master before denoising, exposure, tone mapping, filters and backdrop. Linear sRGB/D65; coverage-premultiplied. Additional memory is admitted explicitly. No compression or extra passes.
简体中文: 保留降噪、曝光、色调映射、滤镜和背景处理前的 32 位浮点 RGBA。线性 sRGB/D65，预乘覆盖率。额外内存经明确准入检查；无压缩或额外通道。

English (原文): The selected completed frame has no retained EXR. Enable retention before rendering; an older PNG cannot recover raw radiance.
简体中文: 所选已完成图像没有保留 EXR。请在渲染前启用保留；旧 PNG 无法恢复原始辐亮度。

English (原文): The render request changed while live rendering was stopping. Start the final image again.
简体中文: 停止实时渲染时渲染请求已更改。请重新开始最终图像渲染。

English (原文): Preparing final image · releasing live-render resources
简体中文: 正在准备最终图像 · 释放实时渲染资源

English (原文): Live rendering needs a positive output width and height.
简体中文: 实时渲染需要正的输出宽度和高度。
实时 · 已暂停 · 已过时

English (原文): Interactive quality: at most 512 pixels on the longest edge. Uses the selected renderer and its supported effects. Final resolution, settings and export remain separate.
简体中文: 交互质量：最长边最多为 512 像素。使用所选渲染器及其支持的效果。最终分辨率、设置和导出保持独立。

English (原文): Shows the last captured image while live rendering updates or is unavailable. It may differ from the current scene or image settings.
简体中文: 实时渲染更新或不可用时显示上次捕获的图像。它可能与当前场景或图像设置不同。

English (原文): Open Output to edit the renderer and image settings.
简体中文: 打开输出以编辑渲染器和图像设置。

English (原文): Live · Interactive quality (up to 512 px) · Updating
简体中文: 实时 · 交互质量（最多 512 px）· 正在更新

English (原文): The live-render capture worker stopped before returning a result
简体中文: 实时渲染捕获工作线程在返回结果之前已停止
吸收 R · G · B（每毫米）

English (原文): Closed glass uses geometric distance. Topology, orientation, overlap and optical boundaries are checked during GPU preparation; Check only admits the request.
简体中文: 封闭玻璃使用几何距离。拓扑、朝向、重叠和光学边界在 GPU 准备时验证；检查仅验证请求准入。

English (原文): Clear coat over the base material
简体中文: 基础材质上的透明涂层

English (原文): Illustrative dielectric coating over the existing opaque appearance. Zero weight leaves the base unchanged.
简体中文: 在现有不透明外观上叠加示意介电涂层。权重为零时保持基础材质不变。
基础贴图替换实体颜色

English (原文): Temporary image-file maps require GPU. CPU can use saved built-in surface maps.
简体中文: 临时图像文件贴图需要GPU。CPU可以使用已保存的内置表面贴图。

English (原文): Turn on Indirect lighting for supported closed Glass shapes, certified nesting and subsurface scattering. Thin sheets can pass shadows. Otherwise use a planar sheet or axis-aligned box. Touching shapes and transmitted shadows through closed Glass remain unsupported. Your values are kept.
简体中文: 启用间接光照可使用受支持的闭合玻璃形状、经验证的嵌套结构及内部散射。薄片可以透射阴影。否则请使用平面薄片或轴对齐盒体。仍不支持相互接触的形状及穿过闭合玻璃的透射阴影。设置值会保留。

English (原文): Saved CPU optics cannot combine with legacy temporary optical bindings. Save the reviewed optics or remove the conflicting temporary binding.
简体中文: 已保存的CPU光学设置不能与临时光学绑定组合。请保存已审阅的设置或移除冲突的临时绑定。
使用这些 GPU 材质设置

English (原文): Up to 128 matching bodies are shown. Refine the filter for large scenes.
简体中文: 最多显示 128 个匹配实体。大型场景请细化筛选条件。

English (原文): Use physical glass on this body
简体中文: 对此实体使用物理玻璃

English (原文): Glass cannot share a body with clear coat or runtime maps in this renderer.
简体中文: 此渲染器不支持在同一实体上同时使用玻璃与透明涂层或贴图。

English (原文): Original illustrative recipes. Swatches show transmittance, not a rendered preview. Absorption is −ln(linear transmittance) / reference distance; alpha is unchanged.
简体中文: 原创示意配方。色样表示透射率，并非渲染预览。吸收系数为 −ln(线性透射率)/参考距离；不改变透明度。

English (原文): These active material overrides require GPU path tracing. Select GPU or disable the overrides before Check or Start.
简体中文: 启用的设置需要 GPU 路径追踪。检查或开始前请选择 GPU，或停用这些设置。

English (原文): At most 128 body overrides, 32 disjoint glass bodies, 64 coats and 128 texture bindings. Identical maps share storage; actual device and total memory limits still apply.
简体中文: 最多 128 个实体设置、32 个分离的玻璃实体、64 个涂层和 128 个纹理绑定。相同贴图共享内存；实际设备和总内存限制仍然有效。

English (原文): Map paths must be bounded local paths; normal strength must be finite and between 0 and 1.
简体中文: 贴图必须使用有长度限制的本地路径；法线强度必须是 0 到 1 之间的有限值。

English (原文): Choose a color image or a normal image before using maps.
简体中文: 使用贴图前请选择颜色图像或法线图像。

English (原文): Enable maps for this opaque body
简体中文: 为此不透明实体启用贴图

English (原文): PNG/JPEG up to 1024×1024; 16 MiB encoded total. U and V are orthogonal world-mm repeat vectors (maximum 128 repeats). Color is sRGB; normal data uses OpenGL +Y. Files are captured at Check/Start.
简体中文: PNG/JPEG 最大 1024×1024，编码数据总计不超过 16 MiB。U/V 是世界毫米单位的正交重复向量（最多 128 次）。颜色使用 sRGB，法线使用 OpenGL +Y。检查/开始时捕获文件。
映射原点 X · Y · Z（mm）

English (原文): Physical Glass requires CPU ray tracing or GPU path tracing.
简体中文: 物理玻璃需要CPU光线追踪或GPU路径追踪。

English (原文): Scene changed. Refresh the body list before adding a target.
简体中文: 场景已变化。添加目标前请刷新实体列表。

English (原文): One U repeat X · Y · Z (mm)
简体中文: U 单次重复向量 X · Y · Z（mm）

English (原文): One V repeat X · Y · Z (mm)
简体中文: V 单次重复向量 X · Y · Z（mm）

English (原文): This assignment belongs to an earlier scene revision. Revalidate its exact body identity before rendering.
简体中文: 此分配属于较早的场景版本。渲染前请重新验证实体的确切身份。

English (原文): These optical edits are unsaved. Save reviewed values, remove the saved assignment, or discard the edits. Legacy temporary bindings and unsupported effects cannot override the saved target.
简体中文: 这些光学编辑尚未保存。请保存已审阅的值、移除已保存的分配或放弃编辑。临时绑定和不支持的效果不能覆盖已保存的目标。

English (原文): The body ordinal and name no longer match. Remove this assignment and explicitly choose the intended body again.
简体中文: 实体序号与名称不再匹配。请删除此分配，并重新明确选择目标实体。

English (原文): Temporary optical overrides for this document tab. They are not saved in the design, render setup or material library.
简体中文: 此文档标签页的临时光学设置，不保存到设计、渲染设置或材质库中。

English (原文): Texture V points upward in the image
简体中文: 纹理 V 轴指向图像上方

English (原文): Compensate for light lost between rough metal microfacets. CPU rendering needs Indirect lighting.
简体中文: 补偿粗糙金属微表面之间损失的光能。CPU 渲染需要间接照明。

English (原文): Raster uses the fixed opaque studio preview. Select an explicit raytracing method for supported optical controls.
简体中文: 光栅化使用固定的不透明工作室预览；要使用受支持的光学控件，请明确选择光线追踪方式。

English (原文): The camera moves as in Design (Preferences › Navigation). Save Setup records the current camera.
简体中文: 相机的操作与设计中相同（首选项 › 导航）。保存设置会记录当前相机。

English (原文): Up to 16 containing layers; every parent must be convex and every child strictly inside it. Intersections, touching surfaces, thin sheets and straight-shadow transmission refuse. Camera-inside state follows the certified hierarchy. Does not create a liquid surface or merge touching CAD boundaries.
简体中文: 最多16层包含关系。父体必须凸，子体必须严格位于内部。拒绝相交、接触、薄片和直线透射阴影。内部相机使用经验证的层次结构。不会创建液面或合并接触的CAD边界。

English (原文): Preview PNG · opaque PBR · blended transparency
简体中文: 预览 PNG · 不透明 PBR · 混合透明

English (原文): Opaque PBR and simple colors; blended transparency. Refraction, HDRI and final rendering are not available yet.
简体中文: 不透明 PBR 和纯色；透明效果使用混合。不支持折射、HDRI 和最终渲染。

English (原文): Replace this target’s saved optics explicitly
简体中文: 明确替换此目标的已保存光学设置

English (原文): Save these optics to the setup
简体中文: 将此光学设置保存到场景

English (原文): Exact definition, feature and occurrence identity survives offline reopen. Missing/replaced/hidden targets refuse; engineering materials are unchanged. Save or discard numeric edits before removing a saved target.
简体中文: 定义、特征及实例的确切标识在离线重开后保留。拒绝缺失、替换或隐藏的目标；工程材料保持不变。移除目标前先保存或放弃数值编辑。

English (原文): Run Check to review this request without starting a render.
简体中文: 运行检查可审查此请求，而不启动渲染。

English (原文): Choose the destination file when exporting the completed image.
简体中文: 导出已完成的图像时选择目标文件。

English (原文): EXR output setup is unavailable here. Linear EXR export requires a completed GPU image with a retained linear master.
简体中文: 此处无法设置 EXR 输出。线性 EXR 导出需要保留线性母版的已完成 GPU 图像。

English (原文): PNG is the exact completed display image. Optional CPU/GPU EXR retains raw scene-linear FLOAT32 radiance before display filters. Export never substitutes the preview cache or a different job.
简体中文: PNG 是完成的显示图像。可选 CPU/GPU EXR 保留显示滤镜前的原始线性 FLOAT32 辐亮度；导出不会替换成预览缓存或其他任务。

English (原文): Select a completed image with raw EXR data to export EXR. Enable raw EXR before rendering new images.
简体中文: 要导出EXR，请选择包含原始EXR数据的已完成图像。渲染新图像前请先启用原始EXR。

English (原文): The requested image exceeds the selected resource envelope. Choose a compatible size or profile explicitly; no automatic downgrade occurs.
简体中文: 请求图像超出所选资源范围；请明确选择兼容尺寸或配置，不会自动降级。

English (原文): CPU image effects and EXR output support images up to 8192 pixels wide or high, with at most 16,777,216 pixels in total.
简体中文: CPU图像效果和EXR输出支持宽度、高度均不超过8192像素且总像素数不超过16,777,216的图像。

English (原文): Format, quality and the Check list are in the Output editor.
简体中文: 格式、质量和检查列表位于输出编辑器中。

English (原文): The linked dimension exceeds this method’s size limit. The previous size is retained; unlock the ratio or choose a smaller value.
简体中文: 关联尺寸超出此方式的上限；保留原尺寸。请解锁宽高比或选择较小值。

English (原文): Image effects require CPU ray tracing or GPU path tracing.
简体中文: 图像效果需要CPU光线追踪或GPU路径追踪。

English (原文): {method}: up to {dimension} px per side and {pixels} pixels. Largest fitting size: {width} × {height}.
简体中文: {method}：每边最多 {dimension} px，总计 {pixels} 像素。可用的最大尺寸：{width} × {height}。

English (原文): To render {width} × {height}, choose {method} with the {profile} CPU resource profile, or a smaller size.
简体中文: 要渲染 {width} × {height}，请选择 {method} 和“{profile}”CPU 资源配置，或选择更小的尺寸。

English (原文): To render {width} × {height}, choose the {profile} CPU resource profile, or a smaller size.
简体中文: 要渲染 {width} × {height}，请选择“{profile}”CPU 资源配置，或选择更小的尺寸。

English (原文): Edit size and format in the Output inspector.
简体中文: 请在输出检查器中编辑尺寸和格式。

English (原文): Finite passive panels belong only to rendered images. They do not add CAD bodies or mass. Placement is fixed after applying; intersecting product bounds refuse. CPU does not provide diffuse bounce lighting.
简体中文: 有限的被动面板仅属于渲染图像，不增加 CAD 实体或质量。应用后位置固定，与主体边界相交时会拒绝。CPU 不提供漫反射间接照明。

English (原文): I understand this partial reference needs grade, condition and source review
简体中文: 我理解此部分参考仍需审阅牌号、条件和来源

English (原文): Real passive floor and wall, separate from the camera backdrop. Cyclorama uses 24 polygonal strips; it is not an infinite or analytically smooth surface. Replaces the saved stage only with your consent.
简体中文: 真实的被动地面和墙面，独立于相机背景。弧形背景采用 24 条多边形带近似，不是无限面或解析光滑表面；仅在确认后替换已保存的舞台。

English (原文): Copy plan with sources and omissions
简体中文: 复制包含来源和省略项的计划

English (原文): Properties not representable in the native card
简体中文: 原生材料卡无法表示的属性

English (原文): Read-only plan prepared. No material was created or assigned. Keep its extended profile and omissions when reviewing the native card.
简体中文: 只读计划已准备，未创建或分配材料。审阅原生材料卡时请保留其扩展配置和省略项。

English (原文): Appearance is not material identification. These are sourced references, not certified effective properties. Existing mass, engineering materials and optics are unchanged.
简体中文: 外观不等于材料识别。这些是有来源的参考，不是经认证的等效属性。现有质量、工程材料和光学设置保持不变。

English (原文): No numerical candidate is established. Grade, formulation or construction must be specified; unknown is not zero.
简体中文: 尚未确定数值候选资料。必须指定牌号、配方或构造；未知不等于零。

English (原文): Choose Body, Face or Component. Click empty space to clear; Shift or Ctrl adds or toggles. Highlights appear only in the live product view.
简体中文: 选择实体、面或组件。单击空白处清除选择；Shift 或 Ctrl 可添加或切换选择。高亮仅显示在实时产品视图中。

English (原文): Click an object to pick up its look
Product picking is not supported yet.

Creative presentation only. RGB gains precede tone mapping; contrast, saturation and vignette follow in display-linear light. Start Render creates new transport samples. Regrade uses the selected retained raw master without denoising or new rays.
简体中文: 仅调整显示。RGB 增益在色调映射前应用，对比度、饱和度和暗角在其后以显示线性光应用。渲染生成新样本；重新调整使用保留的原始母版，不降噪或追踪新光线。

English (原文): Render preparation cleanup failed. This window cannot prepare another image.
简体中文: 渲染准备清理失败。此窗口无法再准备其他图像。

English (原文): Presentation effects work with CPU and GPU ray tracing. Opening this page never changes the method.
简体中文: 图像效果支持CPU和GPU光线追踪。打开此页面不会更改渲染方式。

English (原文): Raster shading and blended transparency. Refraction, HDRI and final rendering are not available yet.
简体中文: 光栅着色和混合透明度。暂不支持折射、HDRI 和最终渲染。

English (原文): Live Preview keeps fixed studio lighting. Exposure and image lighting apply to the image job when you Check or Start.
简体中文: 实时预览使用固定工作室照明。曝光和图像照明在检查或开始时应用于图像任务。

English (原文): The live preview shows direct light only and no shadows.
简体中文: 实时预览仅显示直接光照，不显示阴影。

English (原文): The live preview is unavailable. Saved setups and image-job controls remain accessible. Change the scene or explicitly retry; a refused scene is not rebuilt on every frame.
简体中文: 实时预览不可用，但已保存设置和图像任务控件仍可访问。请修改场景或明确重试；被拒绝的场景不会每帧重建。

English (原文): Exact preview vertex bytes, not total GPU or process memory. Geometry is not simplified. Image jobs use their own admission and lighting.
简体中文: 这是精确的预览顶点字节数，不是 GPU 或进程总内存；几何不会简化。图像任务使用各自的准入检查和照明。

English (原文): Preview PNG · PBR and glass · progressive samples
简体中文: 预览 PNG · 不透明 PBR · 渐进采样

English (原文): Acknowledge the fixed-budget projection and omissions
简体中文: 确认固定预算映射和省略项

English (原文): Sets size, samples, depth, seed and noise reduction. Other image settings are kept.
简体中文: 设置尺寸、采样数、深度、种子和降噪。其他图像设置保持不变。

English (原文): Saved value: {samples} spp. New selections are limited to {maximum} spp.
简体中文: 已保存的值：{samples} spp。新选择的上限为 {maximum} spp。

English (原文): This preset exceeds the 16384 spp selection limit. Choose a sample count up to 16384.
简体中文: 此预设超过 16384 spp 的选择上限。请选择不超过 16384 的采样数。

English (原文): This review changes only resolution, sample budget, path depth, seed and noise reduction. Other settings are kept; the budget does not certify convergence.
简体中文: 此检查仅更改分辨率、采样预算、路径深度、种子和降噪。其他设置保持不变，预算不保证收敛。
{width} × {height} · {samples} 次采样 · 深度 {depth} · 种子 {seed} · {denoise}

English (原文): There is no automatic production queue or animation renderer in this UI. Completed still images remain separately exportable.
简体中文: 此界面没有自动生产队列或动画渲染器；已完成的静止图像仍可单独导出。
重新调整原始母版（不降噪）

English (原文): Creates a separate PNG from the selected completed raw master, using these presentation controls. Does not trace rays, change the captured size/camera/lights, or overwrite the EXR. Denoising is not reapplied: raw masters do not retain its guides. The derivative remains exportable through the same job controls.
简体中文: 根据所选已完成原始母版和这些显示设置创建独立 PNG。不追踪光线，不改变已捕获的尺寸、相机或灯光，也不覆盖 EXR。原始母版不保留降噪辅助数据，因此不重新降噪。可通过相同任务控件导出派生结果。

English (原文): Replace an existing saved binding for this target
简体中文: 替换此目标已有的保存绑定

English (原文): One image pixel per display pixel.
简体中文: 一个图像像素对应一个屏幕像素。

English (原文): The captured model revision is current.
简体中文: 捕获的模型版本为当前版本。

English (原文): No completed image yet. Check the settings, then start a render.
简体中文: 尚无已完成的图像。请检查设置，然后开始渲染。

English (原文): Pan and zoom use Navigation preferences. Space + drag pans.
简体中文: 平移和缩放遵循导航设置。按住空格键并拖动可平移。

English (原文): Open the completed image in the main canvas.
简体中文: 在主画布中打开已完成的图像。

English (原文): This checkpoint is not exportable. Export keeps the last completed result; cancellation returns to that result.
简体中文: 此中间结果无法导出。导出始终使用最后完成的结果；取消后会返回该结果。

English (原文): Display preview reduced to the viewport device/cache limit. The retained PNG and export keep full resolution; native 100% inspection is unavailable for this reduced view.
简体中文: 显示预览已缩小到视口设备或缓存限制。保留的 PNG 和导出仍为完整分辨率；此缩小视图不能进行原生 100% 检查。

English (原文): Showing the last completed image; a newer render has not replaced it.
简体中文: 正在显示最后完成的图像；较新的渲染尚未替换它。

English (原文): This review is stale. Resolve or check again before applying.
简体中文: 此审阅结果已过期；应用前请重新解析或检查。

English (原文): Validate the exact current draft that Render will submit. No renderer fallback, silent resize or resource replacement.
简体中文: 验证渲染将提交的当前设置；不会暗中切换渲染器、缩小图像或替换资源。

English (原文): HDR illumination, camera-only backgrounds and physical stage surfaces are separate controls with explicit replacement consent.
简体中文: HDR 照明、相机专用背景和物理舞台独立控制，替换需明确确认。

English (原文): Finish the current file or confirmation dialog first.
简体中文: 请先完成文件或确认对话框。

English (原文): A render is already running; cancel it explicitly before starting another.
简体中文: 渲染正在进行；开始新任务前请明确取消。

English (原文): Inspect authored rigs or edit supported lights without replacing the current setup until you explicitly apply the change.
简体中文: 检查原创灯光组合或编辑支持的灯光；明确应用前不会替换当前设置。

English (原文): Open the shared appearance inspector and original surface library. Optical edits never silently change engineering properties.
简体中文: 打开共用外观面板和原创表面库；光学编辑不会暗中更改工程属性。

English (原文): There is no active render to cancel.
简体中文: 没有可取消的活动渲染。

English (原文): Complete a render before exporting its exact image.
简体中文: 请先完成渲染再导出图像。

English (原文): Save a shot before restoring its camera.
简体中文: 恢复相机前请先保存镜头。

English (原文): Browse implemented studio compositions and review their replacements before applying. Concept-only scenes remain labeled.
简体中文: 浏览已实现的工作室并在应用前检查替换内容；概念场景仍有明确标记。

English (原文): Saved surface bindings cannot be mixed with temporary optical overrides or an unsaved HDR. Save the HDR or remove the temporary inputs explicitly.
简体中文: 已保存表面绑定不能与临时光学覆盖或未保存 HDR 混用。请明确保存 HDR 或移除临时输入。

English (原文): Pinned built-in maps follow the selected occurrence in local millimeters. A replaced or missing target is an error, never an automatic reassignment.
简体中文: 固定的内置贴图以局部毫米坐标跟随选定实例。目标被替换或缺失时会报错，绝不自动重新分配。

English (原文): All shots needs the saved-shot render queue, which is not available yet.
简体中文: 所有镜头需要尚未提供的已保存镜头渲染队列。

English (原文): Check out of date · check again
简体中文: 检查已过期 · 请重新检查

English (原文): Confirm lighting, environment, exposure and stage replacement
简体中文: 确认替换照明、环境、曝光和舞台

English (原文): Camera, sampling, dimensions, optical bindings, CAD geometry and engineering materials are preserved.
简体中文: 保留相机、采样、尺寸、光学绑定、CAD 几何和工程材料。

English (原文): Compose lighting and a passive stage for the visible subject. Geometry, engineering materials and the camera remain separate.
简体中文: 为可见主体组合照明和被动舞台；几何、工程材料和相机保持独立。

English (原文): Scene preserves the design. Geometry, engineering properties and CAD are never changed from Render.
简体中文: 场景保留设计。渲染不会更改几何、工程属性或 CAD。

English (原文): Review the complete native composition before applying. Unbound advanced SCENE specifications are not substituted.
简体中文: 应用前请审阅完整原生组合；不会替换为未绑定的高级 SCENE 规格。

English (原文): This older setup uses legacy environment rotation or intensity. Those values are retained; convert them explicitly before saving a full image job.
简体中文: 此旧设置使用旧版环境旋转或强度。这些值会保留；保存完整图像任务前，请明确转换它们。

English (原文): Save records the active image method and all its numeric settings. Reload or choosing another setup replaces this draft; restore the camera separately.
简体中文: 保存会记录当前图像方法及其全部数值设置。重新加载或选择其他设置会替换此草稿；相机需单独恢复。

English (原文): You can edit and save this method without its renderer. Check and Start require an available host.
简体中文: 即使渲染器不可用，也可以编辑和保存此方法。检查和开始需要可用的执行器。

English (原文): This full job cannot be saved yet: it contains maps or scene-body bindings. Remove those temporary inputs before saving a portable setup.
简体中文: 此完整任务暂时无法保存：其中包含贴图或场景实体绑定。保存可移植设置前，请移除这些临时输入。

English (原文): The saved render configuration could not be found after the command completed.
简体中文: 命令完成后未找到保存的渲染设置。

English (原文): Exposure needs CPU ray tracing or GPU path tracing.
简体中文: 曝光需要 CPU 光线追踪或 GPU 路径追踪。

English (原文): Field of view needs perspective projection.
Camera values must be finite and within range.
简体中文: 相机值必须为范围内的有限数。

English (原文): Adopt progressive sampling in Sampling before enabling CPU depth of field.
简体中文: 启用CPU景深前，请在采样中应用渐进式采样。

English (原文): Enable depth of field to edit aperture and focus distance.
简体中文: 启用景深以编辑光圈和对焦距离。

English (原文): Depth of field needs GPU path tracing.
简体中文: 景深需要 GPU 路径追踪。

English (原文): Depth of field needs perspective projection.
Depth of field is available for CPU ray tracing and GPU path tracing.
简体中文: CPU光线追踪和GPU路径追踪均支持景深。

English (原文): Remove only this saved setup. Source geometry and completed images are preserved; the action can be undone.
简体中文: 仅删除此保存设置；源几何和已完成图像保持不变，操作可撤销。

English (原文): Save the current draft first. Duplicate and rename preserve exact saved options and resource references.

English (原文): Reading through spacenavd for now: the device itself could not be opened.
简体中文: 目前改通过 spacenavd 读取：无法打开设备本身。

English (原文): Reading the device directly; spacenavd is not running
简体中文: 直接读取设备（spacenavd 未运行）

English (原文): Reading through spacenavd, the only way available
简体中文: 通过 spacenavd 读取（没有其他方式）

English (原文): Move and rotate the view together; sketches use pan and zoom only.
简体中文: 同时移动和旋转视图；草图中仅支持平移和缩放。

English (原文): What kind of 3D mouse is it?
The reading stays put while you hold it, the way a Return to Center device does.
简体中文: 按住时读数保持不变，就像“回中”型设备那样。

English (原文): The reading keeps dropping back as soon as you stop moving, the way a trackball's does.
简体中文: 一停下来读数就回落，这是轨迹球的特征。

English (原文): Calibrating your 3D mouse fixes swapped or reversed axes and sets its speed and feel.
简体中文: 校准 3D 鼠标可以修正互换或反向的轴，并调整它的速度和手感。

English (原文): Traced: the 3D mouse turns the view around the part of the model in the middle of the view when the turn begins, marked by a faint ball. Classic: around the view's center
简体中文: 追踪：3D 鼠标围绕开始旋转时视图中间的模型部分旋转视图，并用一个淡色小球标出该点。经典：围绕视图中心旋转
恢复 3D 鼠标默认设置

English (原文): Set the 3D mouse settings back to their defaults? Your calibration and button mapping stay.
简体中文: 要将 3D 鼠标设置恢复为默认值吗？校准和按钮映射会保留。

English (原文): Show the 3D mouse in the 3D view
简体中文: 在 3D 视图中显示 3D 鼠标

English (原文): A picture of your 3D mouse in the lower left corner, moving as you move it.
简体中文: 在左下角显示你的 3D 鼠标图示，随你的操作而动。

English (原文): The 3D mouse also turns the view while a sketch is open and seen square on, as the mouse can. Off: it pans and zooms the sketch until you tilt the view.
简体中文: 草图打开并正对视图时，3D 鼠标也能旋转视图，与鼠标一样。关闭：在你倾斜视图之前，只平移和缩放草图。

English (原文): Skips this motion both ways, and the calibration leaves it out.
简体中文: 在两个方向上都跳过这个动作，校准时不包含它。

English (原文): Lift the cap up, hold it, then let go.
简体中文: 向上提起摇杆帽，保持住，然后松开。

English (原文): Press the cap down, hold it, then let go.
简体中文: 向下按压摇杆帽，保持住，然后松开。

English (原文): Pull the cap toward you, hold it, then let go.
简体中文: 把摇杆帽拉向自己，保持住，然后松开。

English (原文): Push the cap away from you, hold it, then let go.
简体中文: 把摇杆帽推离自己，保持住，然后松开。

English (原文): Take your hand off the cap and leave it still.
简体中文: 请把手从摇杆帽上移开，让它保持静止。

English (原文): Take your hand off the ball and leave it still.
简体中文: 请把手从球上移开，让它保持静止。

English (原文): Turn the scroll ring clockwise a few clicks.
简体中文: 把滚轮环顺时针转几格。

English (原文): Turn the scroll ring anticlockwise a few clicks.
简体中文: 把滚轮环逆时针转几格。

English (原文): Roll the ball away from you a few times, then let it stop.
简体中文: 把球向远离你的方向滚动几次，然后让它停下。

English (原文): Roll the ball left a few times, then let it stop.
简体中文: 把球向左滚动几次，然后让它停下。

English (原文): Roll the ball right a few times, then let it stop.
简体中文: 把球向右滚动几次，然后让它停下。

English (原文): Roll the ball toward you a few times, then let it stop.
简体中文: 把球朝你滚动几次，然后让它停下。

English (原文): Slide the cap left, hold it, then let go.
简体中文: 向左推动摇杆帽，保持住，然后松开。

English (原文): Slide the cap right, hold it, then let go.
简体中文: 向右推动摇杆帽，保持住，然后松开。

English (原文): Spin the ball clockwise a few times, then let it stop.
简体中文: 把球顺时针旋转几次，然后让它停下。

English (原文): Spin the ball anticlockwise a few times, then let it stop.
简体中文: 把球逆时针旋转几次，然后让它停下。

English (原文): Tilt the top of the cap away from you (the edge nearest you goes up), hold it, then let go.
简体中文: 把摇杆帽顶部向远离你的方向倾斜（离你最近的边向上），保持住，然后松开。

English (原文): Tilt the cap left (left edge down), hold it, then let go.
简体中文: 向左倾斜摇杆帽（左缘向下），保持住，然后松开。

English (原文): Tilt the cap right (right edge down), hold it, then let go.
简体中文: 向右倾斜摇杆帽（右缘向下），保持住，然后松开。

English (原文): Tilt the top of the cap toward you (the edge nearest you goes down), hold it, then let go.
简体中文: 把摇杆帽顶部朝你倾斜（离你最近的边向下），保持住，然后松开。

English (原文): Rest your hand on the cap without pushing it.
简体中文: 把手放在摇杆帽上，不要用力推。

English (原文): Twist the cap clockwise, hold it, then let go.
简体中文: 顺时针扭转摇杆帽，保持住，然后松开。

English (原文): Twist the cap anticlockwise, hold it, then let go.
简体中文: 逆时针扭转摇杆帽，保持住，然后松开。

English (原文): Read the 3D mouse directly (hidraw) instead of through spacenavd.
简体中文: 直接读取 3D 鼠标（hidraw），不经过 spacenavd。

English (原文): The 3D mouse driver's profile turns this axis off, so its motion doesn't move the view. Picking another axis's motion here swaps the two, and that motion stops moving the view.
简体中文: 3D 鼠标驱动程序的配置文件关闭了此轴，因此它的动作不会移动视图。在此选择另一个轴的动作会将两者互换，该动作将不再移动视图。

English (原文): If you have one plugged in, wiggle it.
简体中文: 如果已插上，请轻轻晃动一下。

English (原文): Allow the agent to do this?
简体中文: 允许智能体执行此操作吗？

English (原文): Send what is selected in the model (faces, edges, features, bodies) with the message, so the agent knows what you mean
简体中文: 随消息发送模型中当前选中的内容(面、边、特征、实体),让智能体知道你指的是什么

English (原文): Send a picture of the current view with the message
简体中文: 随消息发送当前视图的图片

English (原文): Pictures, PDFs, text and CAD files
简体中文: 图片、PDF、文本和 CAD 文件

English (原文): Set {vars} in your environment and restart SolidCraft.
简体中文: 请在环境中设置 {vars}，然后重启 SolidCraft。

English (原文): The agent asks you to sign in. You sign in with the agent itself; SolidCraft never sees your password or keys.
简体中文: 智能体要求你登录。登录在智能体本身完成；SolidCraft 从不接触你的密码或密钥。

English (原文): The agent offers no sign-in method here: sign in the way its own documentation describes.
简体中文: 该智能体未在此提供登录方式：请按照它自己的文档登录。

English (原文): Run this in a terminal, then press Connect again:
简体中文: 在终端中运行以下命令，然后再次点击连接：

English (原文): The agent did not respond to Stop and was disconnected. Reconnect to continue.
简体中文: 代理未响应停止请求，已断开连接。请重新连接以继续。

English (原文): Installed, but it does not start: {error}
No longer in the design: it was changed or deleted.
简体中文: 已不在设计中:它被修改或删除了。

English (原文): Any program that speaks the Agent Client Protocol on stdin and stdout. No shell runs it.
简体中文: 任何通过标准输入输出使用 Agent Client Protocol 的程序。不经过 shell 运行。

English (原文): The agent chat needs the desktop app.
简体中文: 智能体聊天需要桌面应用。

English (原文): Drop to attach to your next message
简体中文: 拖放到此处，附加到下一条消息

English (原文): {name}: a CAD file is imported into the design, not read
简体中文: {name}：CAD 文件会导入设计，而不是读取

English (原文): {name}: HEIC pictures can't be read here; export it as JPEG or PNG first
简体中文: {name}：这里无法读取 HEIC 图片；请先导出为 JPEG 或 PNG

English (原文): {name}: pictures (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, TIFF), text files (SVG too) and CAD files (STEP, IGES, FreeCAD, Rhino, STL, 3MF, OBJ, glTF) can be attached
简体中文: {name}：可以附加图片（PNG、JPEG、GIF、WebP、BMP、TIFF）、文本文件（包括 SVG）和 CAD 文件（STEP、IGES、FreeCAD、Rhino、STL、3MF、OBJ、glTF）

English (原文): {name}: a picture can be at most {max} MB
{name}: a text file can be at most {max} KB
{name}: too large to send, even scaled down
{name}: not a picture this can read
At most {max} files go with one message; left out: {files}
简体中文: 一条消息最多发送 {max} 个文件；未发送：{files}

English (原文): Waiting for the files to be read
简体中文: 正在等待文件读取完成

English (原文): At most {max} files on one message
简体中文: 一条消息最多附加 {max} 个文件

English (原文): No coding agent found. The Flatpak sandbox cannot see agents installed in your home folder and has no network access by default. To allow Claude Code and its ACP adapter installed through nvm or ~/.local/bin, run this command in a terminal, then restart SolidCraft. It grants access to the listed program and sign-in files, plus network access:
简体中文: 未找到编程代理。默认情况下，Flatpak 沙箱无法访问主目录中安装的代理，也无法访问网络。要允许使用通过 nvm 或 ~/.local/bin 安装的 Claude Code 及其 ACP 适配器，请在终端运行以下命令，然后重新启动 SolidCraft。此命令授予对所列程序和登录文件的访问权限以及网络访问权限：

English (原文): Chat with a coding agent you already use, or a model endpoint you choose. It works on the open design through SolidCraft's tools: its changes show as it makes them and undo as one step per message. What it may do without asking is set in Preferences > AI.
简体中文: 与你已在使用的编程智能体或你选择的模型端点聊天。它通过 SolidCraft 的工具处理打开的设计：更改即时显示，每条消息的更改可一步撤销。无需询问即可执行的范围在“首选项 > AI”中设置。

English (原文): The agent used last ({agent}) is not available any more. Pick an agent, then press Retry.
简体中文: 上次使用的智能体（{agent}）已不可用。请选择一个智能体，然后按“重试”。

English (原文): The agent reached the limit of {limit} changes for one message. Send another message to let it go on.
简体中文: 智能体已达到每条消息 {limit} 项更改的上限。再发送一条消息可让它继续。

English (原文): {model} can't use SolidCraft's tools, so it can only chat. Pick a model with tool support.
简体中文: {model} 无法使用 SolidCraft 的工具，只能聊天。请选择支持工具的模型。

English (原文): Search, or type any model id…
简体中文: 搜索，或输入任意模型 ID…

English (原文): The model the agent uses. Your choice is remembered for this agent.
简体中文: 智能体使用的模型。你的选择会为此智能体记住。
该端点未列出任何模型

English (原文): The answer was no model list
Start a new chat? The current one is cleared.
简体中文: 开始新对话？当前对话将被清除。

English (原文): solidcraft-cli was not found next to the app, so the agent can't reach the design.
简体中文: 在应用旁边未找到 solidcraft-cli，因此智能体无法访问设计。

English (原文): The agent chat's endpoint did not start, so the agent can't reach the design.
简体中文: 智能体聊天的端点未能启动，因此智能体无法访问设计。

English (原文): The agent runs without SolidCraft's tools, so it can't read or change the design: solidcraft-cli was not found next to the app. Install SolidCraft with solidcraft-cli beside it (on Windows, the MSI or the portable zip), or set SOLIDCRAFT_CLI to its path, then connect again.
简体中文: 代理在没有 SolidCraft 工具的情况下运行，因此无法读取或修改设计：在应用旁边找不到 solidcraft-cli。请安装附带 solidcraft-cli 的 SolidCraft（在 Windows 上为 MSI 或便携版 zip），或将 SOLIDCRAFT_CLI 设置为它的路径，然后重新连接。

English (原文): There is no picture on the clipboard
The model didn't use SolidCraft's tools, so the design wasn't changed. Choose a model that supports tool calling; see Local models in the agent chat guide.
简体中文: 模型没有使用 SolidCraft 的工具，因此设计没有更改。请选择支持工具调用的模型；参见智能体聊天指南中的“本地模型”。

English (原文): Node.js {version} is too old for this agent. Install Node.js 20.10 or newer, then press Refresh.
简体中文: Node.js {version} 版本过旧，无法运行此代理。请安装 Node.js 20.10 或更新版本，然后点击刷新。

English (原文): No coding agent found. Install one of these, then press Refresh:
简体中文: 未找到编程智能体。请安装以下之一，然后点击刷新：

English (原文): Choose faces, edges, features and bodies in the model, then press OK: they are put into the message as a pill where the cursor is (typing @ does the same)
简体中文: 在模型中选择面、边、特征和实体,然后点击确定:它们会作为标签放入消息中光标所在的位置(输入 @ 效果相同)

English (原文): Ask the agent to change the design…
Queue a message for when the agent is done (Ctrl+Enter: send now)
简体中文: 输入消息，待智能体完成后发送（Ctrl+Enter：立即发送）

English (原文): Open in its own window, which you can move to another screen
简体中文: 在独立窗口中打开（可移到另一个屏幕）

English (原文): Nothing goes anywhere except to the agent you run, under your own account.
简体中文: 除了你以自己的账户运行的智能体之外，不会向任何地方发送任何内容。

English (原文): The chat itself sends nothing anywhere: the agent you run talks to its own service under your own account. SolidCraft never sees or stores a key or password.
简体中文: 聊天本身不向任何地方发送任何内容：你运行的智能体以你自己的账户与它自己的服务通信。SolidCraft 从不查看或保存任何密钥或密码。

English (原文): The provider whose models the next list shows.
简体中文: 旁边的列表显示此提供商的模型。

English (原文): Too many messages are waiting: remove one or wait for the agent.
简体中文: 等待中的消息太多：请删除一条，或等待智能体完成。

English (原文):
{agent} is installed ({program}), but it did not start when SolidCraft checked it: {error}
Its installation may be incomplete, or made for another kind of computer. Install it again with `{install}`, check that it prints its version in a terminal, then press Refresh.
简体中文:
{agent} 已安装（{program}），但 SolidCraft 检查时它没有启动：{error}
它的安装可能不完整，或是为另一种计算机准备的。请用 `{install}` 重新安装，确认它能在终端中显示版本号，然后点击刷新。

English (原文): Take it off this message; the part stays in the design (Undo removes it)
简体中文: 从这条消息中移除；零件仍保留在设计中（撤销可将其删除）

English (原文): The reply reached its length limit before it finished, so it may be incomplete. Ask the agent to go on, or for a shorter answer.
简体中文: 回复在完成前达到了长度上限，可能不完整。请让智能体继续，或请它回答得更简短。

English (原文): The model declined to answer this message.
简体中文: 模型拒绝回答这条消息。

English (原文): Stop the agent's current step and send this next (Ctrl+Enter)
简体中文: 停止智能体当前的步骤，并接着发送这条消息（Ctrl+Enter）

English (原文): SolidCraft talks to a coding agent installed on this computer. Pick one in Preferences › AI.
简体中文: SolidCraft 会与安装在此计算机上的编程代理通信。请在“首选项 › AI”中选择一个。

English (原文): No coding agent found. The Snap package is confined, so it cannot see or start the coding agents installed on this computer. To use them, install SolidCraft from the AppImage, .deb or .rpm package instead. An agent that uses an OpenAI-compatible API works in the Snap package too: set one up with Add agent.
简体中文: 未找到编程代理。Snap 软件包运行在受限环境中，无法看到或启动此计算机上安装的编程代理。要使用它们，请改用 AppImage、.deb 或 .rpm 软件包安装 SolidCraft。使用 OpenAI 兼容 API 的代理在 Snap 软件包中同样可用：请通过“添加智能体”进行设置。

English (原文): Stop the agent and everything it started
简体中文: 停止智能体及其启动的所有进程

English (原文): Stop the agent (Esc). Queued messages stay queued.
简体中文: 停止智能体（Esc）。排队的消息仍保持排队。

English (原文): The agent runs without SolidCraft's tools, so it can't read or change the design: solidcraft-cli was found, but its tools did not start (the error in the chat says why). Connect again; if it keeps happening, reinstall SolidCraft.
简体中文: 代理在没有 SolidCraft 工具的情况下运行，因此无法读取或修改设计：已找到 solidcraft-cli，但其工具未能启动（聊天中的错误信息说明了原因）。请重新连接；如果问题仍然出现，请重新安装 SolidCraft。

English (原文): Keep the window responsive while agents run commands
简体中文: 代理运行命令时保持窗口响应

English (原文): An agent's slow commands (from the AI panel or an MCP client) compute beside the window: you can keep turning and inspecting the view, and stop one from the chip in the view. Off: each runs on the window's thread and the window waits for it.
简体中文: 代理（来自 AI 面板或 MCP 客户端）的耗时命令在窗口之外计算：运行时仍可旋转和查看视图，并可在视图中的提示上停止它。关闭：每条命令在窗口线程上运行，窗口会等待其完成。

English (原文): The model's thinking in each reply starts folded; click Thinking to open it. Off: it is shown open.
简体中文: 每条回复中模型的思考默认折叠；点击“思考”即可展开。关闭：以展开状态显示。
正在运行的请求的结果

English (原文): An entry of your own for an installed agent, for example with other arguments. Installed agents are listed by themselves.
简体中文: 为已安装的智能体添加一个自己的条目，例如使用其他参数。已安装的智能体会自动列出。

English (原文): The agent's own mode: its own tools (shell, file edits) follow it. SolidCraft's tools follow the permissions in Preferences > AI.
简体中文: 智能体自己的模式：它自己的工具（shell、文件编辑）遵循此模式。SolidCraft 的工具遵循“首选项 > AI”中的权限。

English (原文): Allow {tool} for this agent from now on, without asking
简体中文: 从现在起允许该智能体使用 {tool}，不再询问

English (原文): Nothing is always allowed yet. "Always allow" answers you give in the chat are listed here.
简体中文: 尚无始终允许的项目。你在聊天中选择“始终允许”的回答会列在这里。

English (原文): SolidCraft checks its own tools itself
简体中文: SolidCraft 会自行检查它自己的工具

English (原文): Enter a URL that starts with http:// or https://
简体中文: 请输入以 http:// 或 https:// 开头的 URL

English (原文): This agent was removed, so there is nothing to save.
简体中文: 此智能体已被移除，没有可保存的内容。

English (原文): Change this agent's name, command or endpoint. A saved key stays hidden.
简体中文: 更改此智能体的名称、命令或端点。已保存的密钥保持隐藏。

English (原文): the endpoint is busy or over its limit; try again later
简体中文: 端点繁忙或已达上限，请稍后再试

English (原文): the endpoint refused the key: check it in Preferences > AI
简体中文: 端点拒绝了密钥：请在“首选项 > AI”中检查

English (原文): no such endpoint or model: check the base URL and the model name
简体中文: 找不到该端点或模型：请检查基础 URL 和模型名称

English (原文): the conversation is too large for this endpoint; start a new chat
简体中文: 对话对此端点来说过大，请开始新的聊天

English (原文): optional; kept in the system keychain
简体中文: 可选；保存在系统钥匙串中

English (原文): leave empty to keep the saved key
简体中文: 留空以保留已保存的密钥

English (原文): A key is only sent over HTTPS, or to this computer.
简体中文: 密钥只会通过 HTTPS 发送，或发送到本机。

English (原文): Stored in the system keychain, never in SolidCraft's settings. Leave it empty for a local server.
简体中文: 保存在系统钥匙串中，绝不保存在 SolidCraft 的设置里。本地服务器可留空。

English (原文): Nothing asks first. Crash reports stay off limits and the folder limits still apply.
简体中文: 不再询问。崩溃报告仍不可访问，文件夹限制仍然有效。

English (原文): The agent can save, overwrite, export and replace your design without asking. Use this only with an agent you trust, on designs you have saved.
简体中文: 智能体可以不经询问保存、覆盖、导出和替换你的设计。只在你信任的智能体和已保存的设计上使用。

English (原文): Every change to the design, and every file action, waits for your Allow.
简体中文: 对设计的每项更改和每个文件操作都要等待你的允许。

English (原文): Modeling commands run without asking; saving, opening, exporting and other file or destructive actions still ask.
简体中文: 建模命令无需询问即可运行；保存、打开、导出等文件操作或破坏性操作仍会询问。

简体中文: 这些设置适用于 SolidCraft 的工具。智能体自己的工具（它的 shell、文件编辑）遵循智能体自己的模式；如果智能体提供模式，可在聊天面板标题栏中选择。

English (原文): Enter the command that starts the agent
简体中文: 请输入启动智能体的命令

简体中文: 此版本无法访问 API 端点

English (原文): The system keychain isn't available, so a key can't be stored. A local server without a key still works.
简体中文: 系统钥匙串不可用，无法保存密钥。无需密钥的本地服务器仍可使用。

简体中文: 可选。将作为 `reasoning_effort` 发送给端点；各服务商接受的值不同（例如 `low`、`high` 或 `max`）。您在此设置的值绝不会被 SolidCraft 替换。留空则不发送任何内容，沿用服务商默认值。

English (原文): The model took longer than {seconds} s. You can raise the request timeout for this endpoint in Preferences › Assistant.
简体中文: 模型用时超过 {seconds} 秒。可在“首选项 › 助手”中调高此端点的请求超时。

English (原文): How long one model request to this endpoint may take, from 30 s to an hour. Raise it for a slow local model.
简体中文: 对此端点的一次模型请求最多可用的时间，30 秒到 1 小时。本地模型较慢时请调高。

关闭后将隐藏所有助手功能，且不会启动任何内容。下方所有选项都会变灰。

智能体聊天：一个面板，由你已在使用的编程智能体或你选择的模型端点处理打开的设计。关闭后：没有 AI 按钮、快捷键、菜单项或面板，也不会查找或启动任何程序。

简体中文: 短暂启动智能体并请求一个会话，然后结束它

English (原文): Sends a short message to the endpoint
简体中文: 向端点发送一条简短消息

简体中文: 工具栏右端的 AI 按钮。Ctrl+Shift+A 和视图菜单仍可打开面板。

简体中文: 将智能体为此消息所做的全部更改一步撤销

English (原文): Soft shading where opaque surfaces meet. Requires the GPU viewport.
简体中文: 在不透明表面相接处添加柔和阴影。需要 GPU 视口。

English (原文): Hide every body the search didn't find
简体中文: 隐藏搜索未找到的所有实体

English (原文): Find components, bodies, sketches, joints, and construction planes, axes and points by name. * stands for any text and ? for any one character. Ctrl+F
简体中文: 按名称查找组件、实体、草图、关节以及构造平面、轴和点。* 代表任意文本，? 代表任意一个字符。Ctrl+F

简体中文: 用 * 或 ? 匹配名称的一部分，例如 *:1

简体中文: 滚动正在平移视图。使用的是平滑滚动滚轮的鼠标吗？让滚轮缩放

English (原文): Center point arc follows the cursor's direction
简体中文: 中心点圆弧跟随光标方向

English (原文): A center point arc runs clockwise or counter-clockwise the way the cursor goes round its center. Off: always counter-clockwise from the start.
简体中文: 中心点圆弧按光标绕中心移动的方向沿顺时针或逆时针绘制。关闭：始终从起点逆时针绘制。

English (原文): Click, then press the new key
For a weak or missing green sense
简体中文: 绿色感知较弱或缺失时使用

English (原文): Changes the colors that carry a meaning: sketch states, axes, bends, analyses and icons. If you use Windows color filters, keep this Off.
简体中文: 更改表示含义的颜色：草图状态、轴、折弯、分析和图标。如果使用 Windows 颜色滤镜，请保持“关闭”。

English (原文): For a weak or missing red sense
简体中文: 红色感知较弱或缺失时使用

English (原文): For a weak or missing blue sense
简体中文: 蓝色感知较弱或缺失时使用

English (原文): How long the teeth are: a multiple of the automatic length, which makes the longest tooth a fifth of the size of the curves shown.
简体中文: 梳齿的长度：自动长度的倍数。自动长度使最长的梳齿为所示曲线尺寸的五分之一。

English (原文): How many teeth each comb has, evenly spaced along the curve. More teeth show more detail of how the curvature changes.
简体中文: 每个梳的梳齿数，沿曲线均匀分布。梳齿越多，越能看清曲率如何变化。

English (原文): Type a command, e.g. {example}  — or press S to search
简体中文: 输入命令，例如 {example}  — 或按 S 搜索

English (原文): Create one component per selected body, named after that body, under the active component.
简体中文: 在活动组件下，为每个选定实体创建一个以该实体命名的组件。

English (原文): Chosen from your picks. Pick another reference, or take one out, to change the method.
简体中文: 已根据所选对象选定方法。添加或移除参照即可更换方法。

English (原文): Pick other references: no method builds from these.
简体中文: 请选择其他参照：没有方法能由这些对象创建。

English (原文): Pick what to build from: the method follows from your picks.
简体中文: 选择创建依据：方法由所选对象决定。

English (原文): Select references to build from first
简体中文: 请先选择创建依据的参照

English (原文): Construction line: click a point, then type an angle or pick a direction
简体中文: 构造直线：单击一点，然后输入角度或选择方向

English (原文): Construction line: click a point, or type its distance from the sketch axis
简体中文: 构造直线：单击一点，或输入它到草图轴的距离

English (原文): Bisector: pick two intersecting straight lines, then the desired solution
简体中文: 角平分线：选择两条相交直线，再选择所需解

English (原文): Common tangent: pick two circles/arcs, then the desired solution
简体中文: 公切线：选择两个圆/圆弧，再选择所需解

English (原文): Tangent: pick a circle/arc or open spline/conic, then the contact point (free-form curves: endpoints)
简体中文: 切线：先选圆/圆弧或开放样条曲线/圆锥曲线，再选接点（自由曲线仅支持端点）

English (原文): Tangent: pick a circle or arc, an external point, then the desired solution
简体中文: 切线：依次选择圆或圆弧、外部点和所需解

English (原文): Construction line: click two points; right-click to restart
简体中文: 构造直线：单击两点；右键单击重新开始

English (原文): An infinite line is always construction: type a length to draw a normal line
简体中文: 无限直线始终是构造线：输入长度以绘制普通直线

English (原文): Construction line: pick a straight line, then click or type the offset; right-click to change the reference
简体中文: 构造直线：先选直线，再单击或输入偏移；右键单击更换参照

English (原文): Construction line: click the point to pass through
简体中文: 构造直线：单击要经过的点

English (原文): Construction line: pick a straight line, then a point; right-click to change the reference
简体中文: 构造直线：先选直线，再选一点；右键单击更换参照

English (原文): Construction line: click the side the line runs toward; right-click to restart
简体中文: 构造直线：单击直线延伸的一侧；右键单击重新开始

English (原文): The browser took this right-click and opened its own menu. Right-click without Shift for SolidCraft's menu.
简体中文: 浏览器接管了这次右键点击并打开了自己的菜单。不按 Shift 右键可打开 SolidCraft 的菜单。

English (原文): Curvature change (G3): the curvature also changes smoothly across the seam.
简体中文: 曲率变化 (G3)：曲率在接缝处的变化也是平滑的。

English (原文): Curvature-continuous (G2): reflections run through without a kink.
简体中文: 曲率连续 (G2)：反射平滑穿过，没有折痕。

English (原文): Position (G0): the surfaces meet, with a crease where they do.
简体中文: 位置 (G0)：曲面相接，但接缝处有折痕。

English (原文): Smooth curvature change (G4): even the way the curvature changes runs on smoothly across the seam.
简体中文: 平滑曲率变化 (G4)：连曲率的变化方式在接缝处也平滑延续。

English (原文): Tangent (G1): no crease, though the curvature jumps across the seam.
简体中文: 相切 (G1)：没有折痕，但曲率在接缝处突变。

English (原文): Copy the full message, to look it up or to report it.
简体中文: 复制完整消息，以便查找或报告。

English (原文): Show schematic markings on threaded cylindrical walls. Changes only the display, never the design or exports.
简体中文: 在带螺纹的圆柱面上显示示意标记。仅改变显示，不影响设计或导出。

English (原文): Choose a slicer program to add to the list
简体中文: 选择要添加到列表的切片软件程序

简体中文: 请先选择要删除的内容：特征、实体、组件或草图几何

简体中文: 请先选择要列出其依赖项的对象

English (原文): STEP, IGES and 3MF exports carry these where the format has a place for them.
简体中文: 导出 STEP、IGES 和 3MF 时，若格式有对应字段，会写入这些属性。

English (原文): Saved as something other than text; typing here replaces it.
简体中文: 已保存为非文本值；在此输入将替换它。

English (原文): Kept in the design as it is and never exported.
简体中文: 按原样保存在设计中，从不导出。

English (原文): Saved {path}; the earlier signature does not cover this save
简体中文: 已保存 {path}；之前的签名不覆盖此次保存

English (原文): Faces show whether a tool can reach them from the chosen direction.
简体中文: 面显示刀具能否从所选方向到达它们。

English (原文): Edit the selected seam. Other seams keep their own settings.
简体中文: 编辑所选接缝。其他接缝保留各自的设置。

English (原文): Earlier geometry: rerun the analysis to edit or frame this seam.
简体中文: 先前的几何体：请重新运行分析，以编辑此接缝或使其适合视图。

简体中文: 面按其局部曲率半径着色。

简体中文: 面按其与脱模方向的夹角着色。

简体中文: 反射条纹显示面之间连接的光顺程度。

简体中文: 没有打开带“确定”按钮的对话框。

简体中文: 请在视图内单击：区域的中心

简体中文: 在视图内要显示区域的中心处单击。

简体中文: 点击工程图视图中的边。

简体中文: 当前显示的图纸，线条以毫米为单位，每种线型一个图层。着色视图和图像不包含在内。

简体中文: SVG 和 PNG 导出当前显示的图纸。

English (原文): One page at the sheet's paper size, its lines and text as vectors.
简体中文: 按图纸纸张尺寸输出一页，线条和文字为矢量。

English (原文): One page for each sheet, in order, each at its own paper size.
简体中文: 每张图纸一页，按顺序，各自使用自己的纸张尺寸。

简体中文: 添加视图前设置纸张大小和标题栏。

简体中文: {paper} · 第三角投影 · 使用模型单位

简体中文: 请先在设计中添加内容，再创建工程图。

简体中文: 选择如何开始绘制 {name} 的工程图。

简体中文: 打开工程图以编辑图纸设置。

简体中文: 选择同一视图的线来定义尺寸（规划中）。

English (原文): Shaded with visible and hidden edges
简体中文: 着色并显示可见边和隐藏边

简体中文: 选择方向，然后单击图纸以放置基础视图。

简体中文: 在基础视图周围移动指针并单击以放置投影视图。完成后按 Esc 或选择“完成”。

简体中文: 此计算机上没有可以打开 PDF 文件的程序

简体中文: 图纸的 PDF 位于 {path}，但无法打开：{reason}

简体中文: 已在 PDF 查看器中打开。请以 100%（实际大小）打印

简体中文: 图纸更改立即生效。每次编辑都是一个撤销步骤。

简体中文: 将此图纸导出为图像时使用的分辨率。

简体中文: 模板将在浏览工程图资源中提供。

简体中文: 工程图必须至少保留一张图纸。

简体中文: 是否删除此视图及其从属视图和标注？

简体中文: EasyPrint 是 Printables 在浏览器中的切片软件。为了在那里打开模型，SolidCraft 会将模型上传到 Printables 的服务器。链接 30 分钟后失效，并且你需要登录 Printables。要继续吗？

English (原文): The edit finishes when the agent's turn ends
简体中文: 代理本轮结束后将完成编辑

English (原文): The agent is still working in this design; try again once its turn is done
简体中文: 代理仍在此设计中工作；请在其本轮结束后重试

English (原文): An edit already waits for the end of the agent's turn
简体中文: 已有编辑在等待代理本轮结束

简体中文: 请在源设计中编辑此配置，然后更新链接。

简体中文: 没有正在原位编辑的链接设计

简体中文: 零件有未保存的更改；请保存以完成编辑

简体中文: 代理本轮结束后将打开零件

简体中文: 更新链接期间装配体已更改；请再次运行

简体中文: 更新链接在完成前已停止

简体中文: 请先保存装配体：其链接设计根据其文件查找

English (原文): Update Links is running in {name}; save it once it is done
简体中文: 正在更新 {name} 中的链接；请在完成后保存

English (原文): The part was saved to another file; the assembly still links {name}
简体中文: 零件已保存到其他文件；装配体仍链接 {name}

简体中文: 爆炸图会将组件彼此分开，因此设计中需要两个或更多组件（新建组件、插入设计或由实体创建组件）

简体中文: 选择文件时设计已更改。请重新开始提取到文件。

简体中文: 该组件现在是独立的设计，并已在此处链接。

English (原文): A face, vertex or parallel plane switches the extent to To Object.
简体中文: 选择面、顶点或平行平面会将范围切换为到对象。
