简体中文: 拉伸要切除的实体。未选择时，SolidCraft 会自动选择实体。

English (原文): The bodies the extrusion joins. With none picked, it joins the body its sketch or face is on, or else the shown bodies of the active component.
简体中文: 拉伸要合并的实体。未选择时，合并到其草图或面所在的实体，否则合并到活动部件中显示的实体。

English (原文): A piece of the rolling ball's sphere, tangent (G1) to each round.
简体中文: 滚球球面的一部分，与每个圆角相切 (G1)。

English (原文): Curvature (G2): a smooth patch. The corner is set back along each edge by the Setback ({factor} × the radius unless you type one) and filled with a patch, so reflections run through it without a kink.
简体中文: 曲率 (G2)：平滑曲面片。角点沿每条边后退一个后退距离（未输入时为半径的 {factor} 倍），并用曲面片填充，反射穿过时没有折痕。

English (原文): Smooth patch corners (G2) need Constant radius and Exact fit.
简体中文: 平滑曲面片角点 (G2) 需要恒定半径和精确的半径拟合。

English (原文): Curvature-continuous (G2): the corner is set back along each edge and filled with a patch, so reflections run through it without a kink.
简体中文: 曲率连续 (G2)：角点沿每条边后退，并用曲面片填充，反射穿过时没有折痕。

English (原文): Tangent (G1): a rolling-ball corner, a piece of the rolling ball's sphere tangent to each round.
简体中文: 相切 (G1)：滚球角，滚球球面的一部分，与每个圆角相切。

English (原文): The smooth corner could not be built here. Try another Setback, or Tangent corners.
简体中文: 无法在此处构建平滑角点。请尝试其他后退距离，或相切角点。

English (原文): This fillet could not be built on these edges. Try another radius, or round fewer edges at once.
简体中文: 无法在这些边上构建此圆角。请尝试其他半径，或一次少倒几条边。

English (原文): No radius builds on these edges, not even a very small one: this shape can't be rounded yet. Try fewer edges, or other ones.
简体中文: 这些边上任何半径都无法生成，即使是很小的半径：此形状暂时无法倒圆角。请尝试减少边数，或选择其他边。

English (原文): The setback is too short for this corner's patch: it builds from {least} on. Try a longer Setback.
简体中文: 对于此角点的面片，后退距离太短：从 {least} 起可以构建。请尝试更长的后退距离。

English (原文): The radius is too large for the faces beside these edges. Try a smaller radius, or set Face limits to Largest radius.
简体中文: 半径对这些边旁边的面来说太大。请尝试更小的半径，或将“面边界”设为“最大半径”。
半径拟合需要恒定半径。

English (原文):
When the radius is larger than the faces beside an edge allow.
Exact radius: the radius as given, or nothing rounded and a message saying why.
Largest radius: every edge rounded with the largest radius that fits.
Narrowed radius: the radius kept, the round narrowed only where the faces run out.
简体中文:
当半径大于边旁边的面所允许的大小时。
精确半径：按给定的半径倒圆，否则不倒圆并说明原因。
最大半径：用能容纳的最大半径倒每条边。
收窄半径：保持半径，只在面不够的地方收窄圆角。

English (原文):
Tangent chain: also round the edges that continue smoothly from the picked ones.
Preview: show the result in the view while you edit.
简体中文:
相切链：同时倒圆与所选边平滑相连的边。
预览：编辑时在视图中显示结果。

English (原文): Where the smooth corner patch starts: how far along each edge from the corner. The default is {factor} × the radius. It must be more than the least setback, where the rounds meet without one: the radius where the faces are square to each other.
简体中文: 平滑角点曲面片开始的位置：从角点沿每条边的距离。默认值为半径的 {factor} 倍。必须大于最小后退距离（不后退时圆角相交之处；面相互垂直时即半径）。

English (原文):
Where two rounds turn round a sharp corner edge between them, such as the rounds along a boss's base at its upright edges.
Mitre: the rounds run on until they meet in a mitre.
Swept: the rounds stop at the corner edge and turn round it, the corner a torus tangent to both. Only for rounds of one radius round a straight, convex corner edge.
简体中文:
两个圆角绕过它们之间尖锐的角边处，例如凸台根部的圆角绕过其竖直边。
斜接：圆角继续延伸，直到以斜接相遇。
旋转：圆角止于角边并绕它旋转，转角是与两者相切的圆环面。仅用于同一半径的圆角绕过笔直的凸角边时。

English (原文):
Constant radius: one radius all along the edge.
Chord length: the width across the round stays the same, whatever angle the faces meet at.
Variable radius: a radius at each end, and more along the edge if you add them.
Curvature continuous: a section without a kink in reflections where it meets flat faces (G2).
Spline: the radius along the edge follows control radii you set.
简体中文:
恒定半径：整条边一个半径。
弦长：无论面以什么角度相交，圆角宽度都相同。
可变半径：两端各一个半径，添加后沿边还有更多。
曲率连续：与平面相接处反射没有折痕的截面 (G2)。
样条：沿边的半径跟随您设置的控制半径。

English (原文): The section across the edge. Curvature continuous: a curvature-continuous (G2) section between planar faces, so reflections run from the faces into the round without a kink.
简体中文: 横跨边的截面。曲率连续：平面之间的曲率连续 (G2) 截面，反射从面平滑过渡到圆角，没有折痕。

English (原文): The first dimension scales the drawing
简体中文: 第一个尺寸缩放整个图形
以草图原点为中心缩放

English (原文): On: the drawing always grows or shrinks about the sketch origin, so a shape drawn away from the origin moves. Off: a drawing that nothing ties to the origin scales about its own middle and stays where it was drawn.
简体中文: 开启：图形总是以草图原点为中心放大或缩小，因此远离原点绘制的形状会移动。关闭：未与原点关联的图形以其自身中心缩放，并保持在绘制的位置。

English (原文): On: a sketch's first length dimension scales the drawing it measures, so its shape stays the same. Off: the dimension sizes only what it measures.
简体中文: 开启：草图的第一个长度尺寸会缩放它所测量的图形，保持其形状不变。关闭：尺寸只改变所测量对象的大小。

English (原文): GLB export keeps the assembly's parts
简体中文: GLB 导出保留装配的零件

English (原文): Each component placement becomes a named node holding its part's bodies, so viewers such as PowerPoint or Blender can move each part on its own. Off: every body is written in world coordinates under one root, as SolidCraft 0.40 did.
简体中文: 每个组件放置都会成为一个命名节点，包含其零件的实体，因此 PowerPoint 或 Blender 等查看器可以单独移动每个零件。关闭：与 SolidCraft 0.40 一样，所有实体以世界坐标写在一个根节点下。

English (原文): The graphics card is out of memory: the view is drawn at a lower quality.
简体中文: 显卡内存不足：视图以较低画质绘制。

English (原文): Quality: ambient occlusion, Fine display quality and adaptive 2× supersampling. Performance: no ambient occlusion, Normal display quality and supersampling off. Manual changes show Custom. MSAA stays unchanged.
简体中文: 质量：环境光遮蔽、精细显示质量和自适应2×超采样。性能：关闭环境光遮蔽、普通显示质量和关闭超采样。手动修改显示为自定义。MSAA保持不变。

English (原文): Side views show the grid on the upright plane facing them instead of the ground
简体中文: 在侧视图中，将网格显示在朝向该视图的竖直平面上，而不是地面上

English (原文): Pasted {rows} of {total} rows: the table has no more rows
简体中文: 已粘贴 {rows}/{total} 行：表格没有更多行了

English (原文): Select a component to ground first: click it in the view or the Browser.
简体中文: 请先选择要固定的组件：在视图或浏览器中点击它。

English (原文): Hide the Origin folder in new designs
简体中文: 在新设计中隐藏原点文件夹

English (原文): New designs start with the Origin folder hidden. A design keeps its own Origin setting once you show or hide it.
简体中文: 新设计开始时原点文件夹处于隐藏状态。显示或隐藏过原点的设计会保留自己的原点设置。

English (原文): History marker: drag to roll the model back; new features go here
简体中文: 历史标记：拖动以回退模型；新特征将在此处添加

English (原文): Finish the current action before playing History
简体中文: 请先完成当前操作，再播放历史

English (原文): Move the History marker back before playing
简体中文: 播放前请将历史标记向后移动

English (原文): Edit a component, or pick one in the Browser, to show only its features
简体中文: 编辑一个零部件，或在浏览器中选中一个，即可只显示它的特征

English (原文): Show only the features of {name} and the components inside it
简体中文: 只显示 {name} 及其内部零部件的特征

English (原文): The features of {name} and the components inside it
简体中文: {name} 及其内部零部件的特征

English (原文): Undo, Redo and History wait until the feature editor has opened
简体中文: 撤销、重做和历史将等待特征编辑器打开

English (原文): {name} has unsaved changes, so its saved file was inserted. Save it, then Update Links to bring the changes in.
简体中文: {name} 有未保存的更改，因此插入的是其已保存的文件。请先保存，再使用“更新链接”导入这些更改。

English (原文): Insert PCB on the web takes the board's files as one zip
简体中文: 网页版插入 PCB 需要将电路板文件打包为一个 zip

English (原文): Inserted {name}; its file is signed by {key} (not checked)
简体中文: 已插入 {name}；其文件由 {key} 签名（未检查）

English (原文): Inserted {name}; its file is signed (not checked)
简体中文: 已插入 {name}；其文件已签名（未检查）

English (原文): Intersection curve: click the second face or curve (right-click to start over)
简体中文: 相交曲线：单击第二个面或曲线（右键单击重新开始）

English (原文): Lasso (drag a freehand loop: takes what is wholly inside)
简体中文: 套索（徒手圈选：选择完全在圈内的对象）

English (原文): Tangent arc: click the arc's end. Rest on the last point again for lines; right-click or Esc to finish
简体中文: 相切圆弧：单击圆弧的终点。再次停留在最后一点可切回直线；右键单击或按 Esc 结束

English (原文): These components build the same bodies as {name}. Make them placements of its link?
简体中文: 这些组件生成的实体与 {name} 相同。要将它们改为其链接的放置吗？

English (原文): Axis view, Look At, Home and Fit
简体中文: 轴视图、注视、主视图与适合窗口

English (原文): Manipulator free drag also on Alt/Option
简体中文: 操纵器自由拖动也适用于 Alt/Option

English (原文): On: Alt/Option or Ctrl/Cmd on extrude / gizmo arrows disables value snapping. Off: Ctrl/Cmd only.
简体中文: 开：在拉伸/小控件箭头上按 Alt/Option 或 Ctrl/Cmd 可关闭数值捕捉。关：仅 Ctrl/Cmd。

English (原文): Material-local axes; no body orientation is assigned.
简体中文: 材料局部坐标轴；不指定实体方向。

English (原文): Sources and licenses are unverified claims. Missing values remain unknown.
简体中文: 来源和许可证声明未经核实。缺失值保持未知。
粘贴架构版本1的材料卡（JSON）

English (原文): The card exceeds the 256 KiB input limit.
简体中文: 材料卡超过256 KiB输入限制。
kg 水 / kg 干燥材料

English (原文): Candidate only: not assigned or saved. Numerical validation is not engineering certification.
简体中文: 仅检查候选数据：不指定或保存。数值验证不等于工程认证。
通过 MCP 连接的代理

English (原文): For agents connected through the MCP server (solidcraft-cli mcp): inspect_design summarizes sketches and tool results are not pretty-printed, so they use fewer tokens. Applies to agent sessions started after the change; --compact or SOLIDCRAFT_MCP_COMPACT=1 also turn it on.
简体中文: 适用于通过 MCP 服务器 (solidcraft-cli mcp) 连接的代理：inspect_design 汇总草图，工具结果不做美化排版，从而占用更少的 token。更改后新开始的代理会话生效；--compact 或 SOLIDCRAFT_MCP_COMPACT=1 也会开启它。

English (原文): Center the mesh on X and Y with its base on Z = 0. When off, the mesh keeps the coordinates stored in the file.
简体中文: 将网格在 X 和 Y 方向居中，并将底面置于 Z = 0。关闭时，网格保留文件中存储的坐标。

English (原文): Select the features to move in the Browser or the History first, then Move Features to Component moves them into the active component.
简体中文: 请先在浏览器或历史中选择要移动的特征，然后“将特征移至组件”会将它们移入活动组件。

English (原文): Navigate with a device app on this computer
简体中文: 使用本机上的设备程序导航

English (原文): A 3D input device's own program (for example a homemade 3D mouse's driver) moves the view over a local connection, so the mouse pointer stays yours. SolidCraft connects to it on this port on this computer only.
简体中文: 3D 输入设备自带的程序（例如自制 3D 鼠标的驱动程序）通过本地连接移动视图，鼠标指针仍由你使用。SolidCraft 只在本机的此端口上连接它。

English (原文): Could not open a new window: {error}
Save {name} first: a new window opens the saved file
简体中文: 请先保存 {name}：新窗口会打开已保存的文件

English (原文): New windows are not available in the browser
简体中文: 浏览器中不支持新窗口

English (原文): {path} is not a program that can be started
Offer to stand up Y-up files
简体中文: 提供站立 Y-up 文件

English (原文): Choose Home or a new Untitled design when starting without a file or closing the last document.
简体中文: 未指定文件启动或关闭最后一个文档时，显示主页或新的未命名设计。

English (原文): Signed; changed since it was checked
简体中文: 已签名；设计在检查后已更改

English (原文): Signed earlier, then saved without a key
简体中文: 之前已签名，然后在没有密钥的情况下保存了

English (原文): This signature needs a newer SolidCraft
简体中文: 此签名需要更新版本的 SolidCraft

English (原文): Signed; not checked in this session
简体中文: 已签名；本次会话中未检查
由 {key} 签名 — 密钥不受信任

English (原文): Frame the image in the sketch
简体中文: 在草图中为图像加边框

English (原文): This synthetic content retains its draft while hidden or moved.
简体中文: 此合成内容在隐藏或移动时保留草稿。

English (原文): Synthetic actions leave the design unchanged.
简体中文: 示例操作不会更改设计。

English (原文): Refuse cancellation while the transaction is live
简体中文: 事务活动期间拒绝取消

English (原文): The panels do not fit within their size limits.
This host does not support that action.
The panel layout has reached its limit.
This panel identity is already in use.

简体中文: 每个面板必须出现一次。

English (原文): This action is disabled for this panel.
These panels cannot share a tab group.
简体中文: 这些面板无法共享标签组。

English (原文): The panel could not complete this action.
This panel target is no longer available.
There is no space for this panel layout.
简体中文: 没有足够的空间容纳此面板布局。

English (原文): Another panel is already pinned to this edge.
简体中文: 此边缘已固定另一个面板。

English (原文): A pinned panel must remain first on its edge.
简体中文: 固定面板必须保持在其边缘的首位。

English (原文): This panel cannot move to that location.
简体中文: 此面板无法移至该位置。

English (原文): The layout changed. Try the action again.
简体中文: 布局已更改。请重试该操作。

English (原文): This panel layout version is unsupported.
简体中文: 不支持此面板布局版本。
面板已在 {name} 的基础上移动。

English (原文): Resets this page's settings. Panel arrangements and saved layouts are kept.
简体中文: 重置此页面的设置。保留面板排列和已保存的布局。

English (原文): Reset {workspace} to its default arrangement. Saved layouts are kept.
简体中文: 将 {workspace} 重置为默认排列。保留已保存的布局。

English (原文): 64 of 64 saved. Pick one to replace.
简体中文: 已保存64个，共64个。请选择要替换的布局。
请使用1–64个字符，不得包含控制字符

English (原文): Select an inserted standard part (a screw, nut, washer or pin) to change its size. To make a body larger or smaller, use Scale.
简体中文: 请选择已插入的标准零件（螺钉、螺母、垫圈或销）以更改其尺寸。要放大或缩小实体，请使用缩放。

English (原文): Rebuilds the part, replacing any added features. All occurrences of this component update.
简体中文: 重新生成零件并替换额外添加的特征。此零部件的所有实例都会更新。

English (原文): The patch meets the faces round it at the chosen continuity along each side. At a corner where those faces meet each other with different curvatures, it stays tangent (G1) there.
简体中文: 补面沿每条边以所选的连续性与周围的面相接。在周围的面彼此以不同曲率相接的角上，补面在该处保持相切 (G1)。

English (原文):
Bodies: solid shapes, picked in the view or the Browser; each is copied whole.
Features: steps of the History, such as an extrude or a hole, picked in the History or on a face they made; the step is repeated.
A sketch is neither: repeat its curves with the sketch's own Pattern or Mirror, or extrude it first.
简体中文:
实体：在视图或浏览器中选取的实心形状，每个都会被整体复制。
特征：历史中的步骤，例如拉伸或孔，在历史中或在其生成的面上选取；该步骤会被重复。
草图两者都不是：请用草图自身的阵列或镜像重复其曲线，或先将其拉伸。

English (原文): A marker to drag the feature across the model and, where the feature can turn, a ring to turn it.
简体中文: 用于在模型上拖动特征的标记，以及在特征可旋转时用于旋转的圆环。

English (原文): The design, editing context or plugin settings changed while the plugin ran. Nothing was applied.
简体中文: 插件运行期间设计、编辑状态或插件设置发生了变化，未应用任何结果。

English (原文): This plugin is turned off in Preferences › Plugins.
简体中文: 此插件已在“偏好设置 › 插件”中关闭。

English (原文): Finish or cancel the open tool to pick into this field.
简体中文: 请先完成或取消已打开的工具，再在此字段中选择。

English (原文): {field} is outside the values it allows.
This plugin asks for permissions that have not been granted: {groups}. Run stays off until they are.
简体中文: 此插件请求了尚未授予的权限：{groups}。授予前无法运行。

English (原文): This dialog was opened on another design. Switch back to that design to run it, or open the entry again here.
简体中文: 此对话框是在另一个设计中打开的。请切换回该设计后运行，或在此处重新打开该入口。

English (原文): The design changed, so the picks were cleared. Pick them again.
简体中文: 设计已更改，已清除所选内容。请重新选择。

English (原文): This entry needs to be run from the agent or CLI.
简体中文: 此入口需要通过智能体或命令行运行。

English (原文): This entry already has an open form. Finish or cancel it first.
简体中文: 此条目的表单已打开。请先完成或取消。

English (原文): The design changed. Review the inputs against the current design.
简体中文: 设计已更改。请根据当前设计检查输入。

English (原文): This pick is missing or no longer matches the model. Pick it again.
简体中文: 此选择已丢失或不再与模型匹配。请重新选择。

English (原文): The design changed. Review the fields, then press Apply again.
简体中文: 设计已更改。请检查各字段，然后再次点击应用。

English (原文): Plugin field update unavailable. Using the declared fields.
简体中文: 无法更新插件字段。使用已声明的字段。

English (原文): Run plugin installation and removal as separate commands, outside batches and scripts.
简体中文: 请在批处理和脚本之外，通过单独的命令安装和移除插件。

English (原文): Every plugin is turned off in Preferences › Plugins
简体中文: 所有插件都已在“偏好设置 › 插件”中关闭

English (原文): Plugin execution ended without a result.
简体中文: 插件执行结束，但未返回结果。

English (原文): Run external plugin entry “{entry}” from “{path}” with its declared command permissions?
简体中文: 是否以声明的命令权限运行“{path}”中的外部插件入口“{entry}”？

English (原文): Send plugin.run as a separate engine.execute request.
简体中文: 请通过单独的 engine.execute 请求发送 plugin.run。

English (原文): Plugins are available in the desktop app.
简体中文: 插件仅在桌面版中可用。

English (原文): Each plugin is a folder inside {path} with a plugin.json. SolidCraft reads that file and does not run any code from the folder. Turning a plugin off keeps it installed.
简体中文: 每个插件是 {path} 里的一个文件夹，其中有 plugin.json。SolidCraft 只读取该文件，不运行文件夹里的代码。关闭插件仍会保留安装。
